raw.description:
Category: Mental Healthcare

Location:


About Insight Therapy Solutions

At Insight Therapy Solutions, we’re focused on making high-quality mental healthcare accessible across the U.S. As a growing telehealth provider, we work with therapists, clinics, and healthcare partners to expand access to care and support the communities we serve.

Insight Therapy Solutions provides accessible, high-quality mental healthcare through a growing network of therapists and healthcare partners across the U.S. As we expand into new markets, we are building a deliberate approach to identifying healthcare organizations that can generate sustainable patient growth.

About the Role

We’re looking for a Healthcare Market Expansion and Partnerships Representative to help identify and develop new growth opportunities for Insight Therapy Solutions.

This role focuses on opening new markets and building the pipeline of future referral partners. You will research target markets, identify high-value healthcare organizations and decision-makers, develop targeted outreach strategies, initiate conversations, qualify opportunities, and build relationships that can lead to referral partnerships.

This is a hands-on role for someone who enjoys prospecting, research, relationship development, and working toward measurable growth goals. This is not an account management role. Your focus is starting new relationships, not managing or deepening existing ones.

You will work closely with Marketing and senior leadership to determine where Insight should grow, who we should target, how we should approach them, and which opportunities are worth pursuing.

What You’ll Own

Market Expansion

  • Research and identify healthcare markets with potential for patient and referral growth

  • Build target lists of healthcare organizations, providers, clinics, practices, and other referral sources within priority markets

  • Identify market segments and organizations that align with Insight’s services, payer mix, clinical capabilities, and growth priorities

  • Research organizations to identify appropriate decision-makers and referral contacts

  • Help prioritize markets and accounts based on opportunity, fit, and potential referral volume

  • Identify gaps in existing referral coverage and opportunities to expand Insight’s referral network

  • Track market activity, competitive information, and emerging partnership opportunities

Prospecting & New Business Development

  • Conduct consistent outbound prospecting through phone, email, and other appropriate channels

  • Develop personalized outreach based on the organization, market, and potential partnership opportunity

  • Initiate conversations with healthcare providers, clinic leaders, practice managers, behavioral health organizations, and other referral sources

  • Conduct initial discovery conversations to understand the organization’s needs, referral patterns, and potential fit

  • Schedule qualified conversations and partnership opportunities

  • Re-engage prospects that have previously been contacted but have not yet converted into active opportunities

Partnership Development

  • Introduce prospective partners to Insight Therapy Solutions and its services

  • Communicate the value of Insight’s services clearly and professionally

  • Develop relationships with prospective referral partners from initial contact through activation

  • Identify opportunities to create recurring referral relationships rather than one-time referrals

  • Maintain consistent follow-up with prospects throughout the partnership development process

  • Support the activation of new referral partners by coordinating next steps with internal teams

Pipeline & CRM Management

  • Maintain an organized pipeline of target accounts and partnership opportunities

  • Accurately document outreach, contacts, conversations, next steps, and outcomes in our CRM

  • Keep account and contact information current

  • Track opportunities through defined stages from prospecting through partnership activation

  • Use CRM data to manage follow-up and prevent opportunities from going dormant

  • Provide regular reporting on outreach activity, meetings, new opportunities, and partnership development

Market Intelligence & Growth Feedback

  • Identify patterns in outreach responses, referral needs, market demand, and barriers to partnership

  • Share insights with Marketing and leadership to improve targeting, messaging, and market strategy

  • Identify new organizations, referral channels, or market segments that Insight should consider

  • Provide feedback on which outreach messages and approaches generate the strongest response

  • Help identify opportunities to improve Insight’s market positioning and referral proposition

What We’re Looking For

You do not need to be a traditional salesperson. You do need to be persistent, organized, curious, commercially minded, and comfortable initiating conversations with people you don’t know.

Required

  • 2+ years of experience in business development, sales development, healthcare outreach, partnership development, recruiting, account development, or a similar role

  • Experience with outbound prospecting and cold outreach

  • Strong research skills and the ability to identify target organizations and decision-makers

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills

  • Comfortable making outbound calls and sending personalized email and various channel outreach

  • Strong follow-up and pipeline management habits

  • Highly organized and able to manage a large number of prospects simultaneously

  • Comfortable working independently in a remote environment

  • Ability to learn healthcare services and communicate them clearly to prospective partners

  • Experience using a CRM or similar system to manage prospects and activities

Preferred

  • Experience in healthcare, behavioral health, mental health, telehealth, or another healthcare services environment

  • Experience developing physician, therapist, clinic, hospital, or healthcare referral relationships

  • Experience conducting market or territory research

  • Experience with Zoho CRM, Salesforce, HubSpot, or similar CRM platforms

  • Familiarity with different channel prospective and other B2B prospecting tools

  • Experience working toward activity, meeting, pipeline, referral, or revenue targets

The Right Person for This Role

You are someone who:

  • Like finding opportunities that other people haven’t identified yet

  • Can turn a broad market into a focused list of target accounts

  • Is comfortable picking up the phone and starting a conversation

  • Doesn’t get discouraged by unanswered calls or emails

  • Can research an organization before reaching out rather than relying on generic messaging

  • Knows the difference between activity and productive activity

  • Follow up without being asked

  • Can manage your own priorities and workload

  • Pays attention to the data and adjusts your approach based on what is working

  • Thinks about the next opportunity rather than simply completing today’s call list

How Success Will Be Measured

Success in this role will be measured by the quality and progression of the market expansion pipeline—not simply by the number of calls made.

Key measures may include:

  • New target accounts identified

  • Qualified prospects added to pipeline

  • Outreach activity and response rates

  • Qualified meetings generated

  • New markets or market segments developed

  • New referral partners activated

  • Referral opportunities generated

  • Referral volume from newly developed partners

  • Prospect-to-meeting conversion

  • Meeting-to-partnership conversion

  • Pipeline progression and follow-up completion

  • CRM accuracy and pipeline hygiene

  • Market intelligence and growth opportunities identified

Tools You’ll Use

  • CRM systems (e.g., Zoho or similar)

  • Google Workspace

  • Communication tools (email, calling platforms, LinkedIn)

  • Online research and prospecting tools

  • Marketing and outreach resources provided by Insight Therapy Solutions

Benefits

  • Paid time off (PTO)

  • Paid U.S. holidays

  • Paid birthday leave

  • Parental leave

  • Monthly health stipend to support your well-being

Why Join Us

  • 100% remote — work from home

  • Work closely with senior leadership and gain direct exposure

  • Be part of a collaborative, mission-driven team

  • Gain hands-on experience in healthcare growth, market expansion, and partnership development

  • Join a growing organization where your work directly contributes to expanding access to mental healthcare

Work Hours

  • Full-time (40 hours a week)

  • Monday-Friday

  • 8 AM-5 PM Pacific Time (1 hour lunch break)

We are looking for someone who is always thinking about artificial intelligence, someone who can maintain alignment in a fast paced and constantly evolving field.

As a Solutions Architect, you will be the first line of technical expertise between NVIDIA, our AI consulting partners and our end-customers. Your duties will vary from creating pilots, demos and MvPs, to building relationships with key technical teams to evangelize accelerated computing and Agentic AI. raw.description:
Senior Competitive & Market Intelligence Manager

WEKA is the AI data and memory infrastructure company transforming how organizations build, run, and scale AI. NeuralMesh™ combines high-performance data storage and extended GPU memory in a single software platform, providing a foundation for training, inference, and agentic AI workloads that maximizes GPU productivity, accelerates AI outcomes, and improves the economics of AI at scale.

WEKA is a pre-IPO, growth-stage company backed by world-class venture capital investors and AI infrastructure leaders. Our technology is trusted by 30% of the Fortune 50, as well as leading hyperscalers, neoclouds, AI builders, and research organizations. Our team is customer-obsessed, accountable, bold, and collaborative, with a shared focus on helping customers succeed. If we sound like your kind of people, join us!

About The Role

We are seeking a Senior Competitive & Market Intelligence Manager to build and lead the intelligence capability that helps us understand where the market is going, how competitors are evolving, where WEKA has the right to win, and what we need to do about it.

This is a technical, hands-on builder role. You will design and scale the systems, tools, operating rhythms, and feedback loops that turn fragmented competitive, customer, field, and market signals into a trusted intelligence engine for the company. You'll go deep on competitors and market dynamics, develop clear points of view, and translate what you learn into positioning, competitive deal strategies, field tools, technical briefs, training decks, product insights, and recommendations that help WEKA stay ahead in a fast-moving AI infrastructure market.

Reporting to the VP of Product Marketing, you'll work closely with Product, Sales, Solutions Engineering, Marketing, Alliances, GTM Operations, and executive leadership. You'll serve as a trusted source of intelligence across the company, helping teams understand not simply what is changing, but what it means for WEKA and what we should do next.

Who We’re Looking For

You're a senior builder. You've created or materially scaled a competitive or market intelligence capability before, and you understand everything required to make it work: sources, tools, processes, field feedback loops, operating cadence, executive communication, enablement, and measurement. You're comfortable starting with a blank page, deciding what matters, and building a system people actually trust and use.

You're intellectually curious, analytical, and technical enough to go well beyond competitor websites and marketing claims. You can dig into products, architectures, benchmarks, customer experiences, business models, and go-to-market strategies, separate signal from noise, and develop a defensible point of view about where competitors are strong, where they're vulnerable, and where the market is headed.

You also know intelligence only matters if it changes decisions and outcomes. You can turn deep research into a concise executive recommendation, a sharp competitive position, or a field tool a seller can use in a live deal. You stay close to Sales, Product, customers, and the market, and measure success by better decisions and stronger competitive performance, not the volume of research produced.

What You’ll Be Working On

  • Build the Intelligence Engine: Design and scale WEKA's competitive and market intelligence program, including sources, tooling, workflows, taxonomy, operating cadence, governance, distribution, and feedback loops. Create a trusted system of record that stays current as the market evolves.
  • Own Competitive Intelligence: Develop deep intelligence on priority competitors across products, architecture, performance, positioning, customers, partnerships, business models, and go-to-market strategy. Identify strengths, vulnerabilities, strategic moves, and likely next steps.
  • Monitor Competitive Pricing & Packaging: Track competitor pricing, packaging, licensing, consumption models, and commercial changes, and surface meaningful shifts to Product and other stakeholders to inform pricing and packaging decisions.
  • Drive Market Intelligence: Track the forces reshaping AI infrastructure, including technology shifts, market structure, customer requirements, emerging categories and competitors, cloud and neocloud dynamics, ecosystem moves, business models, and buying patterns. Translate those signals into implications and opportunities for WEKA.
  • Turn Intelligence Into Strategy: Synthesize competitive, market, customer, and field signals into clear points of view and actionable recommendations that inform company positioning, product strategy, go-to-market priorities, category strategy, and where WEKA should invest, defend, or differentiate.
  • Create Competitive Positioning & Tools: Develop and continuously improve competitive positioning, battlecards, playbooks, objection handling, comparison frameworks, executive briefs, and other tools that help Sales, Solutions Engineering, partners, and Marketing differentiate WEKA and win.
  • Build the Field Intelligence Loop: Establish scalable ways to capture what sellers, SEs, partners, prospects, and customers are seeing in the market. Partner with Sales and GTM Operations to turn competitive deal data, field feedback, and win/loss insights into intelligence that improves positioning, enablement, and strategy.
  • Support Competitive Deals: Engage directly with Sales and Solutions Engineering on strategic competitive opportunities, helping teams understand the competitor, sharpen the strategy, respond to claims, and apply what is learned back into the broader intelligence program.
  • Deliver Executive Intelligence: Establish a consistent cadence of concise, decision-oriented competitive and market briefings for Product, GTM, and executive leadership, surfacing meaningful changes, emerging threats and opportunities, and recommended actions.
  • Apply AI & Automation: Use AI, automation, and modern intelligence tools to continuously monitor market signals, accelerate research and synthesis, and deliver intelligence in the workflows where teams need it. Apply strong judgment to ensure automation increases signal rather than noise.
  • Influence Product & Marketing: Partner closely with Product and Product Marketing to bring competitive and market insights into roadmap discussions, positioning and messaging, launches, category strategy, campaigns, and thought leadership.
  • Leverage Analyst & Industry Insights: Work with Analyst Relations and other external intelligence sources to incorporate analyst research, industry perspectives, market data, and third-party validation into WEKA's view of the market and competitive landscape.
  • Measure Impact: Establish practical measures of success including intelligence adoption, field engagement, competitive win/loss trends, effectiveness of competitive plays, and demonstrated influence on product, positioning, and GTM decisions.

Qualifications

  • 6+ years of experience in competitive intelligence, market intelligence, product marketing, product strategy, management consulting, industry research, or a closely related role in enterprise technology.
  • Demonstrated experience personally building or materially scaling a competitive or market intelligence program, including the systems, tools, processes, operating cadence, and feedback loops required to make it sustainable. We are looking for someone who has built the muscle, not simply participated in an established program.
  • Strong experience conducting competitive research and analysis and translating complex findings into clear positioning, recommendations, enablement, and executive-level insights.
  • Strong technical aptitude and the ability to independently understand enterprise infrastructure architectures, product capabilities, performance claims, integrations, and technical differentiation.
  • Working knowledge of AI/ML infrastructure, accelerated computing, cloud computing, data platforms, storage and memory technologies, or adjacent enterprise infrastructure technologies.
  • Experience building field intelligence and win/loss programs, working directly with Sales, Solutions Engineering, customers, and GTM Operations to understand real-world competitive dynamics.
  • Strong primary and secondary research skills with the ability to synthesize product research, customer and field feedback, analyst research, market data, public information, and other signals into a clear point of view.
  • Exceptional written, visual, and verbal communication skills, with the ability to move from deep analysis to concise battlecards, executive briefings, presentations, and strategic recommendations.
  • Experience using AI, automation, and competitive or market intelligence tools to improve the speed, scale, and quality of intelligence programs.
  • Proven ability to influence Product, Sales, Marketing, and executive stakeholders without direct authority and turn intelligence into action.
  • Strong business judgment and an outcome-oriented mindset, with the ability to prioritize the competitors, market questions, and intelligence work most likely to influence customers, strategy, pipeline, and revenue.
  • Comfortable operating as a senior individual contributor in a fast-paced, high-growth environment with significant autonomy and evolving priorities.
  • Bachelor's degree in a relevant technical or business field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Located in North America with the ability to travel up to 25%.

How We Work: The WEKA Way

  • We are Accountable: We take full ownership, always, even when things don't go as planned. We lead with integrity, show up with responsibility and ownership, and hold ourselves and each other to the highest standards.
  • We are Brave: We question the status quo, push boundaries, and take smart risks when needed. We welcome challenges and embrace debates as opportunities for growth, turning courage into fuel for innovation.
  • We are Collaborative: True collaboration isn't only about working together. It's about lifting one another up to succeed collectively. We are team-oriented and communicate with empathy and respect. We challenge each other, resolve conflict constructively, and are transparent about our goals and the results we achieve. Together, we're unstoppable.
  • We are Customer Centric: Our customers are at the heart of everything we do. We actively listen and prioritize their success, and every decision we make is driven by how we can better serve, support, and empower them to succeed. When our customers win, we win.

Concerned you don’t meet every qualification? Don’t let it stop you from applying!

Studies have shown that traditionally underrepresented groups may be less likely to apply for jobs if they don’t meet every qualification specified. WEKA is committed to building a diverse, inclusive, and authentic workplace. If you are excited about this position but are concerned your past work experience doesn’t match up perfectly with the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles at WEKA.

What We Can Achieve Together:

In this newly created role, the Global Teams Recruiting Lead will execute the strategy and recruitment processes for our general recruiting efforts within the Global Teams which consist of our Chief Conservation Office, Global Science, Protect Oceans Land and Waters, Provide Food & Water Sustainability, Tackle Climate Change, Global Oceans, as well as Impact Finance and Markets, Policy And Public Funding. They will lead a small group of recruiters, as well as consistently manage their own set of mid-level recruitments. They will develop a pipeline of potential talent, network and collaboratively engage recruiting partners globally to ensure best and emerging practices to create a unified approach to talent acquisition at The Nature Conservancy. This role will be a member of the Talent Acquisition team and an integral part of the Global Team as they work to provide subject matter expertise to meet our hiring goals and create a positive experience for candidates. This role will manage large projects and play a significant role in stabilizing and optimizing our newly implemented Applicant Tracking System and Candidate Relationship Management system.

This is a Remote Role that will require flexibility in schedule to reach across global time zones. Preferred location in United Kingdom.

We’re Looking for You:

This is an exciting opportunity to join our Talent Acquisition team and support our mission by finding the next great talent to help us save our planet!

We’re looking for someone who is a great leader of people who can also roll up their sleeves and manage their own requisition load. A change agent who can influence and advise senior leaders on our hiring processes to support our ambitious 2030 goals. A key partner that can collectively build our values based, culturally mosaic, and mission driven workforce. An analytical thinker who leverages technology and stays on top of market trends to deliver world class experience to our candidates and hiring managers. We are looking for you to bring innovative ideas to build and implement effective, proactive, and efficient recruitment strategies and processes to address the talent for all non-term-limited mid-level positions while ensuring best practices are being followed.

What You’ll Bring:

  • Bachelor’s degree and 6 years HR related experience in HR/Talent Acquisition or equivalent combination.

  • Experience as a manager of a recruiting function or team; managing remotely a plus.

  • Leadership experience in building a program area, motivating, developing, and engaging team members toward a shared vision and goals

  • Experience working with senior leaders to develop and implement Talent Acquisition strategies and initiatives

  • Experience communicating and developing relationships with a broad range of audiences including experience working with or recruiting for global teams.

  • As this is a global role; multi-lingual skills and multi-cultural or cross-cultural experience appreciated.

  • Experience working with an Applicant Tracking System producing reports, data manipulation, analysis, and recommending process flow efficiencies and enhancements.

  • Experience leading recruiters while actively managing and closing your own searches.

  • Experience leading projects and coordinating the work of others

  • Experience with prioritizing and organizing work while attending to details.

  • Excellent interpersonal skills, strong client service orientation and client centric mindset

  • Experience using MS Office software

  • Must be willing and able to travel outside of the US.

Salary Information

This position may be based in any country where TNC has an established entity, taking into consideration legal restrictions, such as non-national ratios and immigration processing times. For U.S. based applicants only, the starting pay range for this position is generally within the range of $112,000-137,000 for annual base salary and is based on location, qualifications, specific skills, and experience. This range only applies to candidates whose country of employment is the USA. For all other applicants, pay ranges will be in local currency, the pay range will be based on the local labor market, and not tied to the above pay range. Your geographic location will be confirmed during the recruitment and used to determine your actual pay range. Additionally, for all applicants, actual pay will fall within a range based on a variety of factors including, for example, the candidate's qualifications, specific skills and experience.

Who We Are:

The Nature Conservancy’s mission is to protect the lands and waters upon which all life depends. As a science-based organization, we create innovative, on-the-ground solutions to our world’s toughest challenges so that we can create a world in which people and nature thrive. We’re rooted in our mission and guided by our values, which include respect for all people, communities, and cultures. Whether it’s career development, flexible schedules, or a rewarding mission, there’s many reasons to love life inside TNC. Want a better insight to TNC? Check out our TNC Talent playlist on YouTube to hear stories from staff or visit Glassdoor.

One goal is to cultivate an inclusive work environment so that all our colleagues around the globe feel a sense of belonging and that their unique contributions to our mission are valued. In addition to the requirements in our job postings, we recognize that people come with talent and experiences outside of a job and consider each applicant’s unique experience. Please apply – we’d love to hear from you. To quote a popular saying at TNC, “you’ll join for the mission, and stay for the people.”

What We Bring:

Since 1951, TNC has been doing work you can believe in. Through grassroots action, we have grown from a small non-profit into one of the most effective and wide-reaching environmental organizations in the world. Thanks to more than 1 million members, over 400 scientists, and the dedicated efforts of our diverse staff and partners, we impact conservation around the world!

TNC offers competitive and comprehensive benefits packages tailored to the individual countries where we work. These may include health care benefits, retirement benefits, parental leave, paid time off, life insurance, and disability coverage as well as an employee assistance program and other life and well-being benefits. Learn more about our Benefits and Perks here.

We’re proud to offer a flexible work environment that supports the health and well-being of the people we employ.

Our recruiting process includes a rolling interview process to ensure we engage applicants in a timely manner. This means we may review applications in the order in which they are received. Once a strong candidate pool is identified, the role will be unposted. The timeline may vary depending on the expressed interest in the role, so we highly encourage candidates to apply as soon as possible.

Employees must submit their application by logging into Workday and applying via the Jobs Hub.

The Nature Conservancy is an Equal Opportunity Employer.Our commitment to equal employment opportunity includes the recognition that our conservation mission is best advanced by the leadership and contributions of people of all backgrounds, beliefs, and culture. Recruiting and mentoring staff to create an inclusive organization is a priority, and we encourage applicants from all cultures, races, colors, religions, sexes, national or regional origins, ages, disability status, sexual orientation, gender identity, military, protected veteran status or other status protected by law.

The successful applicant must meet the requirements of The Nature Conservancy's background screening process.

On-Call Availability (On-Call Shift System)

  • What this means: This does not mean you will be actively working 24/7 or during late-night shifts. Instead, you will be on standby outside of standard working hours, meaning you must be reachable and available to log in and resolve critical system incidents only if they arise.

  • Frequency: The approximate rotation frequency is one full week (7 consecutive days) every 3 to 4 months, depending on the team's internal calendar.

Mandatory Technical Knowledge

  • Minimum of 4 years of experience in a similar role.

Nice to Have / Desirable

raw.description:
Equifax is where you can power your possible. If you want to achieve your true potential, chart new paths, develop new skills, collaborate with bright minds, and make a meaningful impact, we want to hear from you.

Equifax’s US Information Solutions (USIS) business unit is seeking a strategic Account Executive - Digital Advertising Channel Partnerships to join our Data-Driven Marketing sales team. The USIS business unit transforms massive consumer and commercial datasets into actionable consumer and commercial risk, identity and fraud, and marketing insights that create a competitive advantage for our customers and open new opportunities.

The Data-Driven Marketing team is responsible for solutions that leverage data insights and solutions to attract the right new customers, deliver a positive experience, and deepen existing relationships. From precise audience segmentation to data-driven growth strategy, Equifax helps businesses reach consumers with the right financial profile for products and services.

As an Account Executive - Digital Advertising Channel Partnerships, you will drive revenue growth by consulting with businesses in this industry, helping them leverage our unique blend of differentiated data assets and advanced analytics capabilities. This is a client-facing, high-touch, sales role responsible for revenue generation, customer relationship and Equifax engagement within highly complex, strategic accounts. AEs have primary responsibility for their clients, and must orchestrate other Equifax resources efficiently to drive sales and revenue growth of a full solutions portfolio.

An ideal candidate will have expertise with consumer marketing data, experience working in AdTech and digital media, and strong direct and partner sales acumen. They will be tasked with protecting existing revenue as well as growing new business.

What you will do

  • Drive Strategic Growth: Own the end-to-end sales cycle to identify, pipeline, and close net-new opportunities while aggressively protecting and growing existing revenue across complex digital advertising and AdTech channel partners.
  • Act as a Trusted Advisor: Consult deeply with clients to understand their business imperatives, embedding Equifax’s differentiated consumer marketing data and identity solutions into their digital ecosystems.
  • Orchestrate Deal Execution: Lead cross-functional Equifax teams—including pre-sales, solutions, and delivery—to seamlessly execute complex, multi-solution deals and drive maximum customer value.
  • Own Account Strategy: Develop and execute comprehensive account plans that align your clients' digital growth strategies with Equifax’s advanced analytics capabilities.
  • Navigate the C-Suite: Build and maintain high-trust, strategic relationships with economic buyers, decision-makers, and key influencers within your partner accounts.
  • Prove ROI: Prepare and conduct compelling quarterly business reviews (QBRs) that demonstrate tangible value, anticipate future needs, and position optimal Equifax solutions.
  • Manage the Business: Oversee complex pricing negotiations, contracting processes, and ongoing contract compliance to ensure profitable, sustainable partnerships.

What experience you need

  • Education: Bachelor’s degree from an accredited university or equivalent work experience.
  • Proven Sales Excellence: 7–10 years of experience consistently meeting or exceeding quota in an Enterprise Account Executive, Channel Partnership, or Senior Business Development role.
  • Deep AdTech Fluency: Strong industry expertise in the MarTech and digital media ecosystems, with a deep understanding of programmatic advertising, identity resolution, consumer graphs, and broader digital marketing channels (SEO, SEM, social, display).
  • Technical Acumen: High proficiency navigating complex digital tools, including CRM systems (e.g., Salesforce), marketing automation platforms, and data analytics dashboards.
  • Executive Presence: Demonstrated ability to build relationships, present compelling data-driven value propositions, and negotiate complex agreements with C-level stakeholders.
  • Strategic Agility: A highly adaptable mindset with the ability to stay ahead of the rapidly evolving advertising landscape, learning new technologies and pivoting sales strategies as market trends shift.

What would set you apart

  • Product Knowledge (Marketing Data): Proven experience directly selling complex consumer or business marketing data. You understand how to position highly targeted datasets—such as SKU-level consumer purchasing data, B2B firmographics, or advanced audience segments—to drive campaign ROI.
  • Relentless "Hunter" DNA: You are a notoriously resilient, proactive, and consultative seller. You don't just manage accounts; you aggressively hunt for new revenue streams, scale partnerships, and thrive in a high-performance, quota-driven environment.
  • Omnichannel Fluency: A strong understanding of how data flows across diverse advertising formats, from Connected TV (e.g., Madhive), streaming audio (e.g., Pandora/SiriusXM), and native/programmatic (e.g., OpenX, Pubmatic, Taboola) to digital out-of-home (OOH) partners (e.g., Outfront Media, Lamar Advertising).
  • Elite Media or AdTech Pedigree: Previous experience working at a major media agency holding company or a premier AdTech platform/partner.

Equifax is required by law to include a good-faith salary range for this role. This compensation range takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to: skill sets; experience and training; and other business and organizational needs. At Equifax, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role. A reasonable estimate of the current base salary range is $117,110.00 to $160,000.00. This position is also eligible for our sales incentive compensation program at approximately 55%. The application window is anticipated to close on September 15, 2026. This date is a good faith estimate only and may be modified where necessary.

We offer comprehensive compensation and healthcare packages, 401k matching, paid time off, and organizational growth potential through our online learning platform with guided career tracks.

Are you ready to power your possible? Apply today, and get started on a path toward an exciting new career at Equifax, where you can make a difference!

LaunchDarkly is looking for a VP, Americas sales to lead and scale our core revenue region during a period of high growth and rapid expansion across our product portfolio. Reporting to the Chief Revenue Officer, this leader will own new business and expansion revenue across North America’s Strategic, Enterprise, and Corporate segments.

This is a high-impact role for a builder and operator who can turn market insight into focused go-to-market execution, build a repeatable pipeline engine, and create the operating discipline needed for predictable growth. The VP will lead a multi-level sales organization and partner closely with Marketing, SDR/BDR, Solutions Engineering, Customer Success, Partnerships, Enablement, Product, and Revenue Operations.

Responsibilities:

  • Own Americas new business and expansion revenue across Strategic, Enterprise, and Corporate segments.
  • Set go-to-market strategy across segmentation, territories, coverage, capacity, hiring, and resources.
  • Build repeatable pipeline through outbound, inbound, account-based, partner, and executive-selling motions.
  • Establish rigorous operating rhythms for pipeline inspection, forecasting, deal progression, performance, and business reviews.
  • Lead, coach, and develop Sales Directors, Managers, and Account Executives while building a strong management bench.
  • Drive consistent sales methodology, account planning, qualification, and pipeline hygiene.

In this role, you will provide critical after-hours support, triaging hospice patients and family needs over the phone wit professionalism and empathy. You will help ensure timely interventions and coordination of care for patients receiving hospice services.

Built around a mission to improve the lives of nurses and patients, IntellaTriage has been providing after-hours nurse triage for hospice and home health providers since 2008. Utilizing best-in-class technology, IntellaTriage provides round-the-clock direct access to licensed, registered nurses using client-customized protocols for patient-centered, compassionate care. We are growing rapidly and excited to support our clients’ nursing staff in the field by leveraging our remote team of nurses to manage after-hours care delivery.     • 3 weeks of paid remote training
    • Supportive clinical team

“Helping people. That’s it. And knowing this team has your back—that makes all the difference. People say it takes a special kind of person to do hospice, and I think that’s true. You’re walking with people and their families through one of the most sacred times in life. It’s an honor to support them and guide them through that journey. I’m so grateful to have been chosen for this award.”

Key responsibilities

  • Provide telephone triage for hospice patients and families
  • Assess patient conditions and determine appropriate next steps
  • Collaborate with on-call teams to coordinate care and resources
  • Accurately document all communications and interventions
  • Maintain a calm and professional demeanor while handling urgent calls.

Benefits

All Remote Hospice Triage RNs, once trained to their originally assigned team are paid $25 per hour. All nurses are eligible for a $2 shift differential for overnights and a $2 shift differential for weekends (Friday evening, Saturday & Sunday). raw.description:
We're transforming the grocery industry

At Instacart, we invite the world to share love through food because we believe everyone should have access to the food they love and more time to enjoy it together. Where others see a simple need for grocery delivery, we see exciting complexity and endless opportunity to serve the varied needs of our community. We work to deliver an essential service that customers rely on to get their groceries and household goods, while also offering safe and flexible earnings opportunities to Instacart Personal Shoppers.

Instacart has become a lifeline for millions of people, and we’re building the team to help push our shopping cart forward. If you’re ready to do the best work of your life, come join our table.

Instacart is a Flex First team

There’s no one-size fits all approach to how we do our best work. Our employees have the flexibility to choose where they do their best work—whether it’s from home, an office, or your favorite coffee shop—while staying connected and building community through regular in-person events. Learn more about our flexible approach to where we work.

Overview

Our backend systems power the clients used by millions of customers every year to buy their groceries online. These systems must also support tight integration with the largest retailers in the US and Canada. Engineering at Instacart provides the opportunity to work on challenging scaling problems while also designing the features that will define our industry. You will learn how to build in an open collaborative environment serving millions of requests daily.

Finance data engineering is part of the Data Infrastructure team, working closely with accounting, billing & revenue teams to support the monthly/quarterly book close, retailer invoicing and internal/external financial reporting. The team plays a critical role in defining how financial data is modeled and standardized for uniform, reliable, timely and accurate reporting. This is a high impact, high visibility role owning critical data integration pipelines and models across all of Instacart's products.

The team is still small and many of our bigger initiatives are at an early stage. We expect you to work closely with stakeholders and shape these systems from design, technical decisions, project management to execution. Your input will be critical for driving the Finance Data Strategy and building the platform that Instacart's financial data infrastructure will be built upon.

About the Job

  • You will work closely with finance, accounting, billing, and revenue teams to understand their main pain points and translate them into self-serve, reliable, and scalable data solutions.
  • You are expected to mentor other team members and be a champion of engineering excellence across the organization.
  • You will be part of a small team with a large amount of ownership and autonomy, managing initiatives directly from design through execution.
  • You will have the freedom to suggest and drive organization-wide initiatives that shape the financial data vision and roadmap.
  • You will own critical data integration pipelines and models, ensuring uniform, reliable, timely, and accurate financial reporting.

About You

Minimum Qualifications

  • 8+ years of working experience in a Data/Software Engineering role, with a focus on building data pipelines (specialized in financial data).
  • Strong knowledge of cloud based warehouses like Snowflake, Redshift, BigQuery.
  • Strong knowledge of common data infra technologies (Python, Airflow, Spark, Iceberg, Delta Lake) in a production environment.
  • Expert in data modeling with experience in modeling complex financial data with scalability and usability in mind.
  • Expert with SQL and dbt (Data Build Tool).
  • Experience building high quality and complex ETL/ELT pipelines including pipelines for accounting/billing purposes.
  • Experience with data immutability, auditability, slowly changing dimensions or similar concepts.
  • Adept at fluently communicating with many cross-functional stakeholders to drive requirements and design shared datasets.
  • An ability to balance a sense of urgency with shipping high quality and pragmatic solutions.
  • Experience working with a large codebase on a cross functional team.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, computer engineering, electrical engineering or equivalent work experience.
  • Experience with Snowflake, dbt (Data Build Tool) and Airflow.
  • Experience with SOX controlled data systems.

raw.description:
Please submit your CV in English and indicate your level of English proficiency.

Mindrift connects specialists with project-based AI opportunities for leading tech companies, focused on testing, evaluating, and improving AI systems. Participation is project-based, not permanent employment.

What this opportunity involves We're building a dataset to evaluate AI coding agents - how well a model handles real-world developer tasks.

You'll create challenging tasks and evaluation criteria within realistic simulated environments:

  • Build realistic developer environments - a virtual company with codebase, infrastructure, and context (tickets, docs, conversations) that forms a believable development history
  • Design tasks from intermediate states of these environments - craft the prompt, define what "solved" means, and ensure the task is solvable by an AI agent
  • Write tests that verify agent solutions - accept all valid approaches and reject incorrect ones, neither too strict nor too lenient
  • Iterate on tasks and tests based on QA feedback - review agent solutions, analyze failures, and refine until the evaluation is fair and robust

What this is NOT

  • Not data labeling
  • Not prompt engineering
  • Not writing code from scratch - the agent writes most of the code; you guide and evaluate

What we look for

  • 5+ years in software development
  • Core stack: Python (FastAPI), JavaScript/TypeScript (React), Docker, Postgres, Kafka, Redis
  • Experience writing tests (functional, integration)
  • English proficiency - B2+

Why this is hard

Frontier models are already good at coding. Creating a task that genuinely challenges the best models is non-trivial. You need to deeply understand where models fail and what scenarios reveal the difference between a good and a bad solution. Tasks have many valid solutions - writing tests that accept all correct solutions and reject incorrect ones is harder than it sounds.

How it works

Apply → Pass qualification(s) → Join a project → Complete tasks → Get paid

Compensation

Up to $40/hr equivalent, depending on level and pace. Tasks are estimated at ~20 hours each; you set your own schedule.

raw.description:
Category: Mental Healthcare

Location:


About Insight Therapy Solutions

At Insight Therapy Solutions, we’re focused on making high-quality mental healthcare accessible across the U.S. As a growing telehealth provider, we work with therapists, clinics, and healthcare partners to expand access to care and support the communities we serve.

Insight Therapy Solutions provides accessible, high-quality mental healthcare through a growing network of therapists and healthcare partners across the U.S. As we expand into new markets, we are building a deliberate approach to identifying healthcare organizations that can generate sustainable patient growth.

About the Role

We’re looking for a Healthcare Market Expansion and Partnerships Representative to help identify and develop new growth opportunities for Insight Therapy Solutions.

This role focuses on opening new markets and building the pipeline of future referral partners. You will research target markets, identify high-value healthcare organizations and decision-makers, develop targeted outreach strategies, initiate conversations, qualify opportunities, and build relationships that can lead to referral partnerships.

This is a hands-on role for someone who enjoys prospecting, research, relationship development, and working toward measurable growth goals. This is not an account management role. Your focus is starting new relationships, not managing or deepening existing ones.

You will work closely with Marketing and senior leadership to determine where Insight should grow, who we should target, how we should approach them, and which opportunities are worth pursuing.

What You’ll Own

Market Expansion

  • Research and identify healthcare markets with potential for patient and referral growth

  • Build target lists of healthcare organizations, providers, clinics, practices, and other referral sources within priority markets

  • Identify market segments and organizations that align with Insight’s services, payer mix, clinical capabilities, and growth priorities

  • Research organizations to identify appropriate decision-makers and referral contacts

  • Help prioritize markets and accounts based on opportunity, fit, and potential referral volume

  • Identify gaps in existing referral coverage and opportunities to expand Insight’s referral network

  • Track market activity, competitive information, and emerging partnership opportunities

Prospecting & New Business Development

  • Conduct consistent outbound prospecting through phone, email, and other appropriate channels

  • Develop personalized outreach based on the organization, market, and potential partnership opportunity

  • Initiate conversations with healthcare providers, clinic leaders, practice managers, behavioral health organizations, and other referral sources

  • Conduct initial discovery conversations to understand the organization’s needs, referral patterns, and potential fit

  • Schedule qualified conversations and partnership opportunities

  • Re-engage prospects that have previously been contacted but have not yet converted into active opportunities

Partnership Development

  • Introduce prospective partners to Insight Therapy Solutions and its services

  • Communicate the value of Insight’s services clearly and professionally

  • Develop relationships with prospective referral partners from initial contact through activation

  • Identify opportunities to create recurring referral relationships rather than one-time referrals

  • Maintain consistent follow-up with prospects throughout the partnership development process

  • Support the activation of new referral partners by coordinating next steps with internal teams

Pipeline & CRM Management

  • Maintain an organized pipeline of target accounts and partnership opportunities

  • Accurately document outreach, contacts, conversations, next steps, and outcomes in our CRM

  • Keep account and contact information current

  • Track opportunities through defined stages from prospecting through partnership activation

  • Use CRM data to manage follow-up and prevent opportunities from going dormant

  • Provide regular reporting on outreach activity, meetings, new opportunities, and partnership development

Market Intelligence & Growth Feedback

  • Identify patterns in outreach responses, referral needs, market demand, and barriers to partnership

  • Share insights with Marketing and leadership to improve targeting, messaging, and market strategy

  • Identify new organizations, referral channels, or market segments that Insight should consider

  • Provide feedback on which outreach messages and approaches generate the strongest response

  • Help identify opportunities to improve Insight’s market positioning and referral proposition

What We’re Looking For

You do not need to be a traditional salesperson. You do need to be persistent, organized, curious, commercially minded, and comfortable initiating conversations with people you don’t know.

Required

  • 2+ years of experience in business development, sales development, healthcare outreach, partnership development, recruiting, account development, or a similar role

  • Experience with outbound prospecting and cold outreach

  • Strong research skills and the ability to identify target organizations and decision-makers

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills

  • Comfortable making outbound calls and sending personalized email and various channel outreach

  • Strong follow-up and pipeline management habits

  • Highly organized and able to manage a large number of prospects simultaneously

  • Comfortable working independently in a remote environment

  • Ability to learn healthcare services and communicate them clearly to prospective partners

  • Experience using a CRM or similar system to manage prospects and activities

Preferred

  • Experience in healthcare, behavioral health, mental health, telehealth, or another healthcare services environment

  • Experience developing physician, therapist, clinic, hospital, or healthcare referral relationships

  • Experience conducting market or territory research

  • Experience with Zoho CRM, Salesforce, HubSpot, or similar CRM platforms

  • Familiarity with different channel prospective and other B2B prospecting tools

  • Experience working toward activity, meeting, pipeline, referral, or revenue targets

The Right Person for This Role

You are someone who:

  • Like finding opportunities that other people haven’t identified yet

  • Can turn a broad market into a focused list of target accounts

  • Is comfortable picking up the phone and starting a conversation

  • Doesn’t get discouraged by unanswered calls or emails

  • Can research an organization before reaching out rather than relying on generic messaging

  • Knows the difference between activity and productive activity

  • Follow up without being asked

  • Can manage your own priorities and workload

  • Pays attention to the data and adjusts your approach based on what is working

  • Thinks about the next opportunity rather than simply completing today’s call list

How Success Will Be Measured

Success in this role will be measured by the quality and progression of the market expansion pipeline—not simply by the number of calls made.

Key measures may include:

  • New target accounts identified

  • Qualified prospects added to pipeline

  • Outreach activity and response rates

  • Qualified meetings generated

  • New markets or market segments developed

  • New referral partners activated

  • Referral opportunities generated

  • Referral volume from newly developed partners

  • Prospect-to-meeting conversion

  • Meeting-to-partnership conversion

  • Pipeline progression and follow-up completion

  • CRM accuracy and pipeline hygiene

  • Market intelligence and growth opportunities identified

Tools You’ll Use

  • CRM systems (e.g., Zoho or similar)

  • Google Workspace

  • Communication tools (email, calling platforms, LinkedIn)

  • Online research and prospecting tools

  • Marketing and outreach resources provided by Insight Therapy Solutions

Benefits

  • Paid time off (PTO)

  • Paid U.S. holidays

  • Paid birthday leave

  • Parental leave

  • Monthly health stipend to support your well-being

Why Join Us

  • 100% remote — work from home

  • Work closely with senior leadership and gain direct exposure

  • Be part of a collaborative, mission-driven team

  • Gain hands-on experience in healthcare growth, market expansion, and partnership development

  • Join a growing organization where your work directly contributes to expanding access to mental healthcare

Work Hours

  • Full-time (40 hours a week)

  • Monday-Friday

  • 8 AM-5 PM Pacific Time (1 hour lunch break)

Position Summary:
The Customer Engagement Coordinator is responsible for enhancing customer satisfaction and loyalty by managing customer interactions, resolving inquiries, and ensuring a positive experience. This role includes accurate and timely entry of customer orders into the company's order management system, close communication with customers, and coordination with sales teams and various departments to ensure efficient order processing that meets customer expectations. The role also involves addressing customer needs, managing communication channels, and maintaining accurate records of customer interactions.

Work You’ll Do:

  • Provide customer service and manage post-order activities, including order acknowledgments, expediting, operations coordination, tracking, and documentation.

  • Ensure all post-order questions, emergency orders, and customer issues are resolved promptly to ensure customer satisfaction.

  • Serve as the main point of contact for post-order communication, collaborating closely with Aftermarket Sales Representatives, Outside Sales Representatives, and internal departments.

  • Provide customers with order status updates and change order notifications related to ship dates.

  • Build and maintain strong customer relationships.

  • Act as the primary point of contact for customer inquiries and concerns.

  • Coordinate and manage communication between customers and internal teams.

  • Resolve customer issues promptly and escalate when necessary.

  • Track and analyze customer feedback to support continuous improvement initiatives.

  • Maintain up-to-date knowledge of products and services to assist customers effectively.

  • Support the development and implementation of customer engagement strategies.

Team:
This role will be a part of the Customer Service and Engagement team.

Basic Qualifications:

  • High School Diploma or equivalent.

  • Minimum of 2 years in a customer-facing role, preferably in manufacturing.

  • Proficiency in Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) software (e.g., SAP).

  • Experience with Customer Relationship Management (CRM) software (e.g., Oracle, Salesforce).

  • Strong working knowledge of Microsoft Office tools (Outlook, Word, Excel, etc.).

  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.

  • Strong data entry and organizational skills.

  • Ability to manage multiple tasks simultaneously with attention to detail.

  • Problem-solving mindset with a strong sense of ownership and accountability.

  • Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a team environment.

  • High level of empathy and customer-centric focus.

  • Adaptability in a fast-paced, dynamic work environment.

  • A proactive, change-oriented mindset.

  • Commitment to continuous improvement.

  • Willingness to travel up to 5%.

Who we are:

Coperion () is a global industry and technology leader in process technology serving a variety of end markets, including plastics, plastics recycling, food, pet food, pharmaceuticals, cosmetics, chemical, battery, and mineral industries. Every day, our teams of experts create individual, high-quality process technologies and systems optimized for the best end products, highest efficiency, and sustainability. Coperion is a business unit of Hillenbrand.

Hillenbrand () is a global industrial company that provides highly engineered, mission-critical processing equipment and solutions to customers in over 100 countries around the world. Our portfolio is composed of leading industrial brands that serve large, attractive end markets, including durable plastics, food, and recycling. Guided by our Purpose — Shape What Matters For Tomorrow™ — we pursue excellence, collaboration, and innovation to consistently shape solutions that best serve our associates, customers, communities, and other stakeholders.

raw.description:
NVIDIA is looking for a Senior Solutions Architect to work with our Global Systems Integrator partners and AI consulting partners. This role requires a combination of technical authority and proven experience operating within regional partnerships. This individual will help inspire our partners to reimagine, reinvent and operate the enterprise business processes of the world's largest companies using Agentic AI using the NVIDIA platform. This is a highly technical role that requires deep expertise in generative AI, large language models (LLMs), and scalable software engineering practices. Our goal is to develop long-lasting relationships with our technology partners, making NVIDIA an integral part of their solutions. We are looking for someone who is always thinking about artificial intelligence, someone who can maintain alignment in a fast paced and constantly evolving field.

As a Solutions Architect, you will be the first line of technical expertise between NVIDIA, our AI consulting partners and our end-customers. Your duties will vary from creating pilots, demos and MvPs, to building relationships with key technical teams to evangelize accelerated computing and Agentic AI. Dynamically engaging with developers, researchers, data scientists, IT managers and senior leaders is a meaningful part of the Solutions Architect role, to identify challenges and create solutions.

What You'll be Doing:

  • Becoming an expert and enabling GSI developers to adopt NVIDIA Agent Toolkit, Nemotron and NIM for their AI offerings, platforms and client services.

  • Construct complex AI agent workflows to analyse, strategise, perform tasks, access APIs, and fix errors autonomously.

  • Work with Partner Business Managers to thoughtfully craft actionable and effective strategies for the partnerships/alliances.

  • Closely partner with other Solutions Architects, engineering, product and business teams at NVIDIA to build AI full stack solutions for industry vertical and enterprise use cases.

  • Encourage industry executives and GSI leaders by articulating the business value of state-of-the-art AI solutions.

What We Need to See:

  • BS, MS, or PhD in Computer Science, Electrical/Computer Engineering, Physics, Mathematics, other Engineering or related fields (or equivalent experience)

  • 5+ overall years in deep learning, data science or software development with knowledge of parallel computing with GPUs

  • Strong development expertise building RAG pipelines and Agentic AI applications.

  • Developer background with LangChain and LangGraph orchestrating LLMs

  • Clear written and oral communication skills with the ability to collaborate with management and engineering. Share knowledge with clients, partners and co-workers.

  • Excellent ability to listen understand and answer, asking questions and being comfortable with presenting visionary technical solutions in English

Ways to Stand Out from The Crowd:

  • Prior experience working with technical teams across multiple external stakeholders

  • Working proficiency with Orchestration platforms like Kubernetes and datacenter including compute, storage, and networking.

  • Expertise in NVIDIA platform-based development using Nemo and NIM, ML/DL frameworks and MLOps ecosystem of tools and solutions in the cloud and on-prem.

  • Background in cloud-based solution designing, APIs and Microservices, orchestration platforms, storage solutions and data migration techniques

  • Curiosity to dig into unfamiliar territories to tackle sophisticated problems and be a phenomenal listener.

raw.excerpt: Senior Competitive & Market Intelligence ManagerWEKA is the AI data and memory infrastructure company transforming how organizations build, run, and scale AI.
raw.description:
Senior Competitive & Market Intelligence Manager

WEKA is the AI data and memory infrastructure company transforming how organizations build, run, and scale AI. NeuralMesh™ combines high-performance data storage and extended GPU memory in a single software platform, providing a foundation for training, inference, and agentic AI workloads that maximizes GPU productivity, accelerates AI outcomes, and improves the economics of AI at scale.

WEKA is a pre-IPO, growth-stage company backed by world-class venture capital investors and AI infrastructure leaders. Our technology is trusted by 30% of the Fortune 50, as well as leading hyperscalers, neoclouds, AI builders, and research organizations. Our team is customer-obsessed, accountable, bold, and collaborative, with a shared focus on helping customers succeed. If we sound like your kind of people, join us!

About The Role

We are seeking a Senior Competitive & Market Intelligence Manager to build and lead the intelligence capability that helps us understand where the market is going, how competitors are evolving, where WEKA has the right to win, and what we need to do about it.

This is a technical, hands-on builder role. You will design and scale the systems, tools, operating rhythms, and feedback loops that turn fragmented competitive, customer, field, and market signals into a trusted intelligence engine for the company. You'll go deep on competitors and market dynamics, develop clear points of view, and translate what you learn into positioning, competitive deal strategies, field tools, technical briefs, training decks, product insights, and recommendations that help WEKA stay ahead in a fast-moving AI infrastructure market.

Reporting to the VP of Product Marketing, you'll work closely with Product, Sales, Solutions Engineering, Marketing, Alliances, GTM Operations, and executive leadership. You'll serve as a trusted source of intelligence across the company, helping teams understand not simply what is changing, but what it means for WEKA and what we should do next.

Who We’re Looking For

You're a senior builder. You've created or materially scaled a competitive or market intelligence capability before, and you understand everything required to make it work: sources, tools, processes, field feedback loops, operating cadence, executive communication, enablement, and measurement. You're comfortable starting with a blank page, deciding what matters, and building a system people actually trust and use.

You're intellectually curious, analytical, and technical enough to go well beyond competitor websites and marketing claims. You can dig into products, architectures, benchmarks, customer experiences, business models, and go-to-market strategies, separate signal from noise, and develop a defensible point of view about where competitors are strong, where they're vulnerable, and where the market is headed.

You also know intelligence only matters if it changes decisions and outcomes. You can turn deep research into a concise executive recommendation, a sharp competitive position, or a field tool a seller can use in a live deal. You stay close to Sales, Product, customers, and the market, and measure success by better decisions and stronger competitive performance, not the volume of research produced.

What You’ll Be Working On

  • Build the Intelligence Engine: Design and scale WEKA's competitive and market intelligence program, including sources, tooling, workflows, taxonomy, operating cadence, governance, distribution, and feedback loops. Create a trusted system of record that stays current as the market evolves.
  • Own Competitive Intelligence: Develop deep intelligence on priority competitors across products, architecture, performance, positioning, customers, partnerships, business models, and go-to-market strategy. Identify strengths, vulnerabilities, strategic moves, and likely next steps.
  • Monitor Competitive Pricing & Packaging: Track competitor pricing, packaging, licensing, consumption models, and commercial changes, and surface meaningful shifts to Product and other stakeholders to inform pricing and packaging decisions.
  • Drive Market Intelligence: Track the forces reshaping AI infrastructure, including technology shifts, market structure, customer requirements, emerging categories and competitors, cloud and neocloud dynamics, ecosystem moves, business models, and buying patterns. Translate those signals into implications and opportunities for WEKA.
  • Turn Intelligence Into Strategy: Synthesize competitive, market, customer, and field signals into clear points of view and actionable recommendations that inform company positioning, product strategy, go-to-market priorities, category strategy, and where WEKA should invest, defend, or differentiate.
  • Create Competitive Positioning & Tools: Develop and continuously improve competitive positioning, battlecards, playbooks, objection handling, comparison frameworks, executive briefs, and other tools that help Sales, Solutions Engineering, partners, and Marketing differentiate WEKA and win.
  • Build the Field Intelligence Loop: Establish scalable ways to capture what sellers, SEs, partners, prospects, and customers are seeing in the market. Partner with Sales and GTM Operations to turn competitive deal data, field feedback, and win/loss insights into intelligence that improves positioning, enablement, and strategy.
  • Support Competitive Deals: Engage directly with Sales and Solutions Engineering on strategic competitive opportunities, helping teams understand the competitor, sharpen the strategy, respond to claims, and apply what is learned back into the broader intelligence program.
  • Deliver Executive Intelligence: Establish a consistent cadence of concise, decision-oriented competitive and market briefings for Product, GTM, and executive leadership, surfacing meaningful changes, emerging threats and opportunities, and recommended actions.
  • Apply AI & Automation: Use AI, automation, and modern intelligence tools to continuously monitor market signals, accelerate research and synthesis, and deliver intelligence in the workflows where teams need it. Apply strong judgment to ensure automation increases signal rather than noise.
  • Influence Product & Marketing: Partner closely with Product and Product Marketing to bring competitive and market insights into roadmap discussions, positioning and messaging, launches, category strategy, campaigns, and thought leadership.
  • Leverage Analyst & Industry Insights: Work with Analyst Relations and other external intelligence sources to incorporate analyst research, industry perspectives, market data, and third-party validation into WEKA's view of the market and competitive landscape.
  • Measure Impact: Establish practical measures of success including intelligence adoption, field engagement, competitive win/loss trends, effectiveness of competitive plays, and demonstrated influence on product, positioning, and GTM decisions.

Qualifications

  • 6+ years of experience in competitive intelligence, market intelligence, product marketing, product strategy, management consulting, industry research, or a closely related role in enterprise technology.
  • Demonstrated experience personally building or materially scaling a competitive or market intelligence program, including the systems, tools, processes, operating cadence, and feedback loops required to make it sustainable. What We Can Achieve Together:

In this newly created role, the Global Teams Recruiting Lead will execute the strategy and recruitment processes for our general recruiting efforts within the Global Teams which consist of our Chief Conservation Office, Global Science, Protect Oceans Land and Waters, Provide Food & Water Sustainability, Tackle Climate Change, Global Oceans, as well as Impact Finance and Markets, Policy And Public Funding. They will lead a small group of recruiters, as well as consistently manage their own set of mid-level recruitments. They will develop a pipeline of potential talent, network and collaboratively engage recruiting partners globally to ensure best and emerging practices to create a unified approach to talent acquisition at The Nature Conservancy. This role will be a member of the Talent Acquisition team and an integral part of the Global Team as they work to provide subject matter expertise to meet our hiring goals and create a positive experience for candidates. This role will manage large projects and play a significant role in stabilizing and optimizing our newly implemented Applicant Tracking System and Candidate Relationship Management system.

This is a Remote Role that will require flexibility in schedule to reach across global time zones. Preferred location in United Kingdom.

We’re Looking for You:

This is an exciting opportunity to join our Talent Acquisition team and support our mission by finding the next great talent to help us save our planet!

We’re looking for someone who is a great leader of people who can also roll up their sleeves and manage their own requisition load. A change agent who can influence and advise senior leaders on our hiring processes to support our ambitious 2030 goals. A key partner that can collectively build our values based, culturally mosaic, and mission driven workforce. An analytical thinker who leverages technology and stays on top of market trends to deliver world class experience to our candidates and hiring managers. We are looking for you to bring innovative ideas to build and implement effective, proactive, and efficient recruitment strategies and processes to address the talent for all non-term-limited mid-level positions while ensuring best practices are being followed.

What You’ll Bring:

  • Bachelor’s degree and 6 years HR related experience in HR/Talent Acquisition or equivalent combination.

  • Experience as a manager of a recruiting function or team; managing remotely a plus.

  • Leadership experience in building a program area, motivating, developing, and engaging team members toward a shared vision and goals

  • Experience working with senior leaders to develop and implement Talent Acquisition strategies and initiatives

  • Experience communicating and developing relationships with a broad range of audiences including experience working with or recruiting for global teams.

  • As this is a global role; multi-lingual skills and multi-cultural or cross-cultural experience appreciated.

  • Experience working with an Applicant Tracking System producing reports, data manipulation, analysis, and recommending process flow efficiencies and enhancements.

  • Experience leading recruiters while actively managing and closing your own searches.

  • Experience leading projects and coordinating the work of others

  • Experience with prioritizing and organizing work while attending to details.

  • Excellent interpersonal skills, strong client service orientation and client centric mindset

  • Experience using MS Office software

  • Must be willing and able to travel outside of the US.

Salary Information

This position may be based in any country where TNC has an established entity, taking into consideration legal restrictions, such as non-national ratios and immigration processing times. For U.S. based applicants only, the starting pay range for this position is generally within the range of $112,000-137,000 for annual base salary and is based on location, qualifications, specific skills, and experience. This range only applies to candidates whose country of employment is the USA. For all other applicants, pay ranges will be in local currency, the pay range will be based on the local labor market, and not tied to the above pay range. Your geographic location will be confirmed during the recruitment and used to determine your actual pay range. Additionally, for all applicants, actual pay will fall within a range based on a variety of factors including, for example, the candidate's qualifications, specific skills and experience.

Who We Are:

The Nature Conservancy’s mission is to protect the lands and waters upon which all life depends. As a science-based organization, we create innovative, on-the-ground solutions to our world’s toughest challenges so that we can create a world in which people and nature thrive. We’re rooted in our mission and guided by our values, which include respect for all people, communities, and cultures. Whether it’s career development, flexible schedules, or a rewarding mission, there’s many reasons to love life inside TNC. Want a better insight to TNC? Check out our TNC Talent playlist on YouTube to hear stories from staff or visit Glassdoor.

One goal is to cultivate an inclusive work environment so that all our colleagues around the globe feel a sense of belonging and that their unique contributions to our mission are valued. In addition to the requirements in our job postings, we recognize that people come with talent and experiences outside of a job and consider each applicant’s unique experience. Please apply – we’d love to hear from you. To quote a popular saying at TNC, “you’ll join for the mission, and stay for the people.”

What We Bring:

Since 1951, TNC has been doing work you can believe in. Through grassroots action, we have grown from a small non-profit into one of the most effective and wide-reaching environmental organizations in the world. Thanks to more than 1 million members, over 400 scientists, and the dedicated efforts of our diverse staff and partners, we impact conservation around the world!

TNC offers competitive and comprehensive benefits packages tailored to the individual countries where we work. These may include health care benefits, retirement benefits, parental leave, paid time off, life insurance, and disability coverage as well as an employee assistance program and other life and well-being benefits. Learn more about our Benefits and Perks here.

We’re proud to offer a flexible work environment that supports the health and well-being of the people we employ.

Our recruiting process includes a rolling interview process to ensure we engage applicants in a timely manner. This means we may review applications in the order in which they are received. Once a strong candidate pool is identified, the role will be unposted. The timeline may vary depending on the expressed interest in the role, so we highly encourage candidates to apply as soon as possible.

Employees must submit their application by logging into Workday and applying via the Jobs Hub.

The Nature Conservancy is an Equal Opportunity Employer.Our commitment to equal employment opportunity includes the recognition that our conservation mission is best advanced by the leadership and contributions of people of all backgrounds, beliefs, and culture. Recruiting and mentoring staff to create an inclusive organization is a priority, and we encourage applicants from all cultures, races, colors, religions, sexes, national or regional origins, ages, disability status, sexual orientation, gender identity, military, protected veteran status or other status protected by law.

The successful applicant must meet the requirements of The Nature Conservancy's background screening process.

TNC is committed to offering accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application process. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, please send a note to with Request for Accommodation in the subject line.
