Equifax’s US Information Solutions (USIS) business unit is seeking a strategic Account Executive - Digital Advertising Channel Partnerships to join our Data-Driven Marketing sales team. The USIS business unit transforms massive consumer and commercial datasets into actionable consumer and commercial risk, identity and fraud, and marketing insights that create a competitive advantage for our customers and open new opportunities.

The Data-Driven Marketing team is responsible for solutions that leverage data insights and solutions to attract the right new customers, deliver a positive experience, and deepen existing relationships. From precise audience segmentation to data-driven growth strategy, Equifax helps businesses reach consumers with the right financial profile for products and services.

As an Account Executive - Digital Advertising Channel Partnerships, you will drive revenue growth by consulting with businesses in this industry, helping them leverage our unique blend of differentiated data assets and advanced analytics capabilities. This is a client-facing, high-touch, sales role responsible for revenue generation, customer relationship and Equifax engagement within highly complex, strategic accounts. AEs have primary responsibility for their clients, and must orchestrate other Equifax resources efficiently to drive sales and revenue growth of a full solutions portfolio.

An ideal candidate will have expertise with consumer marketing data, experience working in AdTech and digital media, and strong direct and partner sales acumen. They will be tasked with protecting existing revenue as well as growing new business.

What you will do

  • Drive Strategic Growth: Own the end-to-end sales cycle to identify, pipeline, and close net-new opportunities while aggressively protecting and growing existing revenue across complex digital advertising and AdTech channel partners.
  • Act as a Trusted Advisor: Consult deeply with clients to understand their business imperatives, embedding Equifax’s differentiated consumer marketing data and identity solutions into their digital ecosystems.
  • Orchestrate Deal Execution: Lead cross-functional Equifax teams—including pre-sales, solutions, and delivery—to seamlessly execute complex, multi-solution deals and drive maximum customer value.
  • Own Account Strategy: Develop and execute comprehensive account plans that align your clients' digital growth strategies with Equifax’s advanced analytics capabilities.
  • Navigate the C-Suite: Build and maintain high-trust, strategic relationships with economic buyers, decision-makers, and key influencers within your partner accounts.
  • Prove ROI: Prepare and conduct compelling quarterly business reviews (QBRs) that demonstrate tangible value, anticipate future needs, and position optimal Equifax solutions.
  • Manage the Business: Oversee complex pricing negotiations, contracting processes, and ongoing contract compliance to ensure profitable, sustainable partnerships.

What experience you need

  • Education: Bachelor’s degree from an accredited university or equivalent work experience.
  • Proven Sales Excellence: 7–10 years of experience consistently meeting or exceeding quota in an Enterprise Account Executive, Channel Partnership, or Senior Business Development role.
  • Deep AdTech Fluency: Strong industry expertise in the MarTech and digital media ecosystems, with a deep understanding of programmatic advertising, identity resolution, consumer graphs, and broader digital marketing channels (SEO, SEM, social, display).
  • Technical Acumen: High proficiency navigating complex digital tools, including CRM systems (e.g., Salesforce), marketing automation platforms, and data analytics dashboards.
  • Executive Presence: Demonstrated ability to build relationships, present compelling data-driven value propositions, and negotiate complex agreements with C-level stakeholders.
  • Strategic Agility: A highly adaptable mindset with the ability to stay ahead of the rapidly evolving advertising landscape, learning new technologies and pivoting sales strategies as market trends shift.

What would set you apart

  • Product Knowledge (Marketing Data): Proven experience directly selling complex consumer or business marketing data. You understand how to position highly targeted datasets—such as SKU-level consumer purchasing data, B2B firmographics, or advanced audience segments—to drive campaign ROI.
  • Relentless "Hunter" DNA: You are a notoriously resilient, proactive, and consultative seller. You don't just manage accounts; you aggressively hunt for new revenue streams, scale partnerships, and thrive in a high-performance, quota-driven environment.
  • Omnichannel Fluency: A strong understanding of how data flows across diverse advertising formats, from Connected TV (e.g., Madhive), streaming audio (e.g., Pandora/SiriusXM), and native/programmatic (e.g., OpenX, Pubmatic, Taboola) to digital out-of-home (OOH) partners (e.g., Outfront Media, Lamar Advertising).
  • Elite Media or AdTech Pedigree: Previous experience working at a major media agency holding company or a premier AdTech platform/partner.

Equifax is required by law to include a good-faith salary range for this role. This compensation range takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to: skill sets; experience and training; and other business and organizational needs. At Equifax, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role. A reasonable estimate of the current base salary range is $117,110.00 to $160,000.00. raw.description:
We're transforming the grocery industry

At Instacart, we invite the world to share love through food because we believe everyone should have access to the food they love and more time to enjoy it together. Where others see a simple need for grocery delivery, we see exciting complexity and endless opportunity to serve the varied needs of our community. We work to deliver an essential service that customers rely on to get their groceries and household goods, while also offering safe and flexible earnings opportunities to Instacart Personal Shoppers.

Instacart has become a lifeline for millions of people, and we’re building the team to help push our shopping cart forward. If you’re ready to do the best work of your life, come join our table.

Instacart is a Flex First team

There’s no one-size fits all approach to how we do our best work. Our employees have the flexibility to choose where they do their best work—whether it’s from home, an office, or your favorite coffee shop—while staying connected and building community through regular in-person events. Learn more about our flexible approach to where we work.

Overview

Our backend systems power the clients used by millions of customers every year to buy their groceries online. These systems must also support tight integration with the largest retailers in the US and Canada. Engineering at Instacart provides the opportunity to work on challenging scaling problems while also designing the features that will define our industry. You will learn how to build in an open collaborative environment serving millions of requests daily.

Finance data engineering is part of the Data Infrastructure team, working closely with accounting, billing & revenue teams to support the monthly/quarterly book close, retailer invoicing and internal/external financial reporting. The team plays a critical role in defining how financial data is modeled and standardized for uniform, reliable, timely and accurate reporting. This is a high impact, high visibility role owning critical data integration pipelines and models across all of Instacart's products.

The team is still small and many of our bigger initiatives are at an early stage. We expect you to work closely with stakeholders and shape these systems from design, technical decisions, project management to execution. Your input will be critical for driving the Finance Data Strategy and building the platform that Instacart's financial data infrastructure will be built upon.

About the Job

  • You will work closely with finance, accounting, billing, and revenue teams to understand their main pain points and translate them into self-serve, reliable, and scalable data solutions.
  • You are expected to mentor other team members and be a champion of engineering excellence across the organization.
  • You will be part of a small team with a large amount of ownership and autonomy, managing initiatives directly from design through execution.
  • You will have the freedom to suggest and drive organization-wide initiatives that shape the financial data vision and roadmap.
  • You will own critical data integration pipelines and models, ensuring uniform, reliable, timely, and accurate financial reporting.

About You

Minimum Qualifications

  • 8+ years of working experience in a Data/Software Engineering role, with a focus on building data pipelines (specialized in financial data).
  • Strong knowledge of cloud based warehouses like Snowflake, Redshift, BigQuery.
  • Strong knowledge of common data infra technologies (Python, Airflow, Spark, Iceberg, Delta Lake) in a production environment.
  • Expert in data modeling with experience in modeling complex financial data with scalability and usability in mind.
  • Expert with SQL and dbt (Data Build Tool).
  • Experience building high quality and complex ETL/ELT pipelines including pipelines for accounting/billing purposes.
  • Experience with data immutability, auditability, slowly changing dimensions or similar concepts.
  • Adept at fluently communicating with many cross-functional stakeholders to drive requirements and design shared datasets.
  • An ability to balance a sense of urgency with shipping high quality and pragmatic solutions.
  • Experience working with a large codebase on a cross functional team.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, computer engineering, electrical engineering or equivalent work experience.
  • Experience with Snowflake, dbt (Data Build Tool) and Airflow.
  • Experience with SOX controlled data systems.

We partner with educational institutions to deliver impactful mental health and wellbeing solutions that improve student outcomes, campus culture, and long-term success.

This is an opportunity to contribute to a mission-driven organization creating measurable social impact while helping shape the future of student wellness in India.

We are seeking a highly connected and entrepreneurial Fractional Senior Consultant role to expand Sukoon's presence across private universities and higher education institutions in India.

The ideal candidate will have experience engaging senior leadership within educational institutions and a proven ability to open doors, build executive relationships, and generate qualified opportunities.

This role is focused on identifying, qualifying, and advancing conversations with decision-makers including Vice Chancellors, Chancellors, Founders, Trustees, and Institutional Owners.

Business Development & Lead Generation

  • Proactively identify and engage private universities, colleges, and educational institutions across India.

  • Develop and maintain a qualified pipeline of prospective institutional partners.
  • Map key stakeholders and decision-makers within target institutions.

Executive Relationship Building

Establish relationships with:

  • Vice Chancellors
  • Chancellors
  • Founders and Owners
  • Governing Board Members
  • Registrars
  • Deans and Academic Leadership
  • Student Affairs and Wellness Leaders

Secure meetings and presentations with individuals who possess budgetary authority and purchasing decision-making responsibility.

Sales & Solution Consulting

  • Conduct discovery conversations to understand institutional challenges related to student wellbeing and mental health.
  • Support proposal discussions and commercial negotiations alongside Sukoon leadership.
  • Effectively articulate Sukoon's mission, value proposition, and impact outcomes.

Pipeline Management

- Maintain detailed records of outreach activities, meetings, and opportunity progress.

- Provide weekly updates on:

  • Outreach efforts
  • Meetings conducted
  • Pipeline status
  • Conversion progress
  • Risks and opportunities

- Work closely with Sukoon leadership to refine target account strategies and improve conversion rates.

Market Intelligence

  • Monitor student wellness initiatives, accreditation requirements, and institutional priorities.
  • Share competitive and market insights that can strengthen Sukoon's positioning and go-to-market strategy.

Performance Expectations

The consultant will be expected to achieve the following minimum monthly outcomes:

Lead Generation

Generate 5 qualified institutional opportunities per month.

Decision-Maker Access

Arrange 4 qualified meetings per month with senior institutional stakeholders.

Executive Meetings

Secure at least 1 meeting every week with a Chancellor, Vice Chancellor, Founder, Owner, Trustee, or equivalent decision-maker with purchasing authority.

Activity Reporting

Participate in a weekly business review with Sukoon leadership and share progress against targets.

Success Metrics

  • Number of qualified opportunities generated
  • Access to key decision-makers
  • Quality of stakeholder relationships
  • Meeting-to-proposal conversion rates
  • Proposal-to-contract conversion rates

Compensation Structure

Fixed Component

Monthly retainer (to be mutually agreed).

Performance Incentives

5% of the contract value upon successful contract execution/signing, payable when the first payment >=10% is received from the client as a deal activation incentive.

Illustrative Example

If a university signs a contract worth ₹100,00,000:

Contract Signing Incentive (5%): ₹5,00,000

This model is designed to reward consultants who successfully generate and enable connects that convert into high-quality institutional partnerships.

To give a perspective Sukoon’s typical deal size is 2-3Cr. Because in the early phase we are targeting institutions >5000 students only and average contract value is 2.5 Cr.

Experience

Skills

  • Strong executive presence and communication skills.
  • Ability to engage C-level and senior academic leadership.
  • Excellent consultative selling and presentation skills.
  • Strong networking and relationship-building capabilities.
  • Ability to work independently and drive outcomes in a fractional capacity.

Preferred Network

Existing relationships within:

  • Private Universities
  • Deemed Universities
  • Medical Colleges
  • Law Universities
  • Engineering Institutions
  • Educational Trusts
  • University Governing Bodies

Benefits

Why Join Sukoon?

raw.description:
Senior Brand Manager - Beauty

ABOUT NEATO

Neato is a 2P eCommerce accelerator based in Las Vegas. We buy inventory from established brands and operate as their exclusive online retailer across every major channel — Amazon, TikTok Shop, DTC, and Walmart — all fulfilled from a single inventory pool. Unlike agencies that get paid whether you grow or not, we make money when we sell your product. When we don't, we eat it. Every decision we make is backed by our own capital.

ABOUT THE ROLE

The Senior Brand Manager owns the profit and loss of a beauty portfolio inside that model. You are the one person accountable for contribution margin — the number that says whether the brand is worth Neato's capital every week. You set the price, protect the buy box, keep the shelves in stock, run the promotional calendar, chase the reimbursements, and answer for the result.

WHAT YOU'LL OWN

✓ Availability — in-stock rate on every ASIN, every day. You set the reorder cadence with Supply Chain and own stockouts before they happen.

✓ Price & margin — every price on every channel. Buy box protection. MAP enforcement. Margin defense when algorithms move against you.

✓ Merchandising, assortment, conversion — detail pages, A+ content, video, imagery, reviews, variations. Anything a shopper sees is your surface.

✓ Profit recovery — billbacks, reimbursements, chargebacks, shortage claims. Money left on the table is money you're accountable for.

✓ Marketplace control — unauthorized sellers, MAP violators, counterfeits. You quarterback the enforcement plan with Legal and the brand.

✓ Demand generation — ad strategy, Vine, PPC, DSP, external traffic. You set the plan; the Ads team executes; you own the ROAS.

✓ Promotion & subscription — promo calendar, deal cadence, Subscribe & Save base growth. Every promo has a P&L before it runs.

✓ Brand partnership — you are the face Neato shows the brand. Weekly reviews, quarterly strategy, joint planning. When the brand escalates, they call you first.

HOW SUCCESS IS MEASURED

✓ Portfolio contribution margin — trend and absolute.

✓ In-stock rate — across the assortment.

✓ Buy box ownership rate — on 1P and 3P.

✓ Subscribe & Save base growth — month over month.

✓ Reimbursement dollars recovered — against opportunity.

✓ Brand partner NPS — they renew or they don't.

WHAT YOU BRING

✓ 7–10+ years operating a beauty CPG brand's P&L — direct Amazon 1P and 3P operating experience, not agency-adjacent.

✓ Weekly numbers cadence — you read the P&L to peers every week without notes.

✓ Reimbursement fluency — you know what Amazon owes you and how to collect it.

✓ MAP enforcement experience — across marketplaces.

✓ Contribution-margin literacy — you can defend a promo or a price change to a CFO.

✓ Bias to action — over meetings and decks.

NICE TO HAVE

★ TikTok Shop, DTC, Walmart — hands-on experience, or fast to learn.

WHY YOU'LL WANT THIS

This is a true P&L seat, not a coordination role — you set price, own the promo calendar, and answer directly for contribution margin, with performance-linked upside tied to the result. You partner daily with Supply Chain, Creative, Ads, and Finance, and you're the person the brand calls first when it matters.

Neato · 2026 · Equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

Salary: $130k-$170k DOE

Equifax is where you can power your possible. If you want to achieve your true potential, chart new paths, develop new skills, collaborate with bright minds, and make a meaningful impact, we want to hear from you.

We are seeking a dynamic, strategic, and results-driven Partner Success Manager to join our growing team. In this role, you will be responsible for managing and growing a dedicated book of business composed of strategic partners. Operating within both enterprise voluntary benefits or B2B2C frameworks, you will act as a trusted advisor to our partners, ensuring they are fully equipped to drive the sales and adoption of our products to the end consumer.

The ideal candidate will have a deep understanding of channel ecosystems—specifically affiliate, reseller, and referral partnerships—and a proven track record of managing product demos, delivering impactful training, driving pipeline growth, and securing high retention and renewal rates. Experience in the identity theft protection space or with consumer-facing software products is highly desirable.

What You'll Do:

High-Stakes Commercial & Launch Readiness

  • Own the operational readiness strategy for incoming major accounts, aligning Marketing, Product, and Sales Operations teams. Align with partner executives to ensure programmatic health, robust joint business plans, coordinated go-to-market and secure long-term commitment.

  • Establish immediate operational ownership over newly signed enterprise partnerships (to eliminate the delays or disappointment in the crucial post-signature period) to ensure timely Revenue Starts and ACV attainment

  • Manage complex commercial conversations with partners as sales motions evolve with our joint go-to-market, and we manage crawl-walk-run phases

ACV maximization

  • Collaboratively manage partner sales pipelines. Work alongside partners to identify new opportunities, develop successful sales strategies, and optimize conversion tactics to increase overall win rates.

  • Partner closely with Business Development (BD), IDW Product Management and EWS more broadly to map out expansion roadmaps, systematically identifying opportunities to cross-sell and upsell new features and products into established partner portfolios.

  • Nurture and grow existing products to different parts of the partner organizations to expand single-point relationships into multi-channel ecosystems that solve for the partner's evolving business needs.

Strategic Governance & Executive Alignment

  • Define, schedule, and lead recurring Joint Steering Committees and Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs) with partners and key internal stakeholders.

  • Serve as the contact for Finance to monitor ACV ramp, build forecasts and communicate overall pipeline health.

  • Identify and facilitate multi-tiered relationships between EFX’s executives and the partners’ C-suite, including joint meetings and networking opportunities.

Sales Enablement Playbook Development & Evolution

  • Spearhead the creation, roll-out, and continuous evolution of channel-specific sales playbooks, competitive battlecards, and go-to-market (GTM) toolkits.

  • Ensure partner sales forces are equipped with the exact conversion tactics needed to drive immediate end-consumer adoption and velocity.

  • Collaborate with Marketing and Sales to ensure appropriate sharing of marketing materials, collateral, thought leadership and joint outreach to prospects.

What Experience You Need:

  • 5+ years of experience in Partner Success, Account Management, or Channel Sales, preferably within a SaaS or technology environment.

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Communications, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience).

  • Prior experience working with B2B2C or Voluntary Benefit business models for enterprise-sized employers is essential.

  • Experience in identity theft protection, cybersecurity, privacy, or consumer-facing digital products is a significant plus.

  • Deep understanding of and hands-on experience managing affiliate, reseller, and referral partnership frameworks.

  • Proven ability to deliver compelling product demos and technical presentations to both executive stakeholders and frontline sales teams.

  • Strong understanding of sales cycles, pipeline development, CRM tools (e.g., Salesforce, HubSpot), and forecasting.

  • Exceptional communication, negotiation, and relationship-management skills, with a proven ability to secure renewals and handle difficult commercial conversations.

We offer comprehensive compensation and healthcare packages, 401k matching, paid time off, and organizational growth potential through our online learning platform with guided career tracks.

Are you ready to power your possible? Apply today, and get started on a path toward an exciting new career at Equifax, where you can make a difference!

Job Description Summary

GE Aerospace’s Propulsion and Additive Technologies (P&AT) Contracts Organization is seeking an experienced Senior Contracts Manager This role manages a mixed portfolio spanning civil and U.S. Government contracts. The Senior Contracts Manager will oversee the full contract lifecycle—from proposal strategy and negotiation through award, execution, and sustainment—serving as a trusted advisor to the business on customer relationships, regulatory compliance, contract terms, negotiation strategy, and scope management.
In this role, you will work across multiple business units and product lines spanning international and U.S. domestic operations, balancing near-term deliverables with long-term program goals. Success requires strong proficiency in managing diverse contract types—including complex development, production, non-disclosure, and sustainment contracts—for both civil and military/government customers, as well as comfort navigating cross-border business practices and regulatory frameworks.
**This role is location-flexible, but working hours must align with Eastern Time business hours**

Job Description

Roles and Responsibilities

  • Serve as a contracts subject matter expert supporting all phases of the program lifecycle—proposal, negotiation, award, and post-award execution—including managing commercial issues, customer relationships, change management, claims, and disputes.
  • Act as the primary point of contact between GE Aerospace and its civil and government customers on all contractual matters, including contract interpretation and dispute resolution.
  • Provide end-to-end contract administration for assigned proposals and contracts, including drafting and reviewing contract terms and conditions, leading negotiations, and advising internal stakeholders on contract risk and compliance.
  • Serve as a liaison with internal functional owners—including finance, program management, engineering, sales, and legal—to align contractual commitments with program execution.
  • Guide proposal teams through solicitation assessment, including FAR/DFARS compliance, export control considerations (ITAR/EAR), and other business, legal, and compliance risks, and develop mitigation strategies.
  • Monitor contract compliance throughout the contract lifecycle, ensuring performance obligations, deliverables, and reporting requirements are met.
  • Participate in special projects as assigned, including process improvement initiatives across the contracts organizations.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree or higher from an accredited institution; a Juris Doctor or advanced degree in business, contract management, or a related field is a plus.
  • 6+ years of experience in contract formation and execution across civil, U.S. Government, and international contracting environments.
  • Demonstrated expertise in the Federal Acquisition Regulation (FAR), with particular emphasis on Part 12 (Acquisition of Commercial Items) and Part 15 (Contracting by Negotiation), as well as the Defense Federal Acquisition Regulation Supplement (DFARS) and applicable export control regulations (ITAR/EAR).

Desired Characteristics

  • Experience negotiating and drafting contracts for both civil/commercial and U.S. Government military customers.
  • Experience briefing stakeholders, including cross-functional team members and functional leadership, on contract status, risk, and compliance matters.
  • Ability to work effectively across international and domestic business contexts, including time zone coordination and cross-cultural business practices.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead negotiations on high-value or high-risk contracts.
  • Ability to work independently and cohesively with teams.
  • Prior experience as a U.S. Government contracting officer or in a similar military/government contracting role.
  • Demonstrated ability to analyze and resolve problems.
  • Strong interpersonal skills with ability to build relationships within GE Aerospace.
  • Ability to manage projects/assignments within tight deadlines
  • Continuous Improvement: Advocate for Flight Deck fundamentals and a lean mindset, leveraging digital tools and rigorous contracting practices to improve efficiency, quality of execution, and internal/external customer satisfaction.

The base pay range for this position is $131,000 - $145,000. The specific pay offered may be influenced by a variety of factors, including the candidate’s experience, education, and skill set. This position is also eligible for an annual discretionary bonus based on a percentage of your base salary/ commission based on the plan. This posting is expected to close on September 4th, 2026.

GE Aerospace offers comprehensive benefits and programs to support your health and, along with programs like HealthAhead, your physical, emotional, financial and social wellbeing. Healthcare benefits include medical, dental, vision, and prescription drug coverage; access to a Health Coach from GE Aerospace; and the Employee Assistance Program, which provides 24/7 confidential assessment, counseling and referral services. Retirement benefits include the GE Aerospace Retirement Savings Plan, a 401(k) savings plan with company matching contributions and company retirement contributions, as well as access to Fidelity resources and planning consultants.

Other benefits include tuition assistance, adoption assistance, paid parental leave, disability insurance, life insurance, and paid time-off for vacation or illness. GE Aerospace.

This role will require in-person attendance for New Hire Orientation on Day 1.

This role requires access to U.S. export-controlled information. Therefore, employment will be contingent upon the ability to prove that you meet the status of a U.S. Person as one of the following: U.S. lawful permanent resident, U.S. Citizen, have been granted asylee or refugee status (i.e., a protected individual under the Immigration and Naturalization Act, 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3)).

raw.description:
Vulnerability Management Analyst

North - Remote

North is seeking a detail-oriented Vulnerability Management Analyst to join our Cybersecurity team. In this role, you will help protect our payment processing platform, cloud environments, and internal infrastructure by identifying, analyzing, and prioritizing technical vulnerabilities.

Working closely with engineering, cloud infrastructure, and IT teams, you will leverage enterprise security tools (such as Wiz and Tenable) to track risk and diplomatically advocate for timely remediation. This role is ideal for an early-to-mid career cybersecurity professional with strong analytical and interpersonal skills who enjoys turning security data into actionable fixes.

What you'll do:

  • Vulnerability Identification & Scanning: Operate, maintain, and assist in configuring scanning platforms (Wiz, Tenable) across cloud assets, containers, data centers, network infrastructure, and endpoints.

  • Analysis & Prioritization:Review vulnerability data, reduce false positives, and prioritize risks based on business context, CVSS scores, threat intelligence, and payment industry risk factors.

  • Remediation Advocacy: Act as a liaison to engineering, IT, and operations teams to champion patching initiatives, explain technical risks, and follow up on overdue SLAs.

  • Tracking & Metrics:Track remediation progress, communicate risk posture to leadership, and maintain dashboards, reports, and key performance indicators (KPIs).

  • Compliance Support:Support security audit and compliance efforts (such as PCI-DSS) by providing evidence of regular vulnerability scanning and remediation.

  • Continuous Improvement:Refine vulnerability management processes, playbooks, and automated workflows to reduce exposure windows.

What we need from you:

Education and Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in Cybersecurity, Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related technical field (or equivalent practical experience).

  • 3 years of hands-on experience in cybersecurity, IT, system administration, or risk management.

  • Hands-on experience operating enterprise scanning platforms, specifically Wiz and Tenable.

Knowledge, Skills & Abilities

  • Core Vulnerability Concepts:Solid understanding of the vulnerability management lifecycle, Common Vulnerabilities and Exposures (CVEs), CVSS scoring, and common attack vectors and vulnerability exploitation.

  • Tooling Familiarity: Exposure to enterprise scanner technologies (Tenable) and cloud security/exposure management tools (Wiz).

  • Analytical Mindset:Ability to analyze large datasets of vulnerability scans, identify trends, and translate raw data into clear, actionable reporting.

  • Interpersonal & Communication Skills: Excellent verbal and written communication skills while building relationships across teams and encouraging patch completion.

  • Technical Foundations: Understanding of core OS concepts (Windows, Linux), cloud security fundamentals (AWS, Azure, or GCP), and enterprise networking.

How to stand out (Preferred):

  • 5 years of relevant or hands-on experience in cybersecurity, IT, system administration, or risk management

  • Experience within fintech, payment processing, or another highly regulated, fast-paced environment.

  • Familiarity with payment industry standards and security frameworks (PCI-DSS, NIST Cybersecurity Framework, CIS Benchmarks).

  • Experience using ticketing and project tracking tools such as Jira to track vulnerability work items.

  • Basic scripting knowledge (Python, PowerShell, Bash, or API queries) to automate reporting or routine tasks.

  • Certifications such as CompTIA Security+, Network+, or eJPT are a plus, but not required.

Salary range: $70,000-$110,000

Pay within this range varies by work location and on job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. We look forward to discussing your salary expectations and our full total rewards offerings throughout the interview process.

Please note: North is a US based company and no sponsorship is available for this position at this time.

Who we are:

North, and our family of companies, are committed to helping entrepreneurs grow their businesses. As an end-to-end payment solutions company, we provide everything business owners need to get paid, whether they serve customers in a physical storefront, online, or both. We pride ourselves on being large enough to offer customized solutions to our enterprise-level clients while remaining agile enough to take an award-winning, hands-on approach to personal service that our merchants won’t find anywhere else.

Let’s go North, together! Our most important resource is our people. Join our diverse team of innovators and do-ers and make your mark on the future of payments technology. We're proud to offer benefits that help our team members further their overall well-being through unique initiatives that are both personally and professionally fulfilling.

At North, we celebrate diversity and create an inclusive environment for everyone. We are an equal opportunity employer.

title: Director, Customer Success

raw.title: Director, Customer Success
raw.excerpt: Dispatch is redefining how the world experiences home and field service.
raw.description:
Dispatch is redefining how the world experiences home and field service. Founded in 2013 and trusted by leading brands and service providers, we power seamless, reliable service experiences through a modern platform built for scale. Our platform gives businesses the visibility, communication, and control they need to manage every step of the service journey, from job acceptance through completion. With the acquisition of Youreka in 2023, Dispatch expanded its capabilities to include a leading Salesforce-native Smart Forms application that equips mobile workers with guided workflows, improves field execution and customer service, and scales to support complex enterprise operations.

As part of Manos Software, a Valsoft operating group, Dispatch combines the focus and agility of a specialized software company with the long-term support of a global vertical SaaS organization. We’re investing in our product, our customers, and our team with a focus on sustainable, profitable growth.

The Customer Success team owns the ongoing strategic relationships with our enterprise customers across our Dispatch and Youreka product lines. As Director of Customer Success, you will lead the Customer Success organization and play a critical role in transforming how we engage, retain, and grow our customers.

You will lead and develop our team of Customer Success Managers, ensuring they are focused and have the tools to develop deep customer relationships, lead strategic business conversations, and drive meaningful business outcomes for our customers. You’ll establish the expectations, operating rhythms, coaching, and processes that enable the team to spend more time understanding our customers, their industries, and where we can create additional value.

You will also serve as a senior commercial leader across our most strategic accounts across our products, partnering directly with SAMs and CSMs on key relationships and stepping in to lead complex renewals, expansion opportunities, executive conversations, and contract negotiations. You should be equally comfortable coaching a CSM through an opportunity and personally taking a strategic renewal or expansion deal through close. This is a hands-on leadership role for someone who has helped evolve or transform a Customer Success organization before. We’re looking for a leader who is energized by building, improving, and challenging how things are done—not simply maintaining an established playbook.

AS THE DIRECTOR OF CUSTOMER SUCCESS, YOU WILL:

  • Lead, coach, motivate, and develop the Customer Success team, creating clear expectations and helping CSMs grow into more strategic, commercially minded customer leaders.
  • Own the Customer Success strategy and operating model across Dispatch and Youreka, ensuring customers receive a consistent, high-quality experience regardless of product.
  • Provide executive-level oversight for Dispatch's most strategic accounts across all product lines, partnering closely with CSMs to strengthen relationships, remove obstacles, and drive customer value.
  • Own the renewal and expansion strategy across the customer base, with accountability for retention, renewal performance, expansion ARR, and overall account growth.
  • Personally lead or support complex enterprise renewals and expansions, including negotiation, pricing, value positioning, stakeholder alignment, contract strategy, and close.
  • Coach CSMs on commercial strategy, executive engagement, account planning, negotiation, value selling, and identifying expansion opportunities.
  • Build strong relationships with senior and executive customer stakeholders and help CSMs expand the depth and breadth of relationships within their accounts.
  • Run strategic account plans, renewal and expansion forecasts, customer health practices, and operating cadences that improve visibility, accountability, and predictability.
  • Leverage AI and automation to improve customer insights, renewal forecasting, risk identification, expansion discovery, and team productivity, while helping the organization rethink how Customer Success work gets done.
  • Serve as a senior escalation point for critical customer situations, helping the team navigate complex challenges while maintaining a strong customer-first approach.
  • Partner closely with Technical Success, Product, Engineering, and Sales leadership to remove customer obstacles, represent the voice of the customer, and create opportunities for retention and growth.
  • Identify trends across the customer base and use those insights to influence customer strategy, product priorities, and broader business decisions.

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR:

  • 8+ years of experience in Enterprise Customer Success, Strategic Account Management, Account Management, or a similarly customer- and commercially focused SaaS environment, including meaningful people leadership experience.
  • Proven experience leading and developing Customer Success Managers, including coaching teams toward stronger executive relationships, strategic account management, and commercial outcomes.
  • Significant experience owning or leading enterprise renewals and expansions, with a demonstrated ability to personally negotiate and close complex renewal, upsell, and cross-sell opportunities.
  • A strong commercial mindset—you understand that great Customer Success combines customer advocacy and value realization with retention, expansion, and disciplined commercial execution.
  • Demonstrated ability to build trusted relationships with VP and C-level stakeholders across large ($250k+ ARR), complex enterprise organizations.
  • Strong strategic account planning skills, including stakeholder mapping, whitespace analysis, renewal risk assessment, value realization, and growth planning.
  • Experience using AI-powered tools to improve customer insights, team productivity, account strategy, forecasting, and decision-making, with genuine interest in rethinking traditional Customer Success workflows through AI.
  • Strong business acumen with the ability to quickly understand a customer's operating model, industry, strategic priorities, and financial drivers.
  • Comfortable working in a hands-on environment where leaders are expected to get directly involved in customers, deals, team development, and organizational change.
  • Ability to thrive in an evolving environment and is energized by the opportunity to improve and transform rather than simply maintain existing processes.
  • Experience in field service, field service management software, or technology supporting distributed service organizations is strongly preferred.
  • Experience with Salesforce or within the Salesforce ecosystem is helpful, particularly experience with Salesforce-native products, but is not required.

SOME SKILLS WE SEEK:

  • Executive communication and presence
  • Enterprise negotiation and commercial strategy
  • Renewal and expansion forecasting
  • Strategic account planning & executive stakeholder management
  • Value selling and ROI development
  • Cross-functional leadership and influence
  • Coaching and mentorship
  • Presentation and facilitation
  • Analytical and problem-solving skills
  • Familiarity with Salesforce and Customer Success platforms
  • Working knowledge of SaaS metrics, enterprise software, and customer lifecycle management

WITHIN ONE MONTH, YOU’LL:

  • Attend New Hire Orientation and build relationships across Customer Success, Technical Success, Sales, Product, Finance, and Engineering.
  • Develop a strong understanding of the field service industry, Dispatch’s customer base, and the business challenges our solutions address.
  • Build deep functional knowledge of Dispatch’s products, customer use cases, and value proposition.
  • Review the existing customer portfolio, renewal calendar, expansion pipeline, account plans, and customer health metrics.
  • Meet with key internal stakeholders to understand current renewal and expansion processes, strengths, gaps, and opportunities.
  • Begin developing strategic growth plans for priority enterprise accounts.

WITHIN THREE MONTHS, YOU’LL:

  • Take ownership of renewal and expansion outcomes across your assigned strategic customer portfolio.
  • Establish account strategies for priority customers, including executive relationships, renewal plans, risk mitigation strategies, and expansion opportunities.
  • Develop strong relationships with key customer decision-makers, influencers, and executive stakeholders.
  • Establish a clear, accurate renewal and expansion forecast and operating cadence.
  • Begin leading commercial discussions, renewal negotiations, and expansion opportunities.

WITHIN SIX MONTHS, YOU’LL:

  • Be viewed internally and externally as a strategic leader for Dispatch’s most important customer relationships.
  • Consistently lead successful executive-level customer conversations focused on value realization, strategic priorities, and future growth.
  • Build a strong pipeline of qualified expansion opportunities across the enterprise customer base.
  • Lead complex renewal and expansion negotiations with senior customer stakeholders.
  • Coach and support CMS in strengthening their commercial and strategic account management capabilities.

WITHIN TWELVE MONTHS, YOU’LL:

  • Consistently achieve or exceed Dispatch’s renewal, retention, and expansion targets.
  • Demonstrate measurable growth across our most strategic enterprise accounts through additional use cases, products, business units, geographies, or service lines.
  • Maintain strong executive relationships across the customer portfolio and establish Dispatch as a strategic partner to our customers.
  • Build a highly predictable renewal and expansion motion supported by strong forecasting, account planning, executive engagement, and value realization.
  • Become a trusted advisor to Dispatch leadership on customer growth strategy, retention risk, market trends, and strategic opportunities.
  • Help establish a scalable model for how Dispatch retains and grows enterprise customers as the business continues to expand.

SALARY:

The base salary range for this role is between $135,000 - $160,000 annually. Actual pay within the range is influenced by multiple factors, including but not limited to skill set, residence location, and prior work experience. In addition to base salary, this position is eligible for an annual bonus and benefits.

LOCATION:

Dispatch fully accommodates remote work, as long as you have a permanent residence in the US and reside in one of our registered states. Want to spend a month in Italy? Great, do it! Live in Idaho? Sweet, we have another team member there! As long as you are crushing your goals and helping us drive the business forward, you do you. We also have an office in Boston that is open and available for you to use.

WE HAVE:

  • An amazing team focused on innovating and improving every day
  • Room for growth and an emphasis on talent development, including a professional development reimbursement program
  • A fun, casual team environment with co-workers who will make you feel like an important part of our team, engage you in developing new solutions to challenging problems, and help you leverage your strengths
  • A generous medical, dental, and vision package with 90% covered by us
  • Paid parental leave
  • 401(k) with company match
  • Company-sponsored life insurance coverage, short-term disability, and long-term disability
  • Additional perks including a wellness and adventure fund, as well as monthly personal Uber credits
  • Flexible Paid Time Off (PTO), 9 company holidays, and a flexible work schedule

STILL WITH US?

We’re ready to meet you if you wake up every day excited to build strategic customer partnerships, lead complex commercial conversations, and find new ways to grow the impact Dispatch has within our customers. Is this role not an exact fit for you? Keep an eye on our Careers Page for other positions!

Dispatch is an equal opportunity employer and participates in E-Verify. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, national origin, gender, religion, age, disability, veteran status, or any other classification as required by applicable law.

raw.description:
About the Role

We are looking for a talented Web Designer / WordPress Developer to join a growing team supporting an Australian SaaS business.

This role is ideal for someone who combines strong WordPress and Divi development skills with good visual design judgment. You will be responsible for taking supplied content, objectives, and direction and turning them into polished, modern, high-quality website pages.

This is not a role where you will simply wait for detailed design instructions. We are looking for someone who can think like both a designer and developer, make sound design decisions, recommend improvements, and take ownership of the page-building process from concept through to completion.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, build, and update website pages using WordPress and Divi.
  • Translate supplied content and objectives into effective page structures, layouts, and visual flows.
  • Create modern, professional, SaaS-style website sections and page designs.
  • Make independent decisions around spacing, typography, imagery, hierarchy, calls to action, and overall user experience.
  • Recommend improvements and better solutions rather than simply implementing instructions.
  • Ensure websites are responsive and function effectively across desktop, tablet, and mobile.
  • Maintain strong visual and structural consistency across the website.
  • Implement ongoing website improvements as new features, content, and campaigns are released.
  • Work directly with stakeholders to take concepts and content through to finished website pages.
  • Follow existing brand guidelines while introducing appropriate design ideas and improvements.
  • Perform website quality checks before publishing or handing pages over for review.
  • Potentially support additional websites and brands as the business grows.

What We're Looking For

  • 3+ years of relevant experience in web design and/or WordPress development.
  • Strong hands-on experience with WordPress.
  • Strong hands-on experience with Divi.
  • Good visual design judgment and a strong eye for detail.
  • Solid understanding of website architecture, page hierarchy, spacing, typography, visual flow, and calls to action.
  • Strong understanding of responsive web design across desktop, tablet, and mobile.
  • Experience working on SaaS, technology, professional services, or other modern business websites is highly preferred.
  • Ability to work from existing brand guidelines while still contributing creative ideas.
  • Ability to independently turn content and objectives into polished, user-friendly web pages.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and the confidence to recommend a better approach when appropriate.
  • Comfortable working with feedback and applying learnings across the broader website.
  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to delivering high-quality work.
  • A portfolio demonstrating relevant WordPress, Divi, and responsive website projects.

How You'll Work

You will generally be provided with the content, purpose, and direction for a page rather than detailed instructions for every design element.

You will be expected to use your expertise to determine:

  • The most effective page structure and layout
  • How information should flow throughout the page
  • Which content should be visually prioritized
  • Where imagery, graphics, or visual elements can strengthen the page
  • How calls to action should be positioned and presented
  • How the overall user experience can be improved
  • How the page should adapt across different screen sizes

We are looking for someone who can produce a strong first version with limited detailed correction, rather than someone who requires extensive step-by-step direction for every page.

What Success Looks Like

Success in this role means consistently delivering website pages that are:

MCI is one of the fastest-growing tech-enabled business services companies in the USA, with a strong call center footprint and operations that extend across multiple countries. Our contact centers are powered by both on-site and remote agents, leveraging advanced technologies to enhance customer journeys, drive scalability and reduce costs.

At MCI we are committed to fostering an environment where professionals can build meaningful careers, access continuous learning and development opportunities and contribute to the success of a globally expanding, industry-leading organization.

In addition to being the best in the business when it comes to customer interactions, you will need to be confident, fully engaged, a team player, and dedicated to bringing a positive and enthusiastic outlook to work each day.

raw.excerpt: About OpenSesameOpenSesame is transforming workforce development with an AI-powered marketplace of skill-building courses and learning pathways.
raw.description:
About OpenSesame

OpenSesame is transforming workforce development with an AI-powered marketplace of skill-building courses and learning pathways. We help organizations build skills and stay compliant through a high-quality content catalog, seamless LMS/LXP integrations, and advanced capabilities like skills-based curation and multilingual content creation. More than 2,000 companies, including 150+ of the Global 2000, rely on OpenSesame to develop the world's most productive and admired workforces.
Learn more:

About the Role

The Partner Marketing Manager leads the strategy and execution of integrated marketing programs that grow OpenSesame’s indirect business. This role activates priority partners’ installed bases and prospects, creates demand through partner-specific and vertical campaigns, and helps convert that demand into sales-accepted leads, qualified pipeline, and bookings.

The role collaborates closely with the Partners team, Sales, Product Marketing, Content, Field and Account-Based Marketing, and GTM Operations to connect partner priorities to scalable go-to-market programs and measurable business outcomes.

How you'll find success

While you are strategically capable, you love to roll up your sleeves and manage the details required to bring programs to life. You translate joint priorities into clear audiences, messages, campaigns, conversion paths, and measurable outcomes, actively driving the work from planning through execution and optimization.

You build trust with internal stakeholders and external partners, bring structure to a complex partner ecosystem, and maintain the judgment to prioritize high-impact work. You can set thoughtful boundaries around ad hoc requests and reshape activities that do not support shared business goals.

Success is measured by marketing-attributable indirect bookings generated through partner campaigns. Beyond delivering results, you will be seen as a critical collaborator across the Partners and Marketing teams, known for making priorities clearer, execution easier, and joint programs more effective.

What You’ll Own

  • Indirect Funnel and Pipeline Generation: Plan, execute, and optimize marketing programs in alignment with partner overall annual and quarterly plans that generate partner-sourced and partner-influenced pipeline and bookings. Activate priority partners’ installed bases and prospects through co-marketing, account-based programs, vertical campaigns, email, webinars, events, marketplace motions, landing pages, and other channels. Manage applicable marketing development funds, including plans, utilization, compliance, and performance reporting.
  • Partner-Rep Activation and Marketing-in-a-Box: Equip Strategic Partner Managers (SPMs) and partner field teams with scalable campaigns, better-together messaging, campaign kits, events, target-account plays, engagement flows, product and launch communications, and clear referral pathways. Make it easy for partner representatives to identify opportunities, engage their audiences, and take the next action.
  • Bring the Partner Story to Life: Ensure OpenSesame’s partner value and better-together stories are clearly and consistently represented across the company’s marketing programs and channels. Collaborate with Product Marketing, Content, Field and ABM, and other teams to translate partner capabilities, launches, and customer value into compelling messaging, content, and market-facing experiences.
  • Cross-Functional Operating Model: Serve as the marketing counterpart to the Partners team. Establish shared briefs, planning cadences, roles, handoffs, service levels, and decision criteria so Partner Marketing and SPMs work from one-market priority and one-funnel plan.
  • Operational Effectiveness and Revenue Measurement: Set campaign goals and reporting cadences in partnership with GTM Operations. Track referral and non-referral leads, MQLs, SALs, opportunities, pipeline, sourced revenue, expansion revenue, engagement, and conversion rates by partner and program. Translate performance into clear optimization and investment decisions.
  • Personal Effectiveness and AI Utilization: Build repeatable, scalable programs and be an organized, proactive cross-functional partner. Apply AI to account and audience research, personalization, partner-specific content adaptation, campaign development, analysis, reporting, and workflow efficiency.

Performance Objectives

Specific performance targets will be established with leadership after the partner funnel baseline has been validated.

First 30 Days: Execute, Learn & Evaluate As You Go

Goal: Seamlessly take ownership of in-flight work while building a strong understanding of the partner ecosystem, current priorities, and performance.

  • Take the reins: Quickly transition ownership of current partner marketing programs, campaigns, and partner commitments, establishing clear priorities and driving existing work forward with minimal disruption.
  • Learn the partner ecosystem: Build an understanding of partner tiers, strategic priorities, key audiences, existing programs, and the role each partner plays in OpenSesame’s growth strategy.
  • Build stakeholder context: Meet with Strategic Partner Managers, Sales, Product Marketing, Content, Field and ABM, GTM Operations, and other key collaborators to understand goals, current commitments, ways of working, and immediate needs.
  • Understand current performance: Review available funnel and campaign performance to establish initial context around what is working, where challenges exist, and which areas require deeper evaluation.
  • Confirm immediate priorities: Align with leadership and key partners on the most important near-term deliverables, risks, and decisions requiring attention.
  • Funnel baseline: Assess performance by partner and motion across indirect non-referral leads, MQLs, SALs, opportunities, pipeline, revenue, expansion, engagement, and conversion rates. Identify the largest leaks, with particular attention to lead-to-SAL conversion.

Key deliverables:

  • Ownership and status tracker for all in-flight partner marketing programs, campaigns, and commitments.
  • Documented near-term priorities, milestones, risks, and dependencies.
  • Initial partner ecosystem and stakeholder overview, including key objectives and ways of working.
  • 30-day execution plan for advancing immediate priorities and addressing urgent needs.
  • Partner marketing current-state assessment and opportunity map.
  • Baseline partner funnel scorecard and agreed metric definitions.
  • Prioritized 90-day roadmap, request-intake criteria, and recommended quick wins.

Days 31–60: Build the System and Launch Pilots

Goal: Turn alignment into focused campaigns and establish the operating cadence needed to convert demand.

  • Campaign planning: Select priority partners, verticals, accounts, audiences, offers, calls to action, and conversion paths. Build campaign briefs that connect partner value propositions to OpenSesame solutions and measurable funnel targets.
  • Portfolio and program audit: Review partner tiers, current plans, active and planned campaigns, installed-base and prospect access, target-account lists, partner assets, events, MDF, referral motions, and marketplace opportunities.
  • Partner-rep enablement: Equip Strategic Partner Managers with the messaging, engagement flows, target-account plays, campaign kits, and referral guidance needed to activate partner field teams alongside the market-facing pilots.
  • Measurement and handoffs: Put campaign tracking, routing, follow-up expectations, and weekly MQL-to-SAL-to-opportunity reviews in place with GTM Operations and Sales.
  • Communication rhythm: Establish a consistent planning and performance cadence with the Partnerships team, including decisions, dependencies, risks, and recommendations to continue, pause, or stop work.

Key deliverables:

  • Partner marketing current-state assessment and opportunity map.
  • Baseline partner funnel scorecard and agreed metric definitions.
  • Approved partner campaign briefs and a shared quarterly activation calendar.
  • Partner-rep activation toolkit and weekly funnel review cadence.

Days 61–90: Optimize, Prove Impact, and Scale

Goal: Use early results to improve conversion, focus investment, and create a repeatable partner growth engine.

  • Performance optimization: Analyze pilot engagement and movement across MQLs, SALs, opportunities, pipeline, and revenue. Test and improve audience quality, messaging, offers, landing pages, routing, and follow-up.
  • Portfolio decisions: Determine which partner, vertical, market-activation, and partner-rep activation plays should scale. Recommend what to pause, stop, or redesign when it is not supporting priority outcomes.
  • Playbook development: Document the repeatable partner campaign model, including intake, tiering, briefing, launch, partner enablement, lead management, reporting, MDF, and post-campaign review.
  • Forward planning: Build the next-quarter roadmap with clear capacity assumptions, partner priorities, funnel targets, campaign milestones, dependencies, and investment recommendations.
  • Executive readout: Present early impact, conversion insights, risks, and recommended next steps to Marketing and Partners teams leadership.

Key deliverables:

  • Pilot performance and optimization readout showing early funnel impact.
  • Repeatable partner marketing playbook and shared funnel scorecard.
  • Leadership-approved next-quarter plan focused on the plays most likely to create SALs, opportunities, and revenue.

You might notice we don’t have the typical list of requirements and buzzwords here. That’s intentional.

We’re looking for proven examples from your career that show you can do this job, that you’ve built systems, driven alignment, and created impact at scale. When you look back a year from now, you’ll know you’ve made OpenSesame better, faster, and stronger because of your leadership.

Although it should go without saying (but it doesn’t), OpenSesame is an equal opportunity employer and we strive to create a welcoming, inclusive environment that celebrates diversity.

We use AI. For real. Every team at OpenSesame works with AI tools daily, not as a buzzword, but as practice. You'll build fluency that most companies are still talking about adopting, with hands-on training and clear guardrails to experiment responsibly. AI amplifies your creativity and judgment. It doesn't replace them. The skills you build here travel with you.

Location: This position can be based anywhere in the US. We operate as a remote-first company, and invest in mandatory all-company meetings several times a year in addition to required team travel of up to 15 days per year as necessary.

raw.description:
Part Time District/Charter Coach

Location: Remote - Flexible within the United States

ABOUT ANET

Achievement Network (ANet) is a nonprofit organization dedicated to helping all students achieve strong educational outcomes. We partner with school and system leaders to strengthen teaching and learning through the strategic use of assessments, coaching, and tools that drive meaningful results. Individuals who join ANet become part of a dynamic, mission-driven, and collaborative organization focused on making a lasting impact in schools. We are committed to supporting one another and growing together as a team. This is a part-time role, with an anticipated workload of approximately 10–15 hours per week.

OPPORTUNITY

The Director of Partnership Experience & Impact coaches district leaders through a structured process to evaluate and strengthen their assessment systems, in collaboration with ANet and partner organizations. Reporting to a Managing Director, this leader drives breakthrough results through coaching, builds strong partner relationships, and ensures districts experience ANet as a trusted advisor committed to equity and continuous improvement.

TRAVEL

~2 times annually for cross-district convenings

RESPONSIBILITIES

Coach and Partner with Leaders

  • Provide direct coaching to district leaders to help them evaluate and strengthen their assessment systems in service of student learning.
  • Guide district teams through a structured process to inventory current assessments, reduce volume, clarify purpose and use, and identify where change may be needed.
  • Build trusting relationships that position the coach and ANet as valued thought partners throughout the engagement.

Drive Project Success

  • Support districts in moving from analysis to clear, actionable decisions about their assessment systems.
  • Help district teams weigh evidence and tradeoffs so that decisions are well-informed and sustainable.
  • Contribute district-level insights and outcomes that demonstrate the value and impact of the work.

Contribute to Coherent and Impact Focused Support

  • Collaborate with project colleagues to ensure a consistent, high-quality coaching experience across participating districts.
  • Share observations, lessons learned, and effective practices to help strengthen the overall approach and tools used in the project.
  • Keep a focus on instructional relevance and student impact throughout all coaching conversations and decisions.

COMPETENCIES

In order to be successful in this role, candidates must demonstrate the following:

  • Expertise in Area of Focus: Brings assessment/data literacy expertise to coach system leaders.
  • Communication: Builds trust and influences diverse stakeholders through clear, empathetic, and strategic communication.
  • Planning and Prioritizing Work:
    • Meets structured documentation requirements (agendas, meeting summaries, transcripts) on tight turnaround, supporting a grant-funded project's learning agenda.
    • Centers goals, monitors progress, and adapts strategies to ensure results.
  • Management:
    • Coaches and develops leaders, fostering community-centered leadership and accountability.
    • Collaborates closely with cross-organizational coaching teams within ANet and across partner organizations.
  • Critical Thinking & Data Orientation: Uses evidence and insights to inform strategies, guide decisions, and anticipate partner needs.
  • Change Management: Supports systems in decision-making that leads to measurable outcomes.

QUALIFICATIONS

Preferred

  • Experience in and knowledge of K-12 Math and ELA assessment landscape.
  • Content-specific expertise in one or both of the following: assessment strategy or data literacy.
  • Proven track record coaching and developing system leaders to achieve student learning gains.
  • Experience supporting leaders in using data and HQIM for equitable instructional improvement.
  • Ability to build and sustain strong, trust-based relationships with partners.
  • Familiarity with system-level leadership structures and decision-making processes.

COMPENSATION

The pay rate for this position is $73.02 per hour. In order to uphold our commitment to transparent, equitable, competitive, and sustainable compensation, ANet does not negotiate pay.

APPLY

We are now accepting applications for this position through 5 pm ET on September 11. Please submit your application online. Learn more about the application process here.

Internal Candidates: If interested, please notify your manager of your interest and submit your application on ANet’s Career page.

ANet is committed to maximizing the diversity of our organization. We are an equal opportunity employer and encourage individuals of all ethnic and racial backgrounds and gender identities to apply to our positions.

Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States on a full-time basis.

Job Description:

Title: Data Scientist

Location: Remote – Canada

Reports to: Director, Data Insights – Product & Technology

Vacancy: Existing vacancy

The Role:

As part of the Valuation Services division of JD Power, you will work to understand what features drive a vehicle's price and run processes to predict future values. Our data science team is accountable for every data point we output and provides industry-leading, accurate, transparent analytics. We are looking for a Data Scientist who will be free to use the latest technologies to solve challenging problems, create innovative processes from the ground up, deploy them into production on our AWS server, and develop the tools for monitoring them. We are a mature and tight-knit data science team looking to add another top-shelf team member ready to make a difference in the automotive industry.

The Impact You Will Have in This Role:

We make data products and every new data product we output will solve a problem in the auto industry. Every Data Scientist will participate in developing and deploying processes and pipelines that go into production and directly impact our core products.

What You’ll Be Doing in This Role:

  • Daily immersion in automotive industry data

  • Development and documentation of multiple critical production processes

  • Maintain and iterate on production algorithms, optimizing ETLs and troubleshooting as necessary to handle changing data and valuation requirements

  • Collaborate closely with technology and engineering teams to build out new processes and improve existing ones

  • Create visual reports in Tableau for data review and validation that will be used by internal and external clients to summarize findings

  • Perform extensive QA on internally developed automotive industry forecasts and the resulting vehicle values

  • Team environment that encourages the sharing of ideas to build the best predictive algorithms

  • Work directly with internal stakeholders to help them understand our predictive products and methodology

  • Create decks to make highly technical predictions relatable to the automotive industry

  • Ad-hoc data analysis and reporting

Qualifications of this Role:

  • Curiosity and passion for solving problems with data

  • Great attention to detail and a focus on organization, logic, and data and code quality

  • 2+ years of professional experience working with large datasets

  • 2+ years of professional experience with statistical programming software (Python/Pandas required, Spark preferred)

  • 2+ years of professional experience with database software (SQL, RedShift, Hive, MYSQL)

  • Experience working with AWS tools (S3, Sagemaker, Glue, Lambda…)

  • Ability to communicate technical processes to both peers and a lay audience

  • Master’s Degree in Statistics, Data Science, Economics, or a related field

Nice to Have:

  • Experience with automotive market data

  • Expertise deploying CI/CD with cloud-based systems, managing code in Git

  • Experience with Tableau for data visualizations

  • Experience with prompting and implementing generative AI output into workstreams

  • Some shareable examples of production data pipelines, product deployments, or data visualizations you have created

  • Experience deploying machine learning models into production with an API

The Hiring Manager says:

We want data science candidates who can think through a customer journey and an industry thoroughly, creatively and intuitively to understand, explain, and predict issues that have not yet been resolved (in large part because they are only emerging). We need the capability to leverage the right data sets from an impressive set of data assets and to collaborate with others to plan process improvements, optimizations, and data QA.

This position has a starting salary range of $85,000 -$90,000 CAD per year. This is the range we reasonably and in good faith expect to pay for the role at the time of posting. An employee’s pay within the range is determined by a number of factors, including relevant skills, education, qualifications, experience, performance, business or organizational needs, and geographic location.

Position Overview

The Chief Growth Officer (CGO) is responsible for driving the organization's overall growth strategy by identifying new business opportunities, expanding market presence, increasing revenue streams, and enhancing customer acquisition and retention. The CGO works cross-functionally across sales, marketing, partnerships, product, and operations to accelerate sustainable business growth and strengthen competitive positioning.

Key Responsibilities

Growth Strategy & Business Expansion

Develop and execute enterprise-wide growth strategies aligned with organizational objectives.

Identify new revenue opportunities, customer segments, and market expansion initiatives.

Drive sustainable growth through innovation, strategic partnerships, and business development.

Revenue Growth & Market Development

Lead initiatives to increase revenue, market share, and profitability.

Analyze market trends, customer behavior, and competitive landscapes to identify growth opportunities.

Develop go-to-market strategies for new products, services, and regions.

Customer Acquisition & Retention

Oversee customer acquisition, engagement, and retention strategies.

Collaborate with marketing and sales teams to optimize conversion funnels and customer journeys.

Drive initiatives that improve customer lifetime value and loyalty.

Sales & Marketing Alignment

Ensure alignment between sales, marketing, and business development functions.

Develop performance-driven campaigns and lead generation strategies.

Support brand positioning and market awareness initiatives.

Partnerships & Strategic Alliances

Build and manage strategic partnerships, alliances, and channel relationships.

Identify opportunities for collaborations, joint ventures, and ecosystem growth.

Strengthen relationships with key stakeholders and industry partners.

Data Analytics & Performance Optimization

Establish KPIs and dashboards to measure growth performance.

Use analytics and market intelligence to guide strategic decisions.

Continuously optimize acquisition, conversion, and revenue-generation efforts.

Innovation & Digital Transformation

Drive innovation initiatives and digital growth strategies.

Leverage technology, automation, and data tools to improve scalability and efficiency.

Stay informed on industry trends and emerging business models.

Cross-Functional Leadership

Collaborate with operations, finance, product, technology, and customer success teams.

Ensure organizational alignment toward growth objectives.

Lead high-impact strategic initiatives across departments.

Leadership & Team Development

Lead and mentor growth, marketing, sales, and business development teams.

Build a high-performance, results-oriented culture.

Foster innovation, accountability, and continuous improvement.

Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Finance, or related field; MBA preferred.

12–15+ years of experience in growth strategy, business development, sales, marketing, or executive leadership roles.

Proven track record of driving revenue growth and market expansion.

Strong understanding of customer acquisition, digital growth, and strategic partnerships.

Key Skills & Competencies

Strategic thinking and commercial acumen.

Strong leadership and stakeholder management skills.

Expertise in growth marketing and revenue optimization.

Analytical and data-driven decision-making abilities.

Excellent communication, negotiation, and relationship-building skills.

Performance Metrics

Revenue growth and profitability.

Customer acquisition and retention rates.

Market share expansion.

Conversion and pipeline performance metrics.

Success of strategic partnerships and growth initiatives.
