raw.description:
About MojoTech

MojoTech is an innovative technology consulting firm that integrates strategy, design, data, and software engineering to create results-driven, AI-enabled digital products and experiences.

We partner with our clients to discover, define, design, and build tomorrow’s innovations, empowering organizations to unlock future market potential, maximize returns on innovation, and drive transformational change.

Role Overview

We are looking for a Senior Principal Software Architect with deep expertise in Microsoft Azure, .NET, and AI-accelerated software development to lead client engagements across architecture, delivery, and growth.

This role combines hands-on technical leadership with client engagement and business development. You will work directly with client stakeholders to modernize applications, shape cloud solutions, guide teams through delivery, and grow accounts through trusted relationships and strong outcomes.

You will also help teams adopt AI-assisted and agentic development practices responsibly. This includes using AI to accelerate software design, implementation, code review, debugging, documentation, and delivery while ensuring that people remain accountable for architectural decisions, quality, security, and production readiness.

You will be expected to stay close to the work. This is a hands-on leadership role in which you will set technical direction, evaluate architecture and code, unblock teams, and step in when needed to move delivery forward.

Key Responsibilities

Azure and .NET Architecture Leadership

  • Design and deliver scalable, maintainable, and secure applications using C#, .NET, Core, and Microsoft Azure
  • Lead the architecture and development of distributed, cloud-native applications, APIs, integration services, and data-driven solutions
  • Modernize legacy .NET and .NET Framework applications using incremental migration, re-platforming, refactoring, or cloud-native modernization approaches
  • Design Azure solutions using services such as Azure App Service, Azure Functions, Azure Container Apps, Azure Kubernetes Service, API Management, Service Bus, Event Grid, Azure SQL, and Cosmos DB
  • Design secure identity and access management solutions using Microsoft Entra ID, OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect, managed identities, and role-based access control
  • Apply Azure Well-Architected Framework principles to improve reliability, security, performance, operational excellence, and cost management
  • Establish application integration patterns using REST APIs, messaging, event-driven architecture, and microservices where appropriate
  • Guide teams in the practical use of automated testing, CI/CD, observability, infrastructure as code, and DevOps practices
  • Use Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, Bicep, Terraform, or similar tools to create repeatable build, deployment, and infrastructure processes
  • Evaluate architectural trade-offs and make clear, pragmatic recommendations based on business needs, delivery constraints, and long-term maintainability
  • Provide hands-on technical support through architecture reviews, code reviews, proof-of-concept development, and complex troubleshooting

AI-Accelerated Engineering Leadership

  • Use AI-assisted development tools to accelerate software design, implementation, testing, code reviews, debugging, and technical problem-solving
  • Design and lead agentic development workflows that support parallelized coding, autonomous task execution, and orchestration across complex software initiatives
  • Apply prompt engineering techniques to software development, system design, code generation, testing, analysis, and technical documentation
  • Use AI to create and maintain documentation, architecture diagrams, technical specifications, delivery plans, test assets, and other project artifacts
  • Establish clear standards for reviewing, validating, testing, and securing AI-generated code and technical outputs
  • Design workflows in which humans remain accountable for architectural decisions, implementation quality, security, compliance, and production outcomes
  • Use rapid prototyping to validate ideas and technical approaches, followed by structured production hardening across architecture, code quality, security, testing, performance, observability, and maintainability
  • Help teams determine where AI-assisted or agentic workflows provide meaningful value and where traditional engineering approaches are more appropriate
  • Monitor the effectiveness of AI-enabled engineering practices and continuously improve the team’s tools, workflows, and quality controls
  • Coach clients and delivery teams on the responsible adoption of AI-accelerated software engineering practices

Client Engagement

  • Work directly with client stakeholders to understand business and technical challenges, define solutions, and align on measurable outcomes
  • Lead discovery engagements, application and cloud assessments, modernization planning, and early-stage solution design
  • Assess existing .NET applications and Azure environments to identify technical debt, security risks, operational gaps, and modernization opportunities
  • Evaluate client software delivery practices and identify opportunities to introduce AI-assisted and agentic development workflows
  • Facilitate technical workshops and architecture discussions with engineering teams, business leaders, and executive stakeholders
  • Translate business requirements into clear, executable technical strategies, roadmaps, and delivery plans
  • Communicate complex Azure, .NET, and AI-enabled engineering concepts to technical and nontechnical audiences
  • Build strong client relationships that position MojoTech as a trusted technology and delivery partner

Sales and Growth

  • Partner with account and sales leaders to shape and win Azure, .NET, application modernization, and AI-accelerated engineering engagements
  • Contribute to proposals, estimates, staffing plans, technical approaches, and client presentations
  • Support technical discovery and solutioning during the sales process
  • Identify follow-on opportunities within existing client engagements
  • Clearly articulate the business and technical value of proposed solutions
  • Help develop reusable Azure, .NET, cloud modernization, and AI-enabled engineering offerings, reference architectures, accelerators, and delivery approaches

Program and Delivery Leadership

  • Lead technical delivery across one or more engagements, ensuring work remains aligned with agreed goals, timelines, budgets, and quality expectations
  • Establish lightweight governance, planning, architecture decision-making, and communication practices that keep teams moving
  • Coordinate across engineering, product, design, data, cloud infrastructure, and security disciplines
  • Structure work so teams can safely use parallelized and agentic development approaches while maintaining appropriate review and integration controls
  • Identify architectural, technical, and delivery risks early and work with teams and client stakeholders to address them
  • Ensure architecture decisions are translated into working software and consistently implemented across delivery teams
  • Maintain a strong focus on production readiness, measurable outcomes, and sustainable client ownership
  • Ensure rapid prototypes move through a defined production-hardening process before release

Team and Practice Leadership

  • Mentor engineers and architects and help develop technical leadership across project teams
  • Establish high standards for .NET development, Azure architecture, AI-assisted engineering, code quality, system design, security, testing, and production readiness
  • Coach teams on AI-accelerated code review, debugging, implementation, prompt engineering, and agentic development workflows
  • Contribute to hiring, interviewing, and building a strong senior engineering organization
  • Help evolve MojoTech’s Azure, .NET, cloud modernization, and AI-native engineering practices
  • Contribute to technical standards, reference architectures, reusable components, prompt libraries, development workflows, and delivery playbooks
  • Stay current with developments across the Microsoft technology ecosystem and AI-assisted software development
  • Remain hands-on enough to maintain technical credibility and provide meaningful support when teams encounter difficult problems

Required Experience

  • 10+ years of experience designing, building, and delivering production software systems
  • Deep expertise in C#, .NET, Core, and modern application architecture
  • Significant experience designing, deploying, and operating production workloads on Microsoft Azure
  • Experience modernizing legacy .NET Framework applications and migrating on-premises systems to Azure
  • Strong understanding of distributed systems, cloud-native architecture, REST APIs, microservices, messaging, and event-driven patterns
  • Experience with Azure services such as App Service, Functions, Container Apps, AKS, API Management, Service Bus, Event Grid, Azure SQL, Cosmos DB, Key Vault, and Azure Monitor
  • Experience with Microsoft Entra ID, OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect, managed identities, and cloud security practices
  • Experience implementing CI/CD pipelines and infrastructure as code using Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, Bicep, Terraform, or comparable technologies
  • Strong knowledge of relational data modeling, SQL Server, Entity Framework Core, and application integration patterns
  • Demonstrated experience using AI to accelerate code reviews, debugging, software design, implementation, testing, and technical problem-solving
  • Experience designing or leading agentic development workflows involving parallelized coding, autonomous task execution, and orchestration
  • Strong prompt engineering skills applied to software development, system generation, code analysis, testing, and documentation
  • Experience using AI to generate and maintain technical documentation, architecture artifacts, specifications, and delivery assets
  • Experience establishing human review, validation, security, and quality controls for AI-generated code and technical outputs
  • Experience rapidly prototyping software solutions and leading the structured hardening required to move them into production
  • Experience leading architecture and delivery within consulting or other client-facing environments, particularly at small or mid-sized firms
  • Demonstrated ability to communicate with engineers, business leaders, and executive stakeholders
  • Experience contributing to technical sales, proposals, estimates, and solution presentations
  • BA/BS in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent professional experience

Preferred Experience

  • Experience with containers, Docker, and Kubernetes
  • Microsoft Azure certifications, such as Azure Solutions Architect Expert or Azure Developer Associate
  • Experience integrating Azure AI services, Azure OpenAI, LLMs, RAG patterns, or other AI-enabled capabilities into production applications
  • Experience establishing AI-assisted software development standards, governance, or reusable delivery practices across multiple teams

Flexible Working Environment

We offer a flexible working model that allows employees to choose between remote work, on-site work at our offices in Boulder, CO, and Providence, RI, or a hybrid arrangement. We also welcome candidates based in Phoenix, AZ as we continue to expand our presence in the area.

This position is remote but requires candidates to reside in one of the following states: RI, CO, AZ, CT, FL, MA, MD, ME, MO, NC, NH, NJ, NV, NY, OR, PA, SC, TN, or UT. Preference will be given to candidates within commuting distance of our offices in Boulder, CO, or Providence, RI.

Benefits

  • Base salary of $145,000–$190,000
  • Medical and dental insurance
  • Flexible Spending Account
  • 401(k) with up to a 4% company match
  • Trust-based time off
  • Catered lunches when working in an office
  • Dedicated time for self-directed, non-client work
  • Dog-friendly offices
  • Remote, hybrid, or in-office working options
  • Paid conference attendance and annual education stipend
  • Generous family leave policy

raw.description:
Lyric is the trusted leader in healthcare decision intelligence. Built on more than 35 years of proven results, Lyric combines responsible AI with clinical, payment, regulatory, and policy expertise to deliver transparent, auditable insights in milliseconds across real-time claims workflows. Lyric augments human decision-making so health plans can make faster, more accurate payments while maintaining full control. Today, Lyric supports 200 million lives, with nine of the top 10 U.S. health plans relying on its platform to reduce waste, improve efficiency, and support accurate payments.

Applicants must already be legally authorized to work in the U.S. Visa sponsorship/sponsorship assumption and other immigration support are not available for this position.

Full-Stack Engineers serve as a frontline engineering owner for complex production and customer-impacting issues while building and improving our cloud-based platform end to end. This role combines hands-on support - triaging incidents, reproducing problems, analyzing telemetry and data, communicating status, and driving issues through resolution - with full-stack delivery across web applications, APIs, services, integrations, and databases.

This is an engineering role with meaningful production support responsibility, not a traditional help-desk position. The engineer is expected to translate incidents and recurring customer pain into durable code fixes, better observability, automation, and platform improvements.

Essential Job Responsibilities and Key Performance Outcomes

1. Production Support and Incident Ownership

  • Own escalated, high-impact production and customer issues from intake through resolution, including triage, severity assessment, reproduction, containment, mitigation, root-cause analysis, and follow-up.
  • Investigate issues across the full application stack using logs, traces, metrics, application code, API behavior, browser and service diagnostics, and database queries.
  • Translate ambiguous customer symptoms into testable hypotheses, clear technical findings, and actionable next steps; provide timely updates to internal stakeholders and, when needed, customers.
  • Use sound judgment when operating in production, following runbooks, least-privilege practices, change controls, and escalation procedures to minimize operational risk.
  • Produce high-quality root-cause analyses that explain what happened, why it happened, the impact, and the prevention plan; contribute to measurable improvements in time-to-mitigation and time-to-resolution.

2. Full-Stack Platform Engineering

  • Design, develop, test, and maintain platform capabilities across modern web interfaces, backend APIs, microservices, integrations, and data-access layers.
  • Build maintainable frontend experiences using JavaScript or TypeScript and a modern framework such as Angular or React, connecting them to secure, well-designed APIs and services.
  • Develop and debug backend services using C# and .NET, applying sound design patterns and engineering practices for performance, scalability, resilience, and maintainability.
  • Create, optimize, and maintain data structures, SQL queries, and data flows that support reliable application behavior and high-performance processing.
  • Integrate external services and APIs to extend platform functionality and interoperability.

3. Reliability and Continuous Improvement

  • Implement safe, durable fixes for production defects, including defensive code, improved error handling, stronger validation, enhanced logging, and automated recovery or monitoring where appropriate.
  • Proactively monitor platform health, identify emerging risks, and improve observability through useful dashboards, alerts, logs, traces, and metrics.
  • Create and maintain runbooks, technical documentation, and knowledge articles that improve support readiness and reduce repeat incidents.
  • Participate in the team's production support and incident response rotation as required.

4. Security, Quality, and Compliance

  • Implement and maintain secure development practices that protect sensitive data and support applicable privacy and compliance requirements, including HIPAA and HITRUST expectations.
  • Write well-tested, maintainable code; participate in code reviews; and follow established standards for source control, CI/CD, deployment, and change management.

5. Collaboration and Problem Solving

  • Partner with product managers, data analysts, support teams, engineers, and other stakeholders to align technical solutions with customer and business needs.
  • Resolve technical challenges independently within the scope of the role while proactively seeking guidance or escalating when broader architecture, risk, or business decisions are required.
  • File high-signal defect reports with clear reproduction steps, evidence, impact, and suspected components, and collaborate with teammates through closure.

Required Qualifications

  • At least two (2) years of professional full-stack software engineering experience building, supporting, and maintaining production applications.
  • Hands-on experience developing and debugging backend applications or services using C# and .NET.
  • Hands-on experience building web applications using JavaScript or TypeScript and a modern frontend framework such as Angular or React.
  • Experience designing, consuming, and troubleshooting RESTful APIs, services, or microservices.
  • 2 + years’ experience working with relational databases and SQL, including investigative queries, data validation, and basic performance awareness.
  • Experience troubleshooting production issues using application logs, metrics, traces, debugging tools, and disciplined root-cause analysis.
  • Experience working with at least one major cloud platform such as Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud.
  • 2 + years of experience working in a software development principled, design patterns, testing, security, scalability, and maintainability environment.
  • Bachelor's degree in software engineering, computer science, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting Azure-based .NET applications, including Azure Monitor, Application Insights, Log Analytics, or related observability workflows.
  • Experience with SQL Server, T-SQL, and SQL Server Management Studio (SSMS), including query optimization or performance troubleshooting.
  • Experience with containerized or orchestrated environments using Docker and Kubernetes.
  • Experience with DataDog or comparable monitoring, dashboarding, and alerting platforms.
  • Familiarity with Azure DevOps, Git-based workflows, pull requests, build pipelines, and CI/CD practices.
  • Experience with AWS, PostgreSQL, Snowflake, NoSQL technologies, or high-volume data-processing solutions.
  • Prior experience in healthcare technology, regulated environments, or customer-facing technical escalations.

What Success Looks Like

  • Customer-impacting issues are diagnosed, communicated, mitigated, and resolved with urgency, accuracy, and sound production judgment.
  • Full-stack features and fixes are delivered with strong quality, security, maintainability, and operational readiness.
  • Recurring issues decline because incident learnings are converted into code improvements, automation, better observability, and reusable documentation.
  • Engineering and business partners receive clear, high-signal technical information that supports timely decisions and durable solutions.

$104,368.00 - $156,551.00

Please note that the compensation details listed in US role postings reflect the base salary only, and does not reflect the value of the total rewards compensation. ***

Work location: Remote Clearance: The successful candidate is subject to a U.S. Federal Government background investigation and must be able to meet the requirements to hold a position of public trust. Responsibilities:

raw.description:
EHS Support is a specialty environmental consulting firm that provides solutions to complex environmental, health, and safety challenges across a range of market sectors and industries. With experts located throughout the United States, Canada, Australia, New Zealand, the United Kingdom, and South Africa, we form long-lasting partnerships with our clients through a culture of excellence, innovation, work ethic, and integrity. We focus on hiring and retaining talented, motivated people who enjoy collaborating with and delivering value to our clients. Our team does more than identify problems— we provide solutions.

Job Overview

This Principal Scientist opportunity is for a dynamic, growth-minded, results-oriented individual interested in leading development of the Ecological Services practice area within the Sediment and Risk Assessment (SRA) Service Line at EHS Support. As a Principal Scientist within our team, you will be joining a high-performance team of risk assessors, toxicologists, ecologists, scientists, and engineers that is focused on providing high-quality technical and strategic solutions to a variety of clients. In this role, you will be responsible for developing and growing our Ecological Services practice area by generating new business opportunities, building and fostering relationships with existing and prospective clients, and expanding the capacity and diversity of technical skillsets and service offerings of the team. You will also support ecological risk assessments for routine and complex scenarios under federal, state and international programs and compensatory services for Natural Resource Damage Assessment (NRDA). You will also be responsible for managing a team of talented professionals and providing mentorship and technical advisement to junior team members. The ideal candidate will have a strong environmental consulting background with demonstrated team-building and business development experience and a proven track record of corresponding sales. This position is remote, with a preference towards the northeast/mid-Atlantic region.

Essential Responsibilities

  • Lead the development and growth of the Ecological Services practice area in coordination with the Service Line Director and Growth Manager, Strategic Director, and other key team members by generating new business opportunities, building and fostering relationships with existing and prospective clients, and expanding the capacity and diversity of technical skillsets and service offerings of the team.
  • Lead the development and expansion of the Ecological Services practice area, including:
    • Wetlands and waterways delineation, permitting, restoration and valuation services
    • Natural resource impact assessments (National Environmental Policy Act [NEPA])
    • Threatened and endangered (T&E) species assessment
    • Biodiversity assessment and biological community assessment
    • Dam removal and river restoration
  • Support the design and implementation of site-specific ecological risk assessments conducted as part of remedial investigations, particularly contaminated sediment investigations, ensuring compliance with regulatory requirements under CERCLA, RCRA, or state programs.
  • Support NRDA services, including injury assessment and compensatory restoration planning.

Here is the Gist:

Wolfspeed is seeking a highly motivated Tax Manager to join our Corporate Tax team and manage the U.S. income tax function. This role will be responsible for leading income tax accounting under ASC 740, managing U.S. federal and multi-state income tax compliance, overseeing domestic tax audits and controversy matters, and supporting tax planning initiatives. The Tax Manager will play a critical role in the Company's quarterly and annual financial reporting process, partnering closely with Accounting, FP&A, Treasury, Legal, external auditors, and tax advisors to ensure accurate tax reporting and compliance.

The ideal candidate is a technically strong tax professional with public company experience, a solid understanding of ASC 740 income tax accounting and tax reporting requirements, excellent interpersonal skills, and the ability to translate complex tax matters into meaningful business insights for senior leadership. This position is eligible for remote work within the United States. Occasional travel may be required for team meetings, planning sessions, or other business needs.

The Day-to-Day

Income Tax Accounting & Financial Reporting

  • Lead the quarterly and annual income tax provision process in accordance with ASC 740
  • Prepare and review U.S. current and deferred income tax calculations
  • Manage accounting for uncertain tax positions (FIN 48 / ASC 740-10)
  • Perform effective tax rate (ETR) analyses and prepare clear explanations of period-over-period tax rate drivers
  • Prepare and review income tax footnote disclosures for SEC filings, including Forms 10-Q and 10-K
  • Support quarterly earnings processes by providing tax analyses, forecasts, and executive-level reporting materials
  • Coordinate with external auditors during quarterly reviews and year-end audits

U.S. Federal & State Tax Compliance

  • Own U.S. federal and multi-state corporate income tax compliance activities, including returns, extensions, estimated tax payments, and related filings
  • Manage relationships with external tax service providers responsible for the preparation of U.S. federal and state tax returns
  • Review key tax return components, including:
    • Schedule M adjustments
    • Fixed asset and depreciation calculations
    • Federal and state tax credits
    • State apportionment and nexus analyses
    • Tax return disclosures and supporting schedules
  • Ensure compliance with all applicable federal, state, and local tax filing requirements

Tax Audits & Controversy

  • Lead U.S. federal, state, and local income tax audits, examinations, notices, and controversy matters
  • Manage tax reserves associated with ongoing audits and controversies

Tax Planning & Technical Research

  • Support tax planning initiatives designed to optimize the Company's effective tax rate and cash tax position
  • Conduct technical research, tax reform analysis, and strategic planning projects and assess the impact on the Company

Internal Controls & Process Improvement

  • Support compliance with SOX 404 requirements, including maintaining and enhancing tax-related internal controls
  • Collaborate with Internal Audit and external auditors on control testing and documentation
  • Identify and implement opportunities to continuously improve tax processes through automation, standardization, and data analytics
  • Mentor and develop junior tax professionals while fostering a culture of accountability and operational excellence

Qualifications

Required

  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Taxation, or related field
  • Minimum of 6 years progressive tax experience in public accounting and/or a publicly traded multinational corporation
  • CPA certification or active progress towards certification
  • Strong technical expertise in:
    • ASC 740 Income Tax Accounting
    • FIN 48 / Uncertain Tax Positions
    • SEC reporting requirements (10-Q and 10-K)
    • U.S. Federal & Multi-State Corporate Income Tax Compliance
    • Tax audits and controversy management
  • Experience managing external tax advisors and service providers
  • Demonstrated ability to manage competing priorities under tight quarterly close deadlines
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills with the ability to interact effectively with senior leadership and external auditors

This role may require additional duties and/or assignments as designated by management

We are an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

Company :

Allegheny Health Network

Job Description :

GENERAL OVERVIEW:

This position performs reporting and analysis of the revenue cycle for monitoring and problem resolution; assists staff with internal and external system issues, audits and questions relative to accounts receivable; acts a primary liaison with other parties to resolve system issues and ensure compliance with all regulations; participates in department/system initiatives involving testing and other activities to ensure overall goals are met. Collaborates with facility/department leadership on a continuum basis. Activities include analysis (including root cause), monitoring & auditing, reporting & education with regards to Revenue Cycle training & problem resolution with all level of leadership including physicians, service line VP's, CAO's, CFO's etc. Establishes and implements appropriate internal controls to achieve complete and accurate documentation & billing processes; collaborates and helps to optimize clinical documentation through analysis and prioritized evaluation. Assists with maintaining the integrity of the CDM (charge description master) and the software program.

ESSENTIAL RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Responsible for financial, statistical and operational projects; present detailed analysis of A/R performance and other financial reports and related outcomes/trends; researches and validates clinical data used to support medical necessity of billed services, conducts quality assurance reviews of various billing components, technical requirements, supporting processes, systems and required documentation; reviews outcomes with wide array of people (i.e., Practice/clinical Directors, Practice/clinical Managers, senior leadership, Coding Manager, hospital case management, managed care contracting and RCC management) and influences adjustments to current facilities, practices.Assist with maintaining the integrity of the CDM (charge description master) and the software program. Performs other duties as assigned. (40%)
  • Performs ad hoc consultative research and coordination on current issues of Revenue Cycle regulatory risk including medical necessity denials; identifies a framework of continuous improvement to accomplish programmatic goals; facilitates meetings both internal and external; works collaboratively with system compliance leadership to coordinate and manage RAC and payer audit appeals. Serves as the Revenue Cycle regulatory liaison between the Practice and the RCC for efficient management of accounts receivable, point of service Revenue Cycle activity and all other areas within the Revenue Cycle area; serves as an internal audit consultant to clinical providers. Identifies barriers and implements corrective action measures in partnership with leaders to ensure positive outcomes. Provides ongoing guidance, training and support to practices and departmental Revenue Cycle staff. Works collaboratively with physicians, leadership, and health professionals to accomplish organization and Revenue Cycle and practice goals. (20%)
  • Responsible for monitoring and auditing of Revenue Cycle issues; monitor facility departments, Practices and RCC staff performance relative to current Revenue Cycle policies and procedures, including medical necessity issues of billed services through sample audits; research regulatory concepts for gaps and opportunities to improve Revenue Cycle compliance; identify under- and over-charge items for immediate resolution by the provider/practice; identify areas for risk as well as improvement - conducts assessments both desk level and on site. (10%)
  • Provides ongoing education to departments, practices and RCC staff concerning practice management system, coding and regulatory complexities (i.e., billing and A/R management workflows, policies and requirements); develops and implements action and educational plans to target resolution of Revenue Cycle issues; identify training needs as well as appropriate hand-off for designated topics; assist with training and implementation of PM system for newly acquired Hospitals, ASC's and practices relative to front-end Revenue Cycle edits or other systematic issues and supportive medical record documentation. (10%)
  • Collaborates with Compliance, Budget Office, Patient Accounts, Health Information Services, Internal Audit and other Revenue and Finance departments on revenue management initiatives. (10%)
  • Develops and maintains a Quality Audit program and associated reporting. Assists in performance of quality audits related to RI liason and charge review coordinators identified areas of opportunity. (10%)
  • Other duties as assigned.

QUALIFICATIONS:

Minimum

  • High School/GED
  • 1-3 years in hospital or physician revenue cycle, billing, coding or billing

Preferred

  • Bachelor's Degree in Business, Healthcare or related field
  • 1 year in Project Management
  • 1 year in a Epic-billing environment

YouTube & TikTok Content Creator - Education/Test Prep Content

Study.com is a leader in online education, helping millions of learners reach their academic and career goals. We're expanding our short-form and long-form video presence across **YouTube and TikTok.** We produce high-quality videos that teach test strategies, explain key concepts, walk learners through practice problems, and help adult learners make smarter education decisions.

We're looking for **confident, engaging on-camera presenters** who can work across both long-form (YouTube) and short-form (TikTok) formats — and make complex topics feel simple and approachable.

This is a remote, contract role. All work is paid per video.

You will record videos using scripts and practice problems we provide, across two formats:

  • YouTube long-form (typically under 10 minutes): test strategies, exam overviews, content explanations, and step-by-step practice problem walkthroughs.
  • TikTok short-form (~1 minute): fast-paced tips, hooks, quick problem demos, and career or degree-completion advice.

Examples of video topics:

  • 5 Easy Strategies to Stay Motivated for the Praxis Exam
  • Practice Problems for ASVAB Mathematics Knowledge
  • TOEFL® Speaking Task 1: How to Answer in 45 Seconds
  • How to Earn Your Bachelor's Degree in 2 Years with Degree Hacked

Your goal: make test prep and degree-completion content feel confident, approachable, and effective for adult learners.

No editing is required. We're looking for creators who are confident presenting clearly on camera.

What You'll Do

  • Record engaging, instructional videos for YouTube (long-form) and TikTok (short-form).
  • Deliver content in a clear, concise, and encouraging style.
  • Maintain a consistent, professional on-screen presence.
  • Demonstrate educational concepts using a dry-erase board, tablet/stylus, or pen-and-paper with clear and readable handwriting.
  • Follow Study.com's brand and presenter guidelines.
  • Incorporate feedback and revise delivery as needed.

Required Skills & Qualifications

  • Education: High school diploma or GED
  • Video experience: Proven experience creating content for YouTube, TikTok, or similar platforms — including both short-form (vertical 9:16) and long-form (16:9) work
  • On-camera skills: Confident, natural presenter who can explain complex ideas simply and connect with the viewer
  • Equipment:
    • Reliable camera (smartphone or dedicated camera with HD 1080p minimum)
    • External microphone for clear audio
    • Good lighting for recording
    • Tablet/stylus or dry-erase board (and printer if needed) for demonstrations and practice problem walkthroughs
  • Professionalism: Able to work independently, meet deadlines, and respond constructively to feedback

Preferred Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree or advanced expertise in test-prep subject areas
  • Experience working from scripts or writing instructional scripts
  • Background creating educational or tutorial content
  • Experience presenting to adult or nontraditional learners
  • Familiarity with short-form content pacing, hooks, and trends
  • Military experience (current or former service) is a plus for ASVAB content, not required
  • Expertise in at least one subject area relevant to our channels, such as:
    • Core academic subjects (Math, ELA, Reading, Science)
    • Military test-prep topics (Electronics, Mechanical Comprehension, Auto & Shop)
    • K–12 teaching content for certification exams (Praxis, TExES, FTCE, CSET)
    • English-language instruction (TOEFL®)

What We Offer:

  • Reliable Payments: You'll receive payments twice a month and automated invoicing for your work.
  • Remote Work: This is a fully online contracted work-from-home opportunity.
  • Flexibility: Basically, there are no requirements! Work when you want, where you want, as often as you want, with no minimums/maximums.
  • Support: Our supportive staff is available answer your questions and help you get up and running.

The Contract Process

  1. Complete the application and submit with your resume.
  2. Applications are approved and contracts sent on Wednesdays.
  3. Submit the contract within the 5-day signing window.
  4. The following Wednesday, you’ll receive onboarding instructions.

You can view a step-by-step overview of the contract process here: How to Become a Freelancer with Study.com

About Study.com

The mission of Study.com is to make education accessible, and over the last two decades we’ve become the leading online education platform, delivering a personalized learning experience across a broad continuum of education for over 30 million students, instructors, and professionals every month.

We help empower millions of learners to achieve their education and career goals. We focus on increasing access to education because we know information is the ultimate equalizer and that education is key to upward mobility.

Feel free to share this opportunity with any friends you think would be interested, too.

Description

Ledgebrook is an InsurTech MGA on a mission to bring Specialty insurance into the modern era. Burdened with legacy technology and processes, the industry has not kept pace with the speed of innovation seen in other sectors. Positioned at the cutting edge of the next generation of InsurTech, Ledgebrook offers the best of both worlds: innovative world-class technology deployed by a leadership team armed with over 100 years of insurance expertise.

About the Role

We’re looking for a Staff Software Engineer to serve as the technical leader for software spanning multiple business and engineering workflows. You will architect and build cross-functional solutions, establish shared technical patterns, and guide teams through complex design and implementation decisions. This is a hands-on role: you will write production code, build foundational capabilities, and ensure solutions are scalable, maintainable, and aligned with the broader technology strategy.

What you’ll do

  • Shape architecture and technical direction across underwriting, rating, claims, and shared services: lead design reviews that raise the org’s bar, move to wherever staff-level depth is most needed, advise strongly without becoming an approval bottleneck, and escalate only when it matters.
  • Drive wide-reaching technical initiatives end to end; clearly communicate the why, what, and how (plus value, status, and progress) to stakeholders at all levels.
  • Design and implement critical frontend and backend components using TypeScript/JavaScript (Node.js) and Python; deep-dive into complex systems while connecting technical excellence to business outcomes.
  • Partner with product managers, designers, engineering managers, and domain experts to turn ambiguous business problems into scalable, maintainable solutions.
  • Raise engineering quality through design docs, code review, observability, and CI/CD practices, helping us be first to know and quick to fix when something breaks.
  • Mentor senior engineers and act as a force multiplier: unblock teams, transfer institutional knowledge, and help others grow toward staff-level impact.
  • Apply sound build-vs-buy judgment; invest engineering effort where it improves underwriter speed and rating/data capability, and prefer proven “boring” technology unless there is a compelling reason to do otherwise.
  • Design and ship LLM-powered workflows that measurably improve underwriter and operator productivity.

About you

Here at Ledgebrook we are passionate about creating a team that is on a continuous learning journey and that shares our excitement about building a company from the ground up. Some of the characteristics we hold dear are:

  • A passion to deliver a world-class customer service experience to both internal and external customers
  • Intellectual curiosity and a desire to innovate processes/procedures versus being satisfied with the status quo
  • A desire to continue learning whatever your career stage
  • Agile prioritization skills coupled with a keen sense of urgency that seeks to balance getting it right versus getting it done right now
  • A strong drive and desire to win together as a high-performing team
  • A moral compass to “do the right thing, period”, we have zero tolerance for toxic behaviors.

Requirements

Must haves

  • ﻿8+ years of software engineering experience, including demonstrated Staff-level (or equivalent) impact: shaping architecture and initiatives across multiple components or teams, not only delivering features within a single team
  • Proven leadership of ambiguous, multi-quarter technical bets that cut across teams: defining the problem, aligning stakeholders, and delivering durable outcomes
  • Proven ability to design end-to-end systems and data models from business domain use cases, with a strong focus on maintainability, testability, and long-term operability
  • A strong systems mindset: you design for extensibility, scalability, and performance, and you make the judgment call on how much of that is warranted at the current stage of the product rather than over-building for a scale we do not have yet
  • Track record as a force multiplier: elevating peers through architecture reviews, mentorship, and clear technical communication of why / what / how
  • Strong full-stack fluency (TypeScript/JavaScript and Python preferred) and the judgment to deep-dive into the hardest problems while keeping portfolio-level outcomes in view
  • Experience with CI/CD (GitHub Actions, AWS CodePipeline, Jenkins, or similar) and production debugging/observability
  • Excellent verbal and written communication; ability to influence without authority across engineering, product, and business partners
  • Demonstrated ability to break down complex, ambiguous technical work into consumable pieces for delivery teams and sequence it by value and dependency

Nice to haves

  • ﻿Prior startup or high-growth experience
  • Experience with insurance, fintech, or other regulated domain complexity (especially pricing/rating, underwriting workflows, or policy systems)
  • Depth in web technologies and frameworks (JS/TS, HTML, CSS/SCSS, React, Angular, Node.js)
  • Experience designing systems that integrate third-party platforms (policy admin, data enrichment, document generation) with a buy-over-build mindset where appropriate

Benefits

  • Full remote flexibility and asynchronous work culture
  • Unlimited PTO and fully paid sick leave
  • Comprehensive health benefits, including medical, dental, and vision coverage, plus HSA and FSA options
  • Additional financial protection and retirement benefits, including a 401(k), company-paid life insurance, and disability coverage
  • A high degree of ownership, autonomy, and the opportunity to help build and shape a growing company
  • The chance to make a meaningful impact while working alongside an ambitious, high-performing team
  • Exposure to the challenges and opportunities of a fast-growing startup environment

Compensation

  • Base Salary Range $150,000-200,000 This is a good-faith compensation range based on what Ledgebrook reasonably expects to pay for this position at the time of this posting. Actual compensation may vary based on a variety of relevant factors including experience, qualifications, geographic location and other relevant factors.
  • Employees in this position are eligible to participate in Ledgebrook’s equity incentive program.

Please note: This position is open only to candidates who are authorized to work in the United States without the need for current or future employer-sponsored work authorization. We are unable to offer sponsorship at this time.

raw.description:
Als IT-Dienstleister treiben wir die Digitalisierung des öffentlichen Sektors voran und schaffen echten Mehrwert für Millionen Menschen in Deutschland. Wir können vieles richtig gut, aber eben noch nicht alles. Darum suchen wir immer wieder neue Kolleg:innen, die mit ihren Ideen, ihrem Können und Engagement etwas bewegen wollen. Fühlst du dich angesprochen? Dann gestalte Deine Welt zum Besseren und werde Teil unseres Customer Cluster Environment, Transportation & Energy.

DEINE MISSION

Als AI Solution Architect (m/w/d) gestaltest Du die KI-/ML-Gesamtarchitektur für komplexe Enterprise-Umgebungen in der Cloud mit Schwerpunkt Microsoft Azure. Du verbindest fundiertes Know-how in ML Engineering, RAG-Architekturen und MLOps, um KI-Lösungen produktionsreif, skalierbar und sicher umzusetzen. Dabei arbeitest Du eng mit technischen Expert:innen, Fachbereichen und Entscheidungsträgern zusammen und trägst maßgeblich dazu bei, innovative KI-Lösungen erfolgreich zu etablieren.

Deine Aufgaben:

  • Entwurf und Weiterentwicklung der KI-/ML-Gesamtarchitektur als Enterprise-KI-Plattform mit Schwerpunkt Microsoft Azure

  • Technische Leitung von ML-Pipeline-Projekten, insbesondere in den Bereichen Training, Deployment, Monitoring und Drift Detection

  • Konzeption und Optimierung von RAG-Architekturen, beispielsweise hinsichtlich Chunking, Retrieval, Guardrails und Context Orchestration

  • Definition und Weiterentwicklung von MLOps-Strategien einschließlich CI/CD für Modelle, Experiment-Tracking und Model Registry

  • Technische Führung und Koordination interdisziplinärer Teams aus ML/AI Engineers, LLM Engineers und MLOps Engineers

  • Beratung interner und externer Stakeholder zu KI-Architekturen sowie Präsentation technischer Konzepte gegenüber IT-Leitung und Fachbereichen

DAS IST UNS WICHTIG

  • Fundierte Erfahrung mit cloudbasierten KI-/ML-Lösungen, idealerweise auf Microsoft Azure, insbesondere Azure Machine Learning und Azure OpenAI Service. Kenntnisse weiterer Cloud- und AI-Services sind von Vorteil.

  • Praktische Erfahrung mit MLOps-Konzepten und entsprechenden Werkzeugen wie MLflow, Kubeflow oder Azure ML Pipelines.

  • Erfahrung im Aufbau von RAG-Architekturen, Prompt Engineering und im Umgang mit Vektordatenbanken.

  • Kenntnisse in der Integration und Orchestrierung von Sprachmodellen, idealerweise mit Frameworks wie LangChain oder LlamaIndex.

  • Erfahrung mit CI/CD für ML-Anwendungen sowie sehr gute Python-Kenntnisse.

  • Praktische Erfahrung mit mindestens zwei gängigen Machine-Learning-Frameworks, beispielsweise scikit-learn, PyTorch oder TensorFlow.

  • Erfahrung im Aufbau von Enterprise-Architekturen in Cloud-Umgebungen.

  • Kenntnisse in angrenzenden Bereichen wie Datenplattformen, Containerisierung, Container-Orchestrierung, Infrastructure as Code und Observability sind von Vorteil, beispielsweise mit Databricks, Azure Data Factory, Azure Data Lake, Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, Prometheus, Grafana oder Application Insights.

  • Grundlegendes Verständnis von AI Governance, Responsible AI sowie Sicherheits- und Datenschutzanforderungen im Enterprise-Umfeld.

  • Mehrjährige Erfahrung mit ML-/AI-Architekturen oder vergleichbaren technischen Aufgaben in Enterprise-Umgebungen.

  • Erfahrung in einer technischen Leitungs- oder Architekturrolle ist wünschenswert.

  • Azure-, AWS- oder Google-Cloud-Zertifizierungen sind ein Plus.

  • Idealerweise Erfahrung in der Energiebranche oder Versorgungswirtschaft sowie mit datengetriebenen Anwendungsfällen.

  • Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse (C2-Niveau) sowie gute Englischkenntnisse.

DEIN NEUER ARBEITSPLATZ

  • Was bei uns zählt? Klar definierte Rollen, echtes Miteinander und ein gemeinsames Ziel. Wir nennen das Responsiveness – transparent, wertschätzend und zielorientiert.

  • Hier bist du am Wandel direkt beteiligt, wenn du möchtest. – Nimm Teil an Projekten, die uns als Unternehmen weiterentwickeln.

  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten und Remote Work? – Sind selbstverständlich.

  • Individuelles Hardware-Budget? – Stell dir deinen Arbeitsplatz so zusammen, wie du dich am wohlsten fühlst.

  • Mental Health? – Dein mentales Wohlbefinden ist uns wichtig. Mit OpenUp unterstützen wir dich und bieten dir jederzeit kostenlosen Zugang zu professioneller psychologischer Unterstützung.

  • Individuelles Weiterbildungsbudget? – Egal ob die nächste Zertifizierung oder ein lang ersehnter Sprachkurs – du entscheidest, worin und wann du dich weiterbildest.

  • Mitarbeiter:innen-PC-Programm? – Lease dir dein nächstes Device zur rein privaten Nutzung einfach über virtual7.

  • JobRad oder Firmenwagen? – Wir helfen dir dabei, so mobil zu sein, wie du es brauchst.

Requirements

Erzähl mir, wer du bist und wann du anfangen kannst. Gerne auch über . Ich freue mich darauf, dich kennenzulernen.

Laura Korth

Senior HR Recruiterin

+49 170 3600221

What you'll do

Preferred

Benefits

raw.excerpt: Position Summary:The Director, CDx Regulatory Consultant will be responsible for applying deep expertise in companion diagnostic regulatory strategy, IVD development, quality system expectations, and global marketing authorization pathways to advise pharmaceutical, biotechnology, and diagnostic clients on the development, clinical trial use, approval, and lifecycle management of companion diagnostics.
raw.description:
Position Summary:

The Director, CDx Regulatory Consultant will be responsible for applying deep expertise in companion diagnostic regulatory strategy, IVD development, quality system expectations, and global marketing authorization pathways to advise pharmaceutical, biotechnology, and diagnostic clients on the development, clinical trial use, approval, and lifecycle management of companion diagnostics. This role will translate complex FDA, EU IVDR, and other global regulatory requirements into practical, actionable strategies that support Rx Dx co-development, patient selection assays, analytical and clinical validation planning, clinical trial enabling submissions, and coordinated diagnostic and therapeutic commercialization.

Essential functions of the job include but are not limited to:

Consulting Services

  • Serve as the CDx regulatory subject matter expert for strategic positioning of client programs inclusive of CDx, including relevant FDA precedents, EU IVDR considerations, global submission expectations, and diagnostic commercialization pathways.
  • Proactively identify client needs by understanding the therapeutic program, biomarker strategy, intended use population, assay technology, clinical trial design, and commercial objectives.
  • Lead consulting engagements with pharmaceutical clients to develop global CDx regulatory strategies, integrated development roadmaps, submission pathways, and milestone-based timelines that support clinical trial execution, regulatory authorization, and commercialization objectives.
  • Partner cross-functionally with therapeutic development teams, diagnostic manufacturers, laboratories, biostatistics, clinical operations, quality assurance, and commercial stakeholders to ensure CDx development activities are coordinated with overall program timelines and regulatory expectations.
  • Develop integrated Rx Dx regulatory strategies that align diagnostic development, biomarker strategy, clinical trial enrollment, therapeutic development milestones, and commercialization objectives for pharmaceutical, biotechnology, and diagnostic clients.
  • Advise clients on regulatory requirements for use of assays in clinical trials, including patient selection, inclusion or exclusion testing, significant risk and nonsignificant risk determinations, IRB considerations, investigational device requirements, and global performance study obligations.
  • Direct the preparation of global regulatory submissions and supporting documentation for companion diagnostics and clinical trial assays, including FDA Q-Submissions, Pre-IDE packages, IDEs, PMAs, PMA supplements, EU IVDR Annex XIV performance study applications, technical documentation, and other country-specific submissions.
  • Lead interactions with regulatory authorities and notified bodies, including preparation for FDA meetings, interpretation of agency feedback, development of response strategies, meeting minutes, and follow-up communications on behalf of clients.
  • Review and direct the development of analytical validation plans, clinical performance study plans, diagnostic clinical protocols, statistical analysis synopses, technical reports, intended use statements, labeling, and other submission-ready documents for CDx programs.
  • Apply IVD quality system, design control, risk management, and post-market regulatory expertise to support CDx readiness from early development through approval, launch, and lifecycle management.
  • Stay current on CDx regulatory, scientific, and market developments, including FDA guidance, EU IVDR implementation, notified body expectations, global regulatory trends, diagnostic precedents, and evolving precision medicine requirements.

Business Development

  • Generate new CDx regulatory consulting opportunities through established relationships with pharmaceutical, biotechnology, diagnostic, laboratory, and precision medicine stakeholders.
  • Partner with the business development team to evaluate CDx and clinical trial assay requests for proposals, identify regulatory assumptions, assess key risks, and define submission strategies and approval timelines.
  • Support bid defense meetings by clearly communicating the CDx regulatory pathway, clinical trial assay considerations, submission risks, agency interaction strategy, and value proposition to prospective clients.
  • Advise on work orders, change orders, master service agreements, and other contract documents to ensure CDx regulatory scope, deliverables, assumptions, and client responsibilities are clearly defined.
  • Lead client workshops, scientific conference sessions, and educational presentations focused on CDx development, Rx Dx co-development, clinical trial assay strategy, and global IVD regulatory requirements.

Administrative

  • Ensure the quality, consistency, and regulatory accuracy of all CDx strategy documents, client deliverables, submissions, meeting materials, and other consulting work products in accordance with corporate standards.
  • Time entry and following SOPs
  • Manage, mentor, motivate, and develop regulatory consulting staff to support a scalable CDx and IVD regulatory consulting practice.
  • Support and contribute to a collaborative, client-focused consulting culture that advances Precision for Medicine’s CDx, IVD, and precision medicine regulatory capabilities.

Qualifications:

Minimum Required:

  • Bachelor’s degree in life sciences, molecular biology, genetics, pathology, laboratory medicine, regulatory affairs, or a related scientific discipline; equivalent relevant experience may be considered.
  • Minimum 5 years of applicable consulting experience with a primary focus in IVD, companion diagnostic, clinical trial assay, or precision medicine regulatory affairs.

Other Required:

  • Minimum of 7 years of experience in an in vitro diagnostic, companion diagnostic, pharmaceutical, or regulatory consulting environment.
  • Direct experience working with diagnostic manufacturers/labs and pharmaceutical sponsors to design global regulatory and commercialization strategies for companion diagnostics and clinical trial assays.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with demonstrated ability to translate complex CDx regulatory requirements into clear, practical recommendations for clients and cross-functional teams.
  • Strong scientific and analytical skills, including the ability to interpret biomarker, assay validation, clinical performance, and diagnostic clinical trial information in support of CDx regulatory strategy.
  • Ability to solve complex CDx regulatory, clinical trial assay, submission, and commercialization challenges with practical, risk-based solutions.
  • Strong leadership, team building, and interpersonal skills, including the ability to guide multidisciplinary teams across diagnostic development, therapeutic development, regulatory, quality, clinical, laboratory, and commercial functions.

Preferred:

Master’s degree or higher in life sciences, molecular diagnostics, regulatory affairs, public health, laboratory medicine, pathology, or a related discipline.

RAC certification

raw.excerpt: The Program Manager plays a critical role in leading strategic accreditation and curriculum initiatives across all programs, all modalities, and all degree levels within the School of Nursing and Health Sciences (SONHS) portfolio.
raw.description:
The Program Manager plays a critical role in leading strategic accreditation and curriculum initiatives across all programs, all modalities, and all degree levels within the School of Nursing and Health Sciences (SONHS) portfolio. Reporting to the Dean SONHS, this individual will drive portfolio-level program management efforts, ensuring alignment with institutional accreditation standards, licensure, and curriculum excellence.
Working collaboratively across the SONHS portfolio, the Program Manager partners with Academic Leadership, Institutional Effectiveness, University teams, and key stakeholders—including Program Directors (PDs), Core Faculty, Assistant/Associate Deans, and Faculty Directors—to support curriculum alignment with professional standards and portfolio metrics. Additionally, they serve as a liaison to multiple internal stakeholders to ensure seamless coordination of curriculum and accreditation efforts.
In this high-visibility role with regular executive leadership interaction, the Program Manager creates, manages, and executes detailed program schedules, reports, and analyses to track milestones and inform stakeholders. They demonstrate strategic thinking to mitigate risks, maximize program benefits, and enhance continuous process improvement efforts for greater effectiveness and efficiency.
Thriving in a fast-paced environment, the Program Manager must possess strong communication and relationship-building skills, exercising cross-functional leadership to solve complex challenges. Their ability to drive strategic initiatives ensures that all projects align with organizational goals while advancing excellence across the portfolio.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities:

Accreditation Oversight & Compliance:

  • Monitor new and existing compliance efforts, including accreditation, licensure, and state requirements across the portfolio ensuring ongoing compliance with external and institutional standards.
  • Develop and maintain accreditation documentation, including systematic evaluation plans and self-study reports.
  • Act as a liaison between Accreditation, Institutional Effectiveness, Office of the Provost’s vertical, and other university teams to support accreditation-related initiatives.
  • Design templates and artifacts to enhance data collection and evidence gathering for accreditation processes.
  • Ensure SoNHS alignment with HLC best practices in all aspects of curriculum and accreditation standards.

Curriculum Development & Academic Quality:

  • Maintain the SONHS Curriculum Roadmap and collaborate with course development team to ensure accuracy of investment needs.
  • Partner with deans and program directors on course development strategy including course prioritization, forecasting of course development needs ensuring alignment with university design principles and external accreditation requirements.
  • Collaborate with Program directors to support subject matter expert (SME) course development and leadership.
  • Partner with Program Directors, Core Faculty, Assistant/Associate Deans, and Faculty Directors to ensure academic programs are professionally relevant, current, and cohesive.
  • Utilize analytics and evidence-based practices to drive continuous improvements in learner success, teaching effectiveness, engagement, and curriculum design.

Strategic Leadership & Process Improvement:

  • Monitor all SoNHS accreditation and curriculum-related projects, ensuring milestones are met and progress is effectively tracked.
  • Provide strategic oversight of the shared governance model, serving as the primary liaison between councils to ensure effective coordination and decision-making across academic and operational functions.
  • Collaborate with academic leadership on strategic program management efforts to align accreditation requirements with business and academic strategies.
  • Identify and address risks while optimizing program benefits through strategic thinking and problem-solving.
  • Deliver detailed program schedules, reports, and analyses to keep stakeholders informed and engaged.
  • Champion continuous process improvement initiatives that enhance institutional effectiveness and curriculum delivery.
  • Collaborate with multi-functional teams, including academic leadership, institutional effectiveness, course development, faculty excellence, and learner affairs, to ensure alignment across key initiatives.

Job Skills:

  • Education — Knowledge of principles and methods for curriculum development, andragogy, and assessment.
    • Knowledge of online teaching, competency-based education, and direct assessment.
    • Discipline knowledge.
    • Ability to objectively analyze program/course quality data and implement recommendations relevant to improving learner outcomes.
    • Ability to maintain program compliance with all regulatory rules, and national program accreditation standards.
    • Familiarity with program development and evaluation.
    • Ability to advise and assess learning effectiveness and quality of the education experience.
  • Navigation --Resolve multi-faceted types of problems encountered involving courses, faculty, regulatory or administrative issues.
  • Adaptability/Flexibility — Open to change.
    • Drive results despite ambiguity.
  • Innovation — Creativity and alternative thinking to develop new ideas for and answers to work-related problems.
  • Stress Tolerance —Ability to accept constructive criticism and deal with high stress situations.
  • Leadership - Ability to operate independently (leading, collaborating and executing) in a highly ambiguous, matrixed environment with high interdependencies.
    • Be a doer, focused not just on thought partnership but on getting things done and executing both independently and with others.
    • Lead by listening, be highly collaborative, and productively contribute opinions to critical decision-making processes.
    • Act independently to achieve results in support of business goals and strategies with a program area.
  • Be proficient in Microsoft Office Suite programs

Work Experience:

  • Minimum of 3 years of teaching experience in higher education required.
  • Experience with nursing or health sciences accreditation and regulatory compliance, including self-study reports, evidence collection, site visits, accreditation reviews (e.g., CCNE, ACEN, CEPH), and state, institutional, and national requirements required.
  • Experience in accredited nursing program leading to professional licensure such as ADN, BSN, or Nurse Practitioner required.
  • Experience collaborating with academic leaders, faculty, program directors, instructional designers, and subject matter experts to support curriculum development, academic quality, and program effectiveness required.
  • Experience developing, implementing, evaluating, and revising undergraduate and/or graduate nursing or health sciences competency-based education (CBE) curricula required.
  • Experience analyzing assessment data, learner outcomes, retention metrics, faculty performance, and program effectiveness measures to drive continuous improvement and informed decision-making preferred.
  • Demonstrated success in assuming stretch assignments beyond primary job responsibilities including leading accreditation efforts, curriculum revisions, quality improvement projects, or cross-functional academic initiatives preferred.
  • Experience managing multiple projects, timelines, milestones, and deliverables in a complex academic environment preferred.
  • Demonstrated success working within shared governance structures and collaborating across cross-functional teams, including faculty committees, academic councils, academic affairs, and administrative departments preferred.
  • Experience developing policies, procedures, templates, and documentation to support accreditation, compliance, and academic quality initiatives preferred.​

Education:

  • Doctoral degree (PhD, EdD, DNP, or related terminal degree) from an accredited institution required.
  • Master of Science in Nursing (MSN) from an accredited institution required.
  • All degrees must be conferred by an institution accredited by an accrediting agency recognized by the U.S. Department of Education.

Other:

  • Must be able to travel occasionally should a business need arise. For most roles travel would not be common. Travel may involve plane, car or metro. In accordance with ADA policies, reasonable accommodations regarding travel limitations can be provided. Travel will be more common for roles such as Account Executives (25 - 50%), senior leaders (10 – 20%) or Capella Core Faculty (5 – 10%).
  • Ability to work onsite in Corporate or Campus location (in a typical office environment) may be required based on role. If so, this would include being mobile within the office, including movement from floor-to-floor using elevators or stairs.
  • If offsite or hybrid role, must have access to work in setting which enables meeting all requirements of the role (including privacy, reliable internet access, phone, ability to video conference, etc.) at a remote location.
  • Faculty and Federal Work Study roles require access to work in setting which enables meeting all requirements of the role (including computer, privacy, reliable internet access, phone, ability to video conference, etc.) at a remote location.
  • This role may require lifting, however reasonable accommodations will be provided in accordance with our ADA policies.
  • Must be able to meet critical thinking and problem solving aspects aligned to job duties, as well as effectively communicating with co-workers.
  • Must be able to work more than 40 hours per week when business needs warrant. Accommodations related to schedule may be considered.
  • Able to access information using a computer.
  • Other essential functions and marginal job functions are subject to modification.

raw.description:
CodePath is the largest educator of college computer science students in the country. We've trained over 40,000 students from 1,000+ universities, and our partners include Amazon, Google, and other leading technology companies. We've spent nearly a decade training the next generation of technical talent, and we just launched a $150M initiative with Anthropic, building one of the most ambitious AI workforce programs in the world.

We're now expanding into new markets and scaling our team so we can move at the speed AI is transforming the workforce. People joining CodePath now will have the opportunity to help architect the next frontier of our work.

We believe technical skill is the fastest way to turn raw talent into real opportunity. We train the engineers the AI era runs on, building toward millions of learners, hundreds of millions in revenue, and billions in economic impact. If you want to own something and be part of a 0-to-1 journey at an organization moving at the speed of AI, this is the place to build it.

About the Role

Location: Remote (U.S.)

Role Type: Full-Time

Reporting to: Head of People

Compensation: $110,000 to $150,000 per year

Manages: A pod of early-talent recruiters plus fractional HR coordination support

Key Activities

Claude Corps is a fellowship that places early-career technologists inside nonprofits, government agencies, and public-interest organizations to build AI solutions that keep working after the fellow leaves. It runs as a partnership between Anthropic, CodePath, and Social Finance, backed by a $150M initiative with Anthropic. CodePath is the Employer of Record: we own the full fellow lifecycle, from recruiting and selection through employment, onboarding, benefits, and host support.
Cohort 1 places 100 fellows. The program scales toward 1,000 fellows in year one and 10,000 by year three. This role builds the pod that makes that scale real.

Why this role, now

Claude Corps needs one person accountable for how fellows get hired and how they get employed. Not a strategic HR seat at a distance from the work, and not a recruiting manager who hands off at the offer. A pod lead, running a small team that carries both.

You'll manage the recruiters screening early talent, and you'll manage the fractional HR coordination support that turns an accepted offer into a real employee. Where the program touches the person, you and the Claude Corps program managers work the case together: performance concerns, employee relations, a placement that isn't landing. You bring the process and the employment side. They bring the day-to-day context and the host relationship. Both names are on the outcome.

The math is the other half of the job. We go from 100 fellows to 1,000 to 10,000, and the pod does not grow 100x to match. A team this size clears that volume by building AI into the work: screening support, scheduling, candidate communication, onboarding packets, compliance tracking, the reporting that eats a coordinator's week. We train people to build with AI. We expect the people running our own operations to do the same.
The pod is small in Cohort 1. It grows with the cohorts, and how much it has to grow is partly up to you.

What you will own

Lead the pod. Manage the fractional early-talent recruiters and the HR coordinators supporting Claude Corps. Set the week's priorities, run the load-balancing when a cohort deadline compresses, coach against the bar, and grow the team's headcount and capability as cohorts scale. Fractional support means you are explicit about what you're buying with those hours and what falls to you.

Own screening and selection. Run the funnel from application review through offer, against the program's selection rubric and calibration process. Keep throughput honest: the pod moves volume, and you hold the line on signal quality and candidate experience while it does.

Own the employer-of-record lifecycle. Offers and e-sign, background checks, I-9 and work authorization, payroll setup, benefits enrollment, onboarding. Fellows are CodePath employees, and the experience should feel like it. You direct this work through the fractional coordinators rather than doing all of it yourself.

Use AI to hold the ratio. Find the repetitive work in recruiting and HR ops and get it automated or AI-assisted: resume screening support, interview scheduling, candidate comms, offer and onboarding document generation, multi-state compliance tracking, cohort reporting. Judgment calls stay with humans, and you decide where that line sits. Come with a bias toward trying things, and bring the team along so the whole pod works this way, not just you.

Co-own employee relations and performance with program management. When a fellow's performance or conduct needs attention, you and the program manager run it together. You own documentation, process, consistency, and the employment decisions that follow. The PM owns the host relationship and what's actually happening on the ground. Escalate to the Head of People when the situation warrants it, and know where that line is.

Build the systems. Turn one-cohort processes into repeatable operations: screening workflows, HR SLAs, multi-state compliance, and clean handoffs with our program partners. Bring a point of view on what to standardize and what to leave flexible while the program is still forming

Who you are

  • 5+ years across recruiting and HR or people operations, including time owning both, not just one
  • You've managed people, and you've managed through others' capacity, including contractors, shared services, or fractional support
  • You've run high-volume or early-talent hiring, and you've owned HR operations (payroll, benefits, compliance, onboarding). Employer-of-record, PEO, or multi-state employment experience is a strong plus
  • You already use AI in your own work and can point to something you automated or rebuilt with it. Comfort with ATS and HRIS configuration, workflow automation, and prompting is expected, not a bonus
  • You've handled employee relations and performance conversations, and you're steady in them
  • You're comfortable in a program that is still being built. You bring structure without waiting for someone else to hand it to you
  • You hold a high bar on quality and candidate experience at the same time
  • You communicate directly and work well across partner organizations with different systems and cultures
  • You care about the mission: expanding who gets to build with AI, and doing right by the people you employ

What success looks like

  • Each cohort is screened and hired on time, at target size, without cutting corners on signal quality
  • The employment lifecycle runs cleanly: offers, onboarding, payroll, and benefits land on time and compliant across every state we hire in
  • Cost and hours per fellow hired and onboarded drop cohort over cohort, because the work got automated and not because the team absorbed it
  • Performance and ER issues get handled early, documented consistently, and resolved with the program manager rather than around them
  • The pod grows in capability and ownership as the program scales, and the fractional support model either scales with it or you make the case for what replaces it

Full-Time Employee Benefits

This is a 100% remote position—work from anywhere in the U.S.! CodePath prioritizes employee well-being with a competitive benefits package to support your health, financial security, and work-life balance.

  • Health & Wellness: Medical, dental, and vision insurance (90% employer-covered for employees and dependents), employer-funded healthcare reimbursement, FSAs, and Employee Assistance Program

  • Financial Security: 401(k), employer-paid life & disability insurance, and identity theft protection

  • Work-Life Balance: Generous PTO, paid holidays, 10 weeks of fully paid parental leave, and an annual year-end company closure (Dec 24 – Jan 2)

  • Professional Growth: $1,000 annual professional development stipend and home office setup support

  • ​​Student Loan Forgiveness: CodePath is a qualifying employer for Public Service Loan Forgiveness (PSLF), helping employees manage student loan debt

  • Additional Perks: Pet wellness plans, legal services, home/auto insurance discounts, and exclusive marketplace savings

Pay range
$110,000—$150,000 USD
