Mindrift is looking for a versatile, highly skilled Graphic Designer to join the Tendem project (**) andcreate high-quality visual assets for real-world use cases. In this role, you'll apply your expertise in visual communication, layout design, and branding to transform ideas into professional, polished creative assets. This part-time remote opportunity is ideal for creative professionals with hands-on experience in visual communications, layout design, and creating diverse marketing materials.

What We Do

The Mindrift platform connects specialists with innovative technology projects. Our mission is to help develop high-quality AI technologies by combining real-world expertise from professionals across the globe with advanced AI development efforts.

About the Role

This is a freelance role for a Tendem project. As a Graphic Designer, your focus will be on layouts, infographics, social media templates, and overall visual polish. We need a versatile, all-around graphic designer to handle diverse visual tasks, utilizing industry-standard tools to structure information cleanly and effectively.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own the creation of clean layouts, modern infographics, and establish a clear visual hierarchy to ensure readable and engaging content.
  • Design highly engaging, reusable templates for various social media channels, as well as impactful one-pagers.
  • Elevate everyday materials by working deeply with advanced typography, grid systems, and thoughtful composition.
  • Transform raw data and concepts into professional, polished visual assets tailored to specific marketing and communication goals.
  • Enforce design quality standards through systematic verification of visual alignment, color usage, and layout consistency prior to delivery.

Important note

Please submit your CV in English. Your CV must include a link to your portfolio with examples of your work — applications without a portfolio link will not be considered.

This is project-based freelance work. Tasks are available only when projects are active. You may be invited to one or more projects depending on your profile and current opportunities.

How to get started

Simply apply to this post, complete the qualification process, and get the chance to contribute to projects aligned with your skills — on your own schedule.

Requirements

Educational qualifications

  • At least 1-2 years of relevant experience in graphic design, digital design, or visual communications is desirable.
  • Bachelor’s or Master’s Degree in Graphic Design, Visual Arts, or related creative fields is a plus.

Academic and/or Professional Experience

Candidates must have a strong, diverse portfolio showcasing a wide variety of formats (such as social media graphics, marketing collateral, and one-pagers). We are looking for versatile specialists with an exceptional grasp of typography, visual composition, and grid systems. An adaptable, fast-paced, and detail-oriented approach is essential, along with the ability to work independently to solve visual challenges.

Technical Skills (Essential)

  • Layout & Typography: Exceptional grasp of typography, precise grid systems, and visual composition to elevate everyday materials.
  • Visual Asset Creation: Proven ability to structure information cleanly through modern infographics and compelling social media templates.
  • Design Tools: Deep proficiency with Adobe Creative Suite (Illustrator, Photoshop, InDesign) and Figma to handle a wide spectrum of visual tasks.
  • Format Versatility: Seamlessly switch between designing impactful one-pagers and highly engaging digital templates, adapting to the constraints of each medium.

Additional requirements

  • An adaptable, fast-paced, and detail-oriented mindset.
  • Strong dedication to delivering visually polished, professional-grade assets.
  • Self-directed work ethic with the ability to manage diverse visual tasks simultaneously.
  • Your CV must include a link to your portfolio with graphic design examples. Applications without a portfolio link, or without relevant graphic design cases, will not be considered.
  • English proficiency: Upper-intermediate (B2) or above (required)

Project time expectations

For this project, tasks are estimated to require around 10–20 hours per week during active phases, based on project requirements. This is an estimate, not a guaranteed workload, and applies only while the project is active.

Compensation

On this project, contributors can earn up to $50 per hour equivalent, depending on their level and pace of contribution.

Compensation varies across projects depending on scope, complexity, and required expertise. Please note that other projects on the platform may offer different earning levels based on their requirements.

K12, a Stride Company, believes in Education for ANY ONE. We provide families an online option for a high-quality, personalized education experience. Students can thrive, find their passion, and learn in an environment that encourages discovery at their own pace.

Student success will be measured by valid and reliable assessment data, parent and student satisfaction, and continued institutional growth within the academic community. Join us!

The High School Computer Science Teacher must also be a provide instruction, support, and guidance, manage the learning process, and focus on students' individual needs. High School Computer Science Teachers monitor student progress through K12's learning management system, and work actively with students and parents to advance each students learning and to develop and monitor a plan for post-secondary success via online tools like Career Builder, Career Cruising, etc.

This is a full-time position. Ability to work independently, typically 40+ hours per week is required. Ability to maintain a professional home office without distraction during workday, typically 9-5 (or 8-4) or as defined by the school.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS: Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential duties.

raw.excerpt: Vividly is the leading modern trade promotion management (TPM) solution built by and for the consumer packaged goods industry.
raw.description:
Vividly is the leading modern trade promotion management (TPM) solution built by and for the consumer packaged goods industry. From campaign creation to deductions management and promotion measurement, we help brands manage every element of trade spend. With our easy-to-use platform and industry-leading experience, we pride ourselves on our ability to bring businesses to the next level.

Not familiar with trade promotion spend? That’s OK. Most people aren’t. It’s an $8 trillion dollar problem that is ripe for disruption by an innovative SaaS startup. In order to grow, consumer packaged goods (CPG) brands spend 20% of their topline revenue to get into retailers and promote their products within those retailers. The problem is that today 70% of those promotions are not ROI positive. This is because ROI is hard to track. The industry operates on emails, pdfs, and xls spreadsheets. At Vividly, we’re solving this massive problem with exciting tactics including AI, Machine Learning, and Fintech and adding value to everyone in the chain. Some of our customers include brands you may use and love - Liquid Death, Amy’s, and Perfect Snacks.

About the Role

Vividly is looking for a Product Marketing Manager to serve as the connective tissue between our product, customer success, sales, and marketing teams. This is a high-impact, cross-functional role that will define how we communicate product value, both internally and externally, as we continue scaling into the mid-market and enterprise CPG space.

You'll be the first dedicated PMM at Vividly, which means you'll have the opportunity to build the function from the ground up with the full support of a lean, revenue-oriented team and a robust tech stack.

What You'll Own

Product Release Communication & Customer Education

  • Partner with Customer Success Managers to proactively communicate product releases directly to customers, ensuring they understand what's new, why it matters, and how to use it
  • Build and manage a scalable release communication framework that coordinates across product, CS, sales, and marketing
  • Own the go-to-market process for new feature launches from early awareness through post-launch adoption

Sales Enablement

  • Develop enablement materials that articulate the strategic differentiators of both new and existing product capabilities, including talk tracks, one-pagers, battle cards, and competitive positioning
  • Arm the sales and SDR teams with the context they need to confidently sell and demo new functionality, especially as we continue moving upmarket
  • Translate product specs into business value for finance and sales personas, our two core buyers

Feature Adoption & Revenue Impact

  • Define and track metrics around feature adoption, customer engagement, and the revenue impact of product releases
  • Set goals around adoption rates and upsell revenue tied to new functionality
  • Work with CS and RevOps to identify upsell opportunities unlocked by product releases and build the campaigns and materials to activate them

Product Advocacy Program

  • Help build and formalize a product advocacy group, structured, incentivized, and consistently engaged
  • Leverage power users and customer advisors to surface real-world feedback, validate messaging, and generate case study content
  • Help transition the organization from ad hoc customer feedback to a repeatable voice-of-customer program that informs both roadmap and positioning

Who You Are

  • 4-7 years of product marketing experience in B2B SaaS, ideally with exposure to CPG, retail, or trade promotion management
  • Startup experience is required. This role wears many hats, operates cross-functionally, and expects you to build process where none exists
  • Proven ability to translate complex product functionality into clear, compelling narratives for both technical and non-technical audiences
  • Experience owning go-to-market launch processes end to end, not just the deck, but the cross-functional coordination and follow-through
  • Comfortable operating in a fast-moving, lean environment where priorities shift and autonomy is expected
  • Data-driven. You set goals, track outcomes, and use results to iterate
  • Strong collaborator who can earn trust across CS, sales, and product without formal authority

Why This Role

Our product is shipping features faster than our customers know about them, and our sales team is selling a roadmap that doesn't always have the enablement to back it up. This hire will directly close that gap and own the process that keeps it closed.

Why Choose Vividly?

A modern, remote-first workplace

We are committed to succeeding as a fully remote team, empowering you with the flexibility to thrive, no commute required. Every Vividly team member receives a stipend upon hire to help create a comfortable, productive home office.

Vividly days off & flexible PTO

For most USA holidays that fall on a Monday or Friday, we turn it into a 4 day weekend! Vividly also offers Flexible Time Off (and we really mean it) to help prevent burn out and fuel creativity.

Competitive Benefits

  • Healthcare, Dental and Vision - We cover 100% of your monthly premiums and 50% of all dependents
  • 401(k) - With a 3% employer contribution
  • Weekly $20 Sharebite Meal Stipend - For every meal you purchase, they donate a meal through Feeding America!
  • Monthly $50 Wellness Reimbursement
  • Monthly $200 Remote Work Stipend

Commitment to our values - The Vividly Code

  • Kind Ambition -We push boundaries with empathy and integrity
  • Keep It Real - We are transparent, honest, and authentic
  • Customer Love - We act as trusted advisors to our customers
  • Own It - We take responsibility and drive outcomes
  • Urgency Wins - We move quickly and focus on impact
  • Pull Together - We collaborate to win as a team

Please note: Vividly will never request sensitive information such as your social security number, bank account information, or other non-publicly available information during the application and interview process. If an applicant is extended an offer of employment, such sensitive information will be requested at that time during the onboarding process. Vividly will never ask you to receive and ship packages or goods as part of the interview. Other practices to be on alert for:

  • Contact initiated via unsolicited text message or cold call. Vividly does not follow up with candidates through instant messaging applications.
  • Our Talent Acquisition team only corresponds from email addresses with the domain ‘@govividly.com’. If a generic email ID ending with Gmail/Yahoo or other domain is used while receiving a job offer or interview call, there is a likelihood of a scammer.
  • While some of our jobs can be found on third party job sites, all of our current job opportunities and descriptions are posted on Vividly’s Careers page, or our official LinkedIn Company Page

The U.S. Federal Trade Commission has published helpful articles to help individuals learn more about protecting themselves from recruiting scams and financial fraud. If you believe you were a victim of such a scam, you may contact your local law enforcement agencies. Vividly is not responsible for any claims, liability, losses, damages, or expenses resulting from scammers or impersonators.

Background
Our company came out of Y Combinator in 2015. Since then, we've grown to 1000+ remote workers, with strong venture backing (including Sequoia Capital) and over $30M in funding to date. We are fully remote across Asia and the US time zones.
  • Check out Magic's Business Profile
  • Know more about our Team via Magic's Careers Page﻿﻿
💰 UNCAPPED COMMISSIONS — the more you close, the more you earn. No ceiling.
Top performers hit 80–150% of monthly target consistently. At 100% quota: $3,500–$4,500/mo. At 150%: $5,000+/mo. All USD, paid monthly.

The Opportunity
50+ warm inbound leads every month. Your job is to own them — from discovery to close.

Magic connects fast-growing U.S. businesses with high-quality remote talent. Leads are warm. Playbook is proven. Earnings are uncapped. We welcome candidates from B2B, B2C, outbound, CS, and AM backgrounds — if you have grit and closing instincts, we want to talk.

Our Hiring ProcessWe move fast for strong candidates.
  • Stage 1 — 4 quick questions + Video Assessment (sent immediately)
    • Four dropdown questions under 3 minutes. Shortlisted candidates receive a Typeform video assessment immediately — 3 prompts, 60–90 seconds each. The video is how we meet you and evaluate your instincts. No live call at this stage.
  • Stage 2 — HR Background Check (45 minutes)
    • Quick call to confirm background, availability, and compensation fit.
  • Stage 3 — Sales Leadership Interview + Live Role Play + Final Panel
    • Sales Leadership runs a live mock discovery call to see your closing instincts, followed by a deeper interview.
  • Stage 4 — Offer within 48 hours
    • Decision and offer issued within 48 hours of your final stage.
What You'll Get
  • 💰 UNCAPPED COMMISSIONS — top performers earn $4,000+/month consistently
  • 50+ warm inbound leads per month — you close, we source
  • Structured playbook and active coaching from Sales Leadership
  • Career path: Sales Executive → Senior → Team Lead
  • 100% remote — USD pay monthly regardless of where you are based
What Winning Looks Like
  • You handle 2–8 discovery calls per day and never drop the ball on follow-up
  • You run 15+ quality discovery calls per week with C-level and Director-level prospects
  • You treat every "not now" as a future win — working deals with patience, creativity, and discipline
  • You own your pipeline: HubSpot is clean, next steps are always set, and nothing falls through the cracks
  • You hit quota monthly and look for ways to exceed it

The Impact you'll make

  • Own the full sales cycle — from inbound discovery call through close and client onboarding handoff
  • Uncover pain, establish urgency, and match the right Magic product to each prospect's specific needs
  • Manage a high-volume pipeline with discipline: prioritize, follow up persistently, and update deal stages in real time
  • Collaborate with Support and Ops to ensure clients start strong and stay happy
  • Share deal insights with the team; apply feedback fast and adapt when strategies evolve
  • Treat personal growth as part of the job — seek coaching, apply it, and continuously improve your close rate

Required Experience

We Welcome All of These Backgrounds
  • B2B sales — SaaS, subscription, outsourcing, professional services, tech
  • B2C sales — insurance, real estate, financial products, retail finance, automotive, telecom (any quota-carrying, consultative B2C role)
  • Outbound sales — cold calling, SDR/BDR promoted to closing, field sales, door-to-door. Grit polish.
  • Customer Success or Account Management — if you have aggressive upselling behavior and close new business (not passive relationship management)
  • Any role where you carried a number, owned a pipeline, and were personally accountable for results
Skills Style
  • Consultative approach — uncover pain before you pitch
  • English at C1 or C2 — clear, confident with U.S. buyers
  • CRM discipline — HubSpot or equivalent, pipeline always current
  • Self-accountable — you own your numbers
Mindset
  • Hungry — you hate leaving potential on the table
  • Gritty — you keep pushing when deals get hard because that's where wins are
  • Coachable — feedback is fuel, not criticism
  • Accountable — you own your outcomes, you don't wait to be told what to fix
This Role Is NOT For You If:
  • You wait for a manager to tell you what to do each day
  • You treat 'not now' as a dead end instead of a future deal to nurture
  • You blame leads, tools, or the process when numbers fall short
  • You see CRM hygiene as optional admin work
  • You need perfect leads to perform — you make the most of what's in front of you

Benefits

Your Offer
  • Guaranteed Base - $1,500 – $2,500 monthly foundation for stability
  • Performance Commission - 15–25%, increasing with performance excellence
  • Average Commission Reality - $1,500 – $2,000 monthly (what most AEs earn)
  • Total Monthly Earnings - $2,500 – $4,500+ with a clear path to increase
  • Truly Uncapped Commission - Our top performers consistently earn $5,000+ monthly
  • Employment Type - Independent Contractor/Consultant – Full Time
  • Workplace Type - Fully Remote
  • Reporting To - Inbound Sales Manager

Your Growth Path
  • Account Executive (0–6 months): Master Magic’s product suite, build pipeline discipline, establish consultative selling habits
  • Senior Account Executive (6–18 months): Consistently exceed quota, mentor new AEs, manage higher-value accounts
  • Team Lead / Sales Manager (18–36 months): Lead a pod of AEs, own team targets, contribute to sales strategy
  • Sales Director (3+ years): Oversee sales operations, drive go-to-market strategy, partner with leadership on growth

Key Time Zone Schedule Requirements
  • Work Schedule: 9-hour shifts following US business hours

raw.title: Senior Security Engineer, Product Security
raw.excerpt: About GoodLeap: GoodLeap is a technology company delivering best-in-class financing and software products for sustainable solutions, from solar panels and batteries to energy-efficient HVAC, heat pumps, roofing, windows, and more.
raw.description:
About GoodLeap:
GoodLeap is a technology company delivering best-in-class financing and software products for sustainable solutions, from solar panels and batteries to energy-efficient HVAC, heat pumps, roofing, windows, and more. Over 1 million homeowners have benefited from our simple, fast, and frictionless technology that makes the adoption of these products more affordable, accessible, and easier to understand. Thousands of professionals deploying home efficiency and solar solutions rely on GoodLeap’s proprietary, AI-powered applications and developer tools to drive more transparent customer communication, deeper business intelligence, and streamlined payment and operations. Our platform has led to more than $30 billion in financing for sustainable solutions since 2018.
GoodLeap is also proud to support our award-winning nonprofit, GivePower, which is building and deploying life-saving water and clean electricity systems, changing the lives of more than 1.6 million people across Africa, Asia, and South America.

GoodLeap’s security team safeguards the organization’s information assets while enabling the business — spanning product safety and resilience, security paved roads, customer and regulatory trust, and technology governance. As a Senior Product Security Engineer, you’ll partner with product and engineering teams to make what we ship safe by default, splitting your time between building production security services and reviewing what other teams build: designs before code exists, pull requests before merge, and running systems before someone else finds the problem. You’ll be the primary security partner for one or more business units — GRC, security operations, and monitoring carry their own parts of the mandate, but you own the product security outcome.

GoodLeap builds in TypeScript, Node.js, .NET, and Python, and you’ll work across all of it — we care that you can move between stacks, not that you’ve spent your career in one. We’re also shipping LLM-backed and agentic features into a regulated consumer-finance product; adversarially testing those systems (prompt injection, jailbreaks, tool abuse, exfiltration) and helping define what’s “safe enough to launch” is core to this role. You don’t need years of AI security experience — you need to show you can take an unfamiliar system, reason about how it fails, and produce findings a product team will act on.

Essential Job Duties and Responsibilities

  • Adversarially test our AI and LLM-backed features. Design and run attacks against LLM-backed applications and agents — prompt injection, jailbreaks, tool abuse, data exfiltration — and turn findings into pass/fail criteria product teams will act on.
  • Build and operate production security services. Backend services and internal tooling — APIs, streaming transports, proxy/CLI/chat interfaces — in whichever of TypeScript, Node.js, .NET, or Python fits the problem, held to the same bar as any other production service: test coverage, CI, dependency management.
  • Find new ways to automate the work. Notice when something we do by hand has become automatable, prototype it, and make the case— even when it means replacing a tool we bought last year.
  • Review pull request vulnerability findings. Triage what scanning and AI-assisted review surface across our stacks, separating real findings from noise. Go deep by hand on auth paths and high-risk changes, and feed what you learn back into the tooling.
  • Threat model from product designs. Review PRDs and technical designs before code exists, infer trust boundaries and data flows in unfamiliar domains, and raise security questions while the design is still cheap to change.
  • Test by hand and validate what you find. Manual testing of web applications and APIs, triage for real exploitability, and retest fixes. Support the red team’s bug bounty and continuous penetration testing programs.
  • Keep the AppSec tooling estate running and low-friction. SAST/dependency scanning tuning, finding triage and routing, SSO and access management, and automating the repetitive parts so the program scales without headcount.
  • Secure the infrastructure your tooling runs on. IAM least-privilege scoping, secrets management, and container/network lifecycle — as infrastructure as code, with automated drift checks.
  • Enable engineers to do the right thing. Build security training and documentation engineers will actually use.
  • Evaluate tools and help set the AI bar. Run structured bake-offs of security products against defined requirements and help set the standards AI/agent systems must satisfy before reaching production.
  • Back up the rest of the security team. Support investigations, threat hunting, and incident response for the products you cover, and contribute to the vulnerability management lifecycle and security analytics platform.

Required Skills, Knowledge, and Abilities

  • You ship production code. Strong backend engineering in at least one modern language, with at least one service you built that others depend on — async patterns, HTTP APIs, and streaming transports are familiar ground. We work across TypeScript, Node.js, .NET, and Python; depth in one plus the willingness to move between them matters more than any particular stack on your résumé.
  • You can read code you didn’t write, across more than one language and stack, well enough to judge whether a reported finding is real, catch the ones tooling missed, and propose a fix the engineer can act on.
  • You know how identity and authorization actually fail: token exchange and scope handling, session lifetime and revocation, request signing, OAuth pitfalls, and network-layer issues like SSRF and DNS rebinding. We’re looking for reasoning that finds real bugs, not checklist recall.
  • You understand API standards and how to secure them: REST and GraphQL in practice, OpenAPI and schema contracts, input validation, rate limiting, gateway-level auth, and webhook and service-to-service verification.
  • Hands-on testing of web applications and APIs — manual, not just scanner-driven — plus the triage, the clear write-up, and the retest.
  • Threat modeling from written designs. You can read a PRD in an unfamiliar domain, infer trust boundaries and data flows, and ask the right questions while the answer is still cheap.
  • Working AWS and infrastructure-as-code competence: IAM scoping, secrets management, container/compute lifecycle, network egress control, and infrastructure defined as code.
  • Practical exposure to AI/LLM security. You have attacked an LLM-backed application or agent — at work, in a CTF, in published research, or in your own lab — and can tell us what you found and why it worked.
  • You write and speak for people who are not in security. Findings engineers act on, documentation they use, and explanations that hold up in front of a product manager, an executive, or Legal.
    • Preferred:
  • Having owned an AppSec tooling estate: SAST/SCA tuning, finding routing, false-positive reduction
  • Running structured vendor evaluations or proofs of concept
  • Contributing to security policy or standards, including for AI systems
  • Delivering security training or building hands-on learning environments
  • Depth in cryptography and key management
  • Detection engineering, incident response, or threat hunting exposure
  • An understanding of how SaaS products get built — roadmaps, prioritization, why the ship date exists. Prior product or engineering management experience is a plus, not an expectation.

When joining PerkinElmer, you select an experienced and trusted leader in scientific solutions, with the support of a global service network and distribution centers, providing the right solution, at the right time, to meet critical customer needs. With over an 80+ year legacy of advancing science and a mission of innovating for a healthier world, our dedicated team collaborates closely with commercial, government, academic and healthcare customers to deliver our broad portfolio of analytical solutions, and OneSource services.

Job Title

Regional Product Manager Atomic Spectroscopy (REMOTE East Coast)


Location(s)

US Remote - CT, US Remote - DC, US Remote - FL, US Remote - GA, US Remote - KY, US Remote - MA, US Remote - MD, US Remote - NC, US Remote - NJ, US Remote - NY, US Remote - OH, US Remote - PA, US Remote - SC, US Remote - VA

Job Description

The Company

PerkinElmer is a global analytical services and solutions provider with offerings including the leading OneSource Field and Laboratory services business that serve the biopharma, food, environmental, safety and applied end markets to accelerate scientific outcomes. Since 1937, PerkinElmer has served as a trusted partner in laboratory analysis and management and today complements its service offerings with a broad portfolio of atomic spectroscopy, molecular spectroscopy, and chromatography instruments, consumables, and reagents. With a dedicated team of more than 5,000 team members, the Company serves customers in more than 35 countries. Additional information is available at www.perkinelmer.com

Purpose

PerkinElmer is seeking a Regional Product Manager to support the commercial organization in the NAM Region and help implement the regional Inorganics strategy. This role coordinates between central product management and the regional sales and marketing teams — providing the product expertise, competitive response capability, and local market intelligence that the field organisation needs to win in customer-facing situations.

The Regional PM is the product line's voice in the field. They are the person a regional sales manager calls when a deal requires deep product knowledge, when a competitor launches a new instrument, or when a key customer wants to understand how the product line meets their specific application needs. They bring the centre's strategic thinking to the region, and the region's market reality back to central product management.

This role will analyze win/loss data, capture critical regional VOC input, facilitate demand creation activities in the region, track regional KPI’s and drive financial performance and actions needed to achieve.

Responsibilities:

Field Commercial Support

  • Provide real-time product expertise to the regional sales team — answering technical and commercial questions, supporting customer demonstrations, and participating in key account meetings where product management presence creates commercial advantage
  • Lead regional competitive response: providing timely, accurate, and commercially useful guidance to the sales team when a competitor launches a new instrument, adjusts pricing, or makes a specific claim in a customer situation
  • Support regional sales management with product mix analysis, product line forecasting inputs, and portfolio utilisation data that helps the region prioritise selling effort
  • Participate in distributor management where the product line is sold through channel partners — providing product training, commercial support, and competitive tools

Launch Localisation & Execution

  • Lead the regional execution of global product launches — adapting central launch plans to regional market conditions, regulatory requirements, and commercial priorities
  • Coordinate with Regional Marketing Managers to ensure launch campaigns, customer events, and demand generation activities reflect the product line's commercial priorities in the region
  • Manage regional beta programmes in partnership with the NPI PM — identifying and engaging appropriate regional beta sites, managing relationships, and ensuring feedback is captured and reported to the central programme team
  • Deliver regional sales training on new product launches — ensuring field commercial teams can demonstrate, position, and close against competitive alternatives from day one of launch

Market Intelligence & Feedback

  • Serve as the regional intelligence feed to central product management — systematically reporting competitive activity, customer feedback, application trends, and market developments that are visible in the field but not from the centre
  • Conduct customer conversations specifically focused on market intelligence: competitive usage patterns, unmet application needs, pricing sensitivity, and regional regulatory trends
  • Attend and represent PerkinElmer at regional scientific conferences, trade shows, and customer events — gathering competitive intelligence and building relationships with key opinion leaders in the region
  • Provide the Strategic PM with documented regional input on product requirements, pricing feedback, and application priorities as part of the Customer Outcome Document and roadmap process

Customer & Stakeholder Relationships

  • Build and maintain relationships with key regional customers — particularly those who are opinion leaders, early adopters, or large-volume buyers whose satisfaction is strategically important to the product line's regional performance
  • Support key account teams with product-specific technical and commercial input for major tenders, framework agreements, and long-cycle strategic accounts
  • Partner with the Applications Scientist to support customer demonstrations, method development assistance, and application-specific support for key regional opportunities

Qualifications & Experience

Required

  • 5–10 years of experience in product management, technical sales, applications science, or commercial marketing within analytical instrumentation or scientific equipment
  • Broad working knowledge of at least one product line technology (atomic spectroscopy, chromatography, materials characterisation) and its key regional application markets
  • Demonstrated ability to operate effectively as a field-based specialist — managing multiple concurrent customer and commercial priorities, often with limited day-to-day management oversight
  • Strong interpersonal and communication skills — able to engage credibly with regional sales teams, distributors, and customers across varying technical and commercial contexts
  • Willingness and ability to travel extensively within the assigned region (40–50%)
  • Bachelor's degree in Chemistry, Analytical Chemistry, Physics, or a related scientific discipline

Preferred

  • Advanced degree (MSc, PhD) in a relevant analytical or materials science discipline
  • Direct hands-on laboratory experience with analytical instrumentation in a research, QC, or applications environment — giving the Regional PM genuine field credibility with scientifically trained customers
  • Prior experience in a field-based role (applications scientist, field sales specialist, or field marketing) that required operating across multiple customer sites and managing competing priorities without close supervision
  • Native or near-native fluency in the primary commercial language of the assigned region (where English is not the dominant commercial language)

The annual compensation range for this full-time position is $120,000 to $155,000. The final base pay offered to the successful candidate will be determined by factors including internal equity, work location, as well as individual qualifications, such as job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

PerkinElmer is committed to creating a diverse environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability status, age, or veteran status or any other characteristics protected by applicable law. PerkinElmer is committed to a culturally diverse workforce.

Description

Sprout Social is looking for an Engineering Manager to lead our Tooling team.

Why join Sprout’s Engineering team?

At Sprout, we believe great engineering organizations are built on exceptional developer experience. Our Tooling team creates the platforms, automation, and workflows that enable hundreds of engineers to build, test, deploy, and operate software safely and efficiently.

As the Engineering Manager for Tooling, you’ll lead a team responsible for improving developer productivity across the company. From modern Continuous Delivery and CI/CD platforms to AI-powered developer workflows, engineering observability, release automation, and internal developer tooling, your team’s work directly impacts every engineer at Sprout.

Work closely with Product Engineering teams to understand pain points and prioritize improvements that meaningfully increase developer velocity.

You’ll partner closely with engineering leaders across Infrastructure and Product Engineering to reduce friction, improve reliability, and enable teams to ship software faster with confidence.

What you’ll do

  • Lead, coach, and develop a team of SRE’s focused on Developer Experience and Engineering Productivity.
  • Partner with Engineering leadership to define the long-term vision for developer tooling across Sprout.
  • Drive the evolution of our Continuous Delivery platform, deployment automation, and release workflows.
  • Lead modernization efforts across our CI/CD ecosystem.
  • Partner with Infrastructure and Security teams to build secure-by-default engineering workflows.
  • Guide technical direction for internal platforms supporting software development, deployment, monitoring, and operational excellence.
  • Foster engineering best practices around automation, reliability, testing, and operational maturity.
  • Help teams improve software delivery performance using DORA metrics and engineering health indicators.
  • Enable adoption of AI-assisted engineering workflows and autonomous development tooling.
  • Work closely with Product Engineering teams to understand pain points and prioritize improvements that meaningfully increase developer velocity.
  • Support strategic infrastructure initiatives including deployment platforms, release management, engineering observability, source control automation, and internal developer portals.
  • Build an inclusive, collaborative engineering culture focused on continuous improvement.

Areas owned by the Tooling team

Examples of platforms and technologies owned or supported include:

  • Continuous Delivery platform
  • GitHub Actions
  • Jenkins modernization
  • Deployment automation
  • Build and release pipelines
  • Internal developer tooling
  • Engineering AI platforms and autonomous agents
  • Datadog developer integrations
  • PagerDuty engineering integrations
  • Package management and artifact repositories
  • Source control automation
  • Engineering productivity metrics
  • Observability

What you’ll bring

We’re looking for a collaborative engineering leader who enjoys solving large scale engineering productivity challenges.

Minimum qualifications

  • 3-5+ years managing software engineering teams
  • 7+ years building and operating production software systems
  • Experience leading cross-functional technical initiatives across multiple engineering organizations
  • Experience designing and operating CI/CD systems and modern software delivery pipelines
  • Experience with cloud-native platforms such as Kubernetes and AWS
  • Experience improving engineering productivity through automation

Preferred qualifications

  • Experience with GitHub Actions or similar CI/CD platforms
  • Experience leading Developer Experience or Platform Engineering teams
  • Experience with deployment orchestration and release automation
  • Experience with Infrastructure-as-Code and platform automation
  • Experience implementing software delivery metrics such as DORA
  • Experience evaluating or implementing AI assisted software development workflows
  • Experience with observability platforms such as Datadog, Sentry, Grafana, or OpenTelemetry
  • Experience supporting internal engineering platforms used across large engineering organizations

How you’ll grow

Within 1 month

  • Complete Sprout’s onboarding program.
  • Meet your team, stakeholders, and partner engineering organizations.
  • Learn our software delivery lifecycle, deployment platforms, and developer workflows.
  • Build relationships with Product Engineering, Infrastructure, Security, and Engineering Leadership.
  • Understand current priorities around Continuous Delivery, CI CD modernization, and developer productivity.

Within 3 months

  • Begin leading quarterly planning with your team.
  • Develop a roadmap for engineering productivity improvements.
  • Understand key developer pain points and identify opportunities to reduce friction.
  • Partner with Engineering leaders to prioritize platform investments.
  • Contribute to technical planning and architecture discussions for internal developer platforms.
  • Help drive adoption of engineering best practices across multiple product teams.

Within 6 months

  • Successfully deliver several meaningful improvements to developer experience and software delivery.
  • Coach engineers through career development, performance feedback, and technical growth.
  • Drive measurable improvements in deployment speed, reliability, and engineering efficiency.
  • Lead cross functional initiatives spanning Infrastructure and Product Engineering.
  • Establish clear operational metrics for Tooling platform health and adoption.
  • Help teams safely adopt new deployment capabilities and engineering workflows.

Within 12 months

  • Establish the Tooling team as a trusted engineering platform organization.
  • Deliver measurable improvements in developer productivity and software delivery performance.
  • Build and execute a multi-quarter roadmap aligned with Engineering strategy.
  • Partner with senior engineering leadership on long-term platform investments.
  • Develop future technical leaders within the team.
  • Champion continuous improvement across engineering through automation, standardization, and developer focused platform investments.
  • Help shape the future of AI-enabled software development at Sprout.

Success in this role

Success is not measured by the number of features shipped by your own team. It is measured by the productivity, reliability, and satisfaction of every engineering team that relies on the platforms you build.

You’ll know you’re succeeding when:

  • Engineering teams deploy more frequently and with greater confidence.
  • Developer friction decreases through automation and self-service platforms.
  • Software delivery metrics improve across the organization.
  • Developers adopt your platforms because they are intuitive and valuable.
  • The Tooling team becomes a trusted strategic partner for engineering leaders.
  • Engineers spend more time building customer value and less time managing infrastructure, tooling, and deployment complexity.

Our Benefits Program

We’re proud to regularly be recognized for our team, product, and culture. We invest in our team with a comprehensive, competitive benefits program:

  • Comprehensive Health & Wellness: Premium BCBSIL medical, dental (high/low plans), and vision (Eyemed) insurance for you and your eligible dependents.
  • Premium Mental Health Support: Full, free access to Modern Health for you and your dependents, including coaching, therapy sessions, and digital wellness resources.
  • Retirement Savings: 401(k) plan with a 50% company match on your first 6% of contributions (a 3% total match).
  • Financial Security: 100% employer-paid Life and Disability insurance for your peace of mind.
  • Flexible Paid Time Off: A flexible PTO policy, supplemented with additional company-wide Rest & Recharge days throughout the year.
  • Paid Parental Leave: Up to 16 weeks of paid leave for new parents to support you in expanding your family.
  • Annual Lifestyle Stipend: A $1,000 USD annual Lifestyle Spending Account to spend on your physical, mental, and financial well-being.
  • Work From Home Support: A one-time $550 USD stipend to set up your home office, plus a monthly $50 USD stipend for internet.
  • Giving Back: 16 hours of paid volunteer time annually, plus a $100 annual match for your charitable donations.
  • Additional Financial Perks: Access to pre-tax commuter benefits, subsidized child/eldercare (Care.com), discounted pet insurance (Figo), and no-cost personalized financial wellness support through Your Money Line.

*This list is for informational purposes only. Benefit offerings are discretionary and subject to change and do not constitute a contract or guarantee of benefits.

About Tailscale

Tailscale is making safe connection effortless by delivering software that makes it easy to securely interconnect people and their devices, no matter where they are. From hobbyists to multinational corporations, teams of every size use Tailscale each day to protect their networks, share access to internal tools, and more. We're building a future for the Internet that's easy, sensible, and safe, like it used to be. Founded in 2019 and fully distributed, we're backed by Accel, CRV, Insight, Heavybit, and Uncork Capital.

About the Role

We’re looking for an experienced Talent Acquisition Operations professional to help build and scale the operational foundation of Tailscale’s Talent Acquisition organization.

You’ll partner closely with TA leadership, Talent Acquisition Partners, Sourcers, Coordinators, and cross-functional teams to build efficient, scalable recruiting processes and deliver an exceptional candidate and hiring team experience. You’ll own and improve core areas including recruiting systems, analytics and reporting, process design, coordinator operations, and operational programs.

We’re looking for someone who enjoys solving operational problems, creating structure, and using technology and data to make recruiting more effective. You’ll have the opportunity to expand your ownership over time and help shape how Talent Acquisition Operations evolves as Tailscale scales.

Key Responsibilities

Talent Acquisition Operations & Systems

  • Administer, configure, and continuously optimize our recruiting technology stack, workflows, permissions, integrations, templates, and operational processes.
  • Partner with TA leadership to identify and implement process and system improvements across the recruiting lifecycle.
  • Support recruiting technology implementations, upgrades, integrations, and vendor relationships.
  • Maintain system integrity, documentation, and standard operating procedures that create consistency and scalability.

Talent Acquisition Analytics & Reporting

  • Build and maintain recruiting dashboards and recurring reporting that provide visibility into hiring progress, pipeline health, funnel performance, recruiting activity, and other key metrics.
  • Analyze recruiting data to identify trends, bottlenecks, risks, and opportunities, translating findings into actionable insights for TA and business stakeholders.
  • Partner with TA leadership to define meaningful recruiting metrics and reporting cadences that support team performance and business decision-making.
  • Support headcount tracking, hiring forecasts, and data quality to ensure reporting is accurate, consistent, and actionable.

Talent Acquisition Programs & Process Improvement

  • Design and implement scalable recruiting programs, processes, and operational initiatives that improve team effectiveness and candidate experience.
  • Identify operational inefficiencies and translate them into practical, scalable solutions.
  • Create and maintain recruiting playbooks, hiring guides, process documentation, and other resources that drive consistency and adoption.
  • Lead operational projects from planning through implementation in partnership with People, Finance, IT, Legal, and other cross-functional teams.

Talent Acquisition Coordinator Partnership

  • Partner closely with Talent Acquisition Coordinators to improve scheduling operations, candidate communications, interview logistics, and candidate experience.
  • Serve as an operational resource and escalation point for complex coordination or recruiting process challenges.
  • Document and optimize coordinator workflows, identify opportunities for automation and process improvement, and help build scalable operating practices.
  • Partner with TA leadership on coordinator capacity and provide coverage during periods of increased hiring activity or planned time off as needed.

Recruiting Technology, Automation & AI

  • Partner with the Talent Intelligence, Sourcing & AI Programs Lead to operationalize recruiting technologies, AI-enabled workflows, and automation initiatives.
  • Support implementation, documentation, enablement, and adoption of new tools and workflows across Talent Acquisition.
  • Identify opportunities to reduce manual work, improve data quality, and create more efficient recruiting experiences through technology and automation.
  • Ensure new tools and workflows integrate effectively with existing recruiting processes while maintaining appropriate standards for data quality, privacy, and candidate experience.

Compliance & Operational Excellence

  • Maintain recruiting documentation, operational standards, and processes that support compliance and audit readiness.
  • Partner with appropriate stakeholders to ensure recruiting processes align with internal policies and applicable employment requirements.
  • Identify and address operational risks while continuously improving the consistency, effectiveness, and scalability of recruiting operations.

What We Are Looking For

  • 3+ years of experience in Talent Acquisition Operations, recruiting coordination, Talent Acquisition, People Operations, or a related operational role, ideally within a high-growth environment.
  • Hands-on experience administering and improving Applicant Tracking Systems and recruiting technologies such as Greenhouse, ModernLoop, or similar platforms.
  • Strong operational and project management skills, with experience designing processes, improving workflows, and creating scalable documentation.
  • Strong analytical skills and comfort building reports, working with recruiting metrics, and translating data into actionable insights.
  • Strong attention to detail and judgment, with the ability to maintain data integrity while managing multiple priorities and operational initiatives.
  • Excellent communication and cross-functional partnership skills, with the ability to work effectively across Talent Acquisition, People, Finance, IT, Legal, and business teams.
  • A continuous improvement mindset and comfort navigating ambiguity, adopting new technologies, and building scalable solutions as the organization evolves.

Nice to Have

  • Experience supporting Talent Acquisition Operations within a high-growth or globally distributed technology company.
  • Experience with recruiting technologies such as Greenhouse, ModernLoop, Crosschq, Metaview, LinkedIn Recruiter, or similar platforms.
  • Experience building recruiting dashboards and reporting using Google Sheets, Looker, Tableau, or similar analytics tools.
  • Experience using automation or AI-enabled tools to improve recruiting workflows, data quality, or operational efficiency.
  • Experience supporting Talent Acquisition Coordinators and building scalable coordination practices.
  • Experience leading recruiting programs, systems implementations, or cross-functional operational initiatives.

As a company, we strive to maintain fair and equitable compensation practices within our team across all roles and all levels. Tailscale's compensation package includes base salary, equity, and comprehensive benefits. The salary range displayed on each job posting represents the target range for a new hire's base salary. Individual offers may vary based on experience and skill set.

US Pay Range
$100,000—$130,000 USD

raw.description:
Sparteo is an independent suite of AI-powered advertising technologies built on sustainable, sovereign infrastructure.

Since 2018, we’ve been reshaping programmatic advertising to make it faster, more transparent, and more profitable by building the most direct path between publishers and advertisers.
But we don't stop here: wherever attention lives, on the web, in apps, on CTV, and beyond, our mission is to monetize audiences, across every device. Our data-driven tech delivers 30% higher revenues for our clients on average than traditional solutions.

Our Solutions:

→ Actirise: the display tech designed for performance
→ FastCMP: the consent management platform specifically designed for business purposes
→ Meetscale: the most advanced SSP for Publishers and Ad Networks
→ Viously: the ultimate all-in-one video tech solution
→ Voxeus: the audio distribution and monetization technology

Behind Sparteo’s growth is a team of 100+ talents across 11 countries, united by a shared ambition to redefine the future of digital advertising.

Our dedication has placed Sparteo among the most dynamic tech players in Europe:

  • FT1000 ranking – Among the fastest-growing European companies in 2024 & 2025

  • The Europas – Featured in the list of 100 hottest startups

  • Pixalate Ranking – #1 Web SSP in France with our Actirise solution, overtaking Google AdExchange

These milestones are just the result. What truly sets us apart is how we work: at Sparteo, we don’t settle, we act.

  • We are Drivers, not passengers: We take the wheel and own our results.

  • We are data-obsessed: Facts guide us, not assumptions, not egos.

  • We think as one: Collective goals come before personal wins.

  • We trade off: We simplify, prioritize, and go for high-impact results.

  • We solve problems: We own challenges and turn ideas into action.

  • We say what we do: Radical transparency is how we grow, no fluff, no hiding

Discover our journey, products, and culture on 👉 our website 👈

The Mission

As the Product Manager Flashbid / Dynamic Yield, you own the buy-side auction stack including our proprietary wrapper Flashbid on Actirise properties end-to-end. Your mission: continuously optimize yield while guaranteeing auction reliability and a fully compliant demand chain to drive incremental revenues and saving costs.

Your key responsibilities:

1. Wrapper & Auction Core

  • Own the Flashbid wrapper roadmap end-to-end: integration, evolution, and maintenance of the proprietary wrapper.

  • Monitor and optimize auction latency and performance — every millisecond of delay costs revenue.

  • Manage publisher demand connections: GAM, External RTB, and non-oRTB integrations.

2. Demand & Bidder Management

  • Own bidder setting configuration, integration, activation, and monitoring — both server-to-server (S2S) and client-side — including status monitoring and whitelisting per property.

  • Drive Shield: detect and block malicious or non-desired ads, and control the revenue impact of every blocking decision.

3. Yield Optimization

  • Own throttling and yield algorithms: pressure regulation, dynamic floor prices, smart refresh, and bid enrichment.

  • Partner with the Data team on AI-driven yield algorithms to push incremental revenue further.

  • Run structured A/B tests on yield levers (floor prices, bidder mix, throttling rules) and let data drive every decision.

4. Supply Chain & Compliance

  • Own SCHAIN: ads.txt management and vendor list curation to guarantee supply chain integrity.

  • Own the collection, processing, and transmission of consent signals (TCF, GPP) to demand partners.

5. Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Work closely with DPO on consent signal quality and compliance requirements feeding the auction.

  • Partner with PM Analytics to ensure auction/yield KPIs are properly tracked, benchmarked, and actionable.

  • Align with Supply, Data, and Tech/Engineering teams to prioritize the roadmap and ship reliably.

  • Act as the auction/yield product voice across Sparteo, translating technical trade-offs into clear business decisions for stakeholders and C-level.

Your profile for this job

We are looking for someone who treats every millisecond and every basis point of fill rate as money on the table — and who is as comfortable in a bid stream log as in a revenue dashboard.

  • PM Expertise: 4+ years of experience in Product Management, ideally on programmatic/header bidding products, SSPs, or yield management platforms.

  • Programmatic Expertise: Deep understanding of header bidding, RTB/OpenRTB, GAM, S2S vs. client-side bidding, and the SSP/DSP ecosystem.

  • Yield Mindset: Proven experience optimizing floor prices, throttling, or bidder mix to drive incremental revenue — you think in RPM, fill rate, win rate, and latency.

  • Supply Chain & Compliance Knowledge: Familiarity with ads.txt/sellers.json, schain validation, and consent frameworks (TCF, GPP) as they apply to the demand chain.

  • Data-Driven: Strong analytical skills; comfortable running A/B tests on auction parameters and reading the results into concrete roadmap decisions. SQL basics are a plus.

  • Technical Literacy: Understanding of auction latency, bid streams, and wrapper architecture. You don't need to code, but you need to speak engineering's language fluently.

  • Performance Obsession: Treats auction reliability and latency as first-class product metrics, not afterthoughts.

  • Exceptional Communicator: Able to translate highly technical programmatic trade-offs into clear priorities for Tech, Supply, and C-level stakeholders.

  • A strategic thinker with an 'AI-native' reflex, you excel at deconstructing business complexity into flawless operational blueprints. You don't just use AI; you design the structured documentation and logic flows that allow intelligent systems to execute our vision with precision

Your mind set to share our adventure

  • 🚀 You want to make an impact and move things forward collectively. Does hearing phrases like "Yes, but we've been doing it this way for years..." make your hair stand on end? We feel the same way: progress is made by questioning what already exists.

  • 🧠 You solve problems pragmatically and analytically.

  • 🏃‍♂️ You're looking for a fast-moving environment where your agility will be an asset. The 80-20 (Pareto) principle holds no secrets for you.

  • 🎧 Your ability to listen encourages you to challenge and improve yourself on an ongoing basis.

Benefits & Work Environment

  • 🌍 Dynamic Remote Culture: At Sparteo, we embrace a flexible work environment that adapts to your lifestyle, allowing you to contribute from wherever you feel most productive, be it from home or our urban offices in Paris, Lille, or London.

  • 👥 Close-knit Team: Be part of our dynamic and united team, where collaboration, innovation, and mutual support drive our collective success and create a thriving work environment.

  • 🎉 Vibrant Social Events: Engage in regular social gatherings and company events that foster community and celebrate our milestones.

  • 🚀 Rapid Growth: Experience the excitement of working with a company in rapid expansion mode, impacting the advertising technology landscape across Europe and beyond.

  • 📈 Tailored Support: We provide robust career development support, including training programs, career check-ins with HR, opportunities for internal mobility, and performance feedback sessions conducted quarterly or semi-annually, depending on your role.

  • 🩺 Comprehensive Health and pension plans: We provide a robust health benefits plan, ensuring you and your family are covered and cared for.

At Sparteo, we believe diversity is a strength. We are committed to providing equal opportunities and fostering an inclusive work environment. We encourage applications from all backgrounds, identities, and experiences.

Ready to join Team Sparteo? Send us your CV and continue the recruitment process!

Here are the stages in our recruitment process

  • Discussions about your driving forces, your ambitions and our Sparteo mindset will be held with a member of our Talent Acquisition team.

  • Analytical and business logic tests

  • Discussions with one or more members of the Sparteo team, including your future manager

  • Taking up references

Our recruitment process is mainly conducted by videoconference; however, certain stages may require a face-to-face meeting.

Job Title: Senior Marketing Manager

Position Type: Full-Time, Remote

Working Hours: U.S. Business Hours

About the Role

We’re hiring a Senior Marketing Manager / Head of Marketing Operations to lead and execute high-impact digital marketing initiatives across SEO, content, growth, and marketing operations.

This is a high-ownership role for someone who combines strategic marketing thinking with strong execution capabilities across technical SEO, content production, digital growth, and operational management.

You will be responsible for driving organic growth, managing marketing systems and workflows, overseeing website and SEO initiatives, coordinating campaigns, and leveraging AI tools to improve speed, scalability, and marketing performance.

The ideal candidate is highly proactive, execution-focused, AI-driven, and capable of independently building and managing marketing initiatives in a fast-paced environment.

Responsibilities

Marketing Strategy & Execution

  • Develop and execute marketing initiatives across multiple digital channels
  • Drive organic growth strategies across SEO, content, and digital marketing efforts
  • Coordinate and manage ongoing marketing campaigns and operational priorities
  • Support revenue-focused marketing initiatives and performance tracking

Content & Social Media Management

  • Create and oversee daily social media content across platforms including Instagram, Facebook, and X (Twitter)
  • Produce or manage high-quality content including blogs, articles, PR outreach, and promotional materials
  • Collaborate with designers and developers to ensure visually engaging and brand-aligned content
  • Maintain consistency across messaging, branding, and communication

SEO & Website Management

  • Lead Technical SEO initiatives including on-page optimization, audits, backlink strategies, and organic growth planning
  • Manage website projects using ASTRO, headless WordPress, or similar CMS technologies
  • Monitor SEO performance and implement improvements based on analytics and industry trends
  • Stay updated on evolving SEO, AIO, and AI-driven search strategies

Marketing Operations & Systems

  • Manage marketing workflows, reporting systems, and operational processes
  • Support quarterly reporting, shareholder updates, and performance analysis
  • Coordinate marketing projects across internal teams and external partners
  • Ensure operational efficiency across campaigns, systems, and communication workflows

AI & Automation Integration

  • Leverage AI tools to improve content production, SEO research, automation, and marketing workflows
  • Identify opportunities to streamline repetitive marketing tasks using AI platforms
  • Experiment with emerging AI technologies to improve efficiency and campaign performance
  • Support AI-first operational improvements across the marketing function

Crisis & Brand Management

  • Support crisis-response marketing initiatives when required
  • Maintain professionalism and responsiveness during high-priority or time-sensitive situations
  • Ensure brand communication remains consistent and aligned during critical events

What Makes You a Strong Fit

  • You combine strategic marketing thinking with hands-on execution
  • You are highly organized and capable of managing multiple initiatives simultaneously
  • You are deeply familiar with Technical SEO and organic growth strategies
  • You proactively solve problems and execute independently without heavy oversight
  • You are AI-first in your approach to content, research, workflows, and automation
  • You communicate clearly and collaborate effectively across teams

Required Experience & Skills

Must-Have Requirements (Non-Negotiable)

  • Proven experience in a senior marketing, growth, or marketing operations role
  • Strong expertise in Technical SEO and organic growth strategies
  • Experience managing websites using ASTRO, WordPress, or headless CMS platforms
  • Experience with Google Ads, backlink analysis, and SEO tools
  • Strong understanding of AI tools and their use in marketing workflows
  • Experience managing marketing projects and cross-functional collaboration
  • Excellent English communication skills (written and verbal)
  • Strong analytical and reporting abilities
  • Ability to independently manage and execute marketing initiatives

Nice-to-Have Experience

  • Active involvement in the SEO or digital marketing community
  • Experience with HubSpot, Slack, Asana, or similar operational tools
  • Experience in luxury, hospitality, lifestyle, or travel-related industries
  • Experience leading crisis-response marketing initiatives
  • Familiarity with Revenue Operations or marketing analytics systems

What Does a Typical Day Look Like?

Your day will revolve around managing marketing initiatives, driving SEO and content execution, coordinating campaigns, and improving operational efficiency across marketing systems.

You will:

  • Review marketing performance and SEO metrics
  • Coordinate content creation and campaign execution
  • Manage website updates and optimization initiatives
  • Collaborate with design and development teams
  • Build and improve AI-assisted marketing workflows
  • Monitor digital growth opportunities and reporting metrics
  • Support operational coordination across marketing initiatives

In essence: you are the person driving marketing execution, operational structure, and organic growth across the business.

Key Metrics for Success (KPIs)

  • Organic traffic growth and SEO performance improvements
  • Consistency and quality of content production
  • Growth in engagement and digital visibility across channels
  • Marketing workflow efficiency and campaign execution
  • Website performance and optimization improvements
  • Effective implementation of AI-driven marketing systems

Interview Process

  • Initial Screening Call
  • Recruiter Interview
  • Final Interview with Leadership
  • Offer & Onboarding

iHeartRadio

Current employees and contingent workers click hereto apply and search by the Job Posting Title.

The audio revolution is here – and iHeart is leading it! iHeartMedia, the number one audio company in America, reaches 90% of Americans every month -- a monthly audience that’s twice the size of any other audio company – almost three times the size of the largest TV network – and almost 4 times the size of the largest ad-supported music streaming service. In fact, we have:

  • More #1 rated markets than the next two largest radio companies combined;

  • We’re the largest podcast publisher, with more monthly downloads than the second- and third-largest podcast publishers combined. Podcasting, the fastest-growing new media, today has more monthly users than streaming music services or Netflix;

  • iHeart is the home of many of the country’s most popular and trusted on-air personalities and podcast influencers, who build important connections with hundreds of communities across America;

  • We create and produce some of the most popular and well-known branded live music events in America, including the iHeartRadio Music Festival, the iHeartRadio Music Awards, the iHeartCountry Festival, iHeartRadio Fiesta Latina and the iHeartRadio Jingle Ball Tour;

  • iHeartRadio is the #1 streaming radio digital service in America;

  • Our social media footprint is 7 times larger than the next largest audio service; and

  • We have the only complete audio ad technology stack in the industry for all forms of audio, from on demand to broadcast radio, digital streaming radio and podcasting, which bring data, targeting and attribution to all forms of audio at an unparalleled scale. As a result, we’re able to combine our strong leadership position in audience reach, usage and ad tech with powerful tools and insights for our sales organizations to help them build success for their clients at a more efficient cost than any other option.

Because we reach almost every community in America, we’re committed to providing a range of programming that reflects the diversity of the many communities we serve – and our company reflects that same kind of diversity. Our company values stress collaboration, curiosity, welcoming dissent, accepting mistakes in the pursuit of new ideas, and respect for everyone.

Only one company in America has the #1 position in everything audio: iHeartMedia!

If you’re excited about this role but don’t feel your experience aligns perfectly with the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. At iHeartMedia we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive, and authentic workplace and are looking for teammates passionate about what we do!

What We Need:

About AudioGraph: AudioGraph is iHeartMedia’s programmatic broadcast radio platform — the first at scale to let agencies plan, buy, and measure broadcast radio through the same programmatic workflows they use for digital. It connects 860+ stations across 150+ markets to the programmatic ecosystem through DSP integrations, audience targeting, and automated measurement.

Why This Role Matters: Sellers need a technical partner who can shorten deal cycles, remove friction, and make AudioGraph feel as easy to buy as digital. This role directly accelerates revenue by helping agencies say yes faster and ensuring every campaign delivers a best‑in‑class experience.

The Role: As Senior Solutions Engineer, you own AudioGraph’s technical go‑to‑market. You lead complex pre‑sale conversations, build repeatable implementation playbooks, and create the operational backbone for a seamless client experience from first pitch through post‑campaign wrap. Your work drives sales effectiveness, deal velocity, and client retention.

What You'll Do:

As Senior Solutions Engineer, you own the technical go-to-market for AudioGraph. You are the most technically fluent person on the commercial side of the business—leading complex pre-sale engagements, designing repeatable implementation playbooks, and building the operational infrastructure for a best-in-class customer experience from first pitch through post-campaign wrap-up. You will have direct, measurable impact on sales effectiveness, deal velocity, and client retention.

Sales Effectiveness & Deal Acceleration

  • Lead technical pre-sale engagements with agency holding companies and mid-market agencies, translating AudioGraph capabilities into solutions that align with their buying workflows, planning tools, and KPIs.

  • Build reusable pitch assets—technical one-pagers, demo environments, objection-handling frameworks, ROI calculators—that equip sellers to move deals forward without waiting for SE availability.

  • Reduce time-to-proposal by owning a standardized deal configuration process: audience strategy, market selection, measurement approach, and pricing structure templated and ready to customize.

  • Participate directly in high-value pitch meetings and RFP responses; own the technical narrative that differentiates AudioGraph from competing audio solutions.

  • Train and enable the seller base through recurring technical workshops, deal clinics, and 1:1 coaching on how to position AudioGraph’s capabilities.

Operational Excellence & Customer Experience

  • Design and own the end-to-end client lifecycle playbook.

  • Ensure seamless handoffs between sales, ad ops, and client services at every stage transition—no client should ever feel like they’re starting over with a new team.

  • Architect campaign configurations for complex deals including audience layering, frequency management, creative specifications, and cross-platform measurement design.

Platform & Partner Integration

  • Inform the product roadmap by synthesizing field-level technical feedback into prioritized requirements; participate in sprint reviews and beta testing for new capabilities.

What You'll Need:

  • 5–8 years of experience in solutions engineering, technical account management, or advanced ad operations within programmatic advertising.

  • Deep understanding of the programmatic supply chain: bid mechanics, deal structures (PMP/PG/preferred deals), header bidding, and SSP-DSP integration patterns.

  • Direct experience with major DSPs (Amazon, TTD, DV360, Viant, Basis, or equivalent) from a technical integration or partner perspective.

  • Hands-on proficiency with ad serving platforms (Triton, GAM, FreeWheel, or equivalent), including deal setup, inventory packaging, and log-level troubleshooting.

  • Strong grasp of audience data architecture: identity graphs, data onboarding, clean rooms, and how audience segments flow through the programmatic pipe.

  • Experience with measurement and attribution methodologies (pixel-based, exposure file, foot traffic, brand lift) and at least one vendor in the space.

  • Demonstrated ability to operate independently in ambiguous environments and drive cross-functional projects without direct authority.

  • Excellent communication—comfortable presenting to agency leadership and equally comfortable debugging a bid stream with an engineer.

Nice to Have

  • Experience in audio, podcast, or broadcast advertising.

  • Familiarity with Salesforce, Operative AOS, or similar order management systems.

  • SQL proficiency and experience building operational dashboards or reporting pipelines.

  • Experience working within a media company or publisher-side ad tech team.

  • Prior experience in a player-coach or team lead capacity within an SE or technical solutions group.

What You'll Bring:

  • Respect for others and a strong belief that others should do this in return
  • Expertise with various technical disciplines and applications
  • Close attention to detail and quality orientation
  • Ability to multitask on a variety of critical projects
  • Ability to work independently, while also collaborating with others
  • Strong communication skills, particularly when explaining complex technical information
  • Ability to provide solutions to problems in situations that are atypical/infrequent
  • Analytical thinking and the ability to identify patterns
  • Efficiency with own work and impact of team results
  • Informal leadership capabilities with an interest in mentoring less experienced team members

Compensation:

Salary to be determined by multiple factors including but not limited to relevant experience, knowledge, skills, other job-related qualifications, and alignment with market data.

$112,000 - $140,000

About Zoetis
Zoetis is the world's leading animal health company, dedicated to nurturing our world and humankind by advancing care for animals. Powered by rigorous science, data-driven research and development, and deep customer insight, Zoetis discovers, develops, manufactures, and commercializes vaccines, medicines, diagnostics, biopharmaceuticals, and digital solutions for companion animals and livestock.

The Zoetis Retail Team brings these solutions to consumers and customers through important retail and omnichannel partnerships. This role will help expand access to companion animal prescription and over-the-counter solutions while building durable partnerships that support better outcomes for pets, the people who care for them, and the business.

Learn more about Zoetis and Zoetis products.

Role summary
The Senior Account Manager, Retail is a highly visible role within the U.S. Retail Team and serves as the commercial owner for a portfolio of strategically important omnichannel retail relationships. The portfolio will include a combination of retail accounts and channels including, but not limited to ecommerce, club, mass, convenience and distribution --accounts that are critical to the current performance and future growth of the Zoetis Retail business.
The successful candidate will build and execute customer strategies that deliver profitable net sales growth, strengthen strategic partnerships, improve execution, and expand the reach of priority Zoetis companion animal products. This role requires a balance of strategic thinking and disciplined execution: setting a clear direction with customers, translating business priorities into joint plans, and mobilizing internal teams to deliver results.
The Senior Account Manager will lead Joint Business Planning engagements, manage day-to-day customer relationships across multiple stakeholder groups, and collaborate closely with Marketing, Finance, Operations, Supply, Sales, and other cross-functional partners. The role will work across companion animal prescription and OTC/consumer portfolios, with priorities evolving in line with business needs and product opportunities.

Key responsibilities

  • Own customer strategy and growth: Build and execute 12 -18 month customer business plans and Joint Business Plans for assigned Drive and Develop Accounts. Deliver profitable growth through distribution, assortment, product placement, promotions, and new opportunities aligned to Zoetis priorities.
