raw.description:
The Opportunity:

We are looking for a highly capable Senior Android Engineer to join our Powered team and take ownership of our Android SDKs: the CQoE SDK, which telecom carriers and partners embed directly into their own apps to passively measure real-world network quality, and the Speedtest SDK, the core measurement library that powers every Speedtest client.

You will be responsible for implementing and maintaining features that perform a wide variety of network measurements on millions of Android devices. Much of this measurement logic lives in a shared C++ engine used across Android, iOS, and embedded targets, so you’ll have an opportunity to work across the Kotlin/Java, JNI/NDK, C++ boundary.

You love to code and appreciate well-designed APIs, as you will need to strike the right balance between SDK and application code. You have experience with Android platform, but are interested in both Android and iOS as well as embedded environments. You want to make a better Internet for everyone. If you already use Ookla’s tools to check your broadband or mobile data performance, now you have a chance to be a part of the team that produces them.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Design, implement, and maintain network measurement features in the CQoE and Speedtest Android SDKs, consumed by external carrier partners, third-party app developers, and internal client apps. This includes implementation, testing, documentation, deployment, and development support

  • Work across the JNI/NDK boundary into the shared C++ measurement engine used across Android, iOS, and embedded targets by debugging native code and, over time, contributing to and maintaining it directly

  • Bring AI-assisted tooling into coding, QA, and data analysis where it genuinely earns its place, with clear guardrails around safety, privacy, security, and verification

  • Stay hands-on where it counts (technical reviews, architecture discussions, targeted implementation) while taking ownership of delivery end-to-end on the features and fixes you drive

  • Roll out SDK and measurement changes deliberately: gate them behind feature flags, run quality checks, and verify post-release that real-world behavior matches intent before widening exposure

Job Requirements:

  • 5+ years of software development experience, with a solid foundation in data structures, algorithms, and design patterns

  • Experience with Android using Kotlin and Java

  • Substantial experience building and maintaining SDKs or libraries

  • Strong data literacy: comfortable writing SQL to investigate production and measurement data, using Python (or similar) for analysis, and applying data-quality monitoring practices to catch anomalies before they reach partners

  • A curious, proactive stance toward AI and modern engineering practices

  • Excellent debugging, troubleshooting, data analysis skills

  • Strong time management skills and a self-driven work ethic

Nice to have:

  • Experience with telecom/network measurement, QoE/QoS systems, or RF/cellular domain knowledge

  • Experience with iOS

  • Strong understanding of networking fundamentals (IP, TCP/UDP, HTTP/S, WebSocket).

  • Experience with embedded systems using C++

About

Ookla, an Accenture company, is a global leader in connectivity intelligence that brings together the trusted expertise of Speedtest®, Downdetector®, Ekahau®, and RootMetrics® to deliver unmatched network and connectivity insights. By combining multi-source data with industry-leading expertise, we transform network performance metrics into strategic, actionable insights.

Our solutions empower service providers, enterprises, and governments with the critical data and insights needed to optimize networks, enhance digital experiences, and help close the digital divide. At the same time, we amplify the real-world experiences of individuals and businesses that rely on connectivity to work, learn, and communicate. From measuring and analyzing connectivity to driving industry innovation, Ookla helps the world stay connected.

About Accenture

Accenture helps the world’s leading enterprises reinvent by building their digital core and unleashing the power of AI to create value at speed for organizations across industries. Our strategy is to be the reinvention partner of choice for our clients and lead in the safe, widespread adoption of AI, and to be the most client focused, AI-enabled, great place to work in the world. We bring together the talent of our approximately 799,000 people with proprietary assets and platforms, deep process and industry expertise, and leading ecosystem relationships to deliver end-to-end solutions and measurable outcomes at scale. Through our Reinvention Services, we offer broad expertise across Cybersecurity, Digital Core, Finance, Industry and Enterprise, Song, Supply Chain and Engineering, and Talent, with advanced capabilities in AI and Data, Industry and Process, and Technology. We serve approximately 9,000 clients and generated approximately $70 billion in FY25 revenue. Visit us at.

Compensation Range

Ookla provides a range for the base pay. Factors that may be used to determine your actual pay may include your specific job related knowledge, skills, experience, and geographic location. The salary compensation for this roleis 50,000 to 74,500 EUR annually. Individual pay within the compensation range for this business unit specific role is determined based on a variety of factors including experience, scope of the role, capabilities to perform the role, education and training, as well as business and company performance.

This is a project-based opportunity on an AI training platform — not a job. No fixed hours, no commitment beyond what fits your schedule. You record, you get paid.

About the Role

We're looking for people to record point-of-view videos of everyday household activities. You mount your smartphone on your head, go about your routine, and the camera captures exactly what you see. These videos help train AI systems and robots to understand how people interact with objects in real-world environments.

Do you wash dishes every day? Vacuum the rug? Walk the dog? Fold laundry? What if you could get paid just for recording it?

Responsibilities

  • Record everyday household activities from a first-person perspective — cooking, cleaning, tidying up, folding laundry, gardening, walking the dog, and more
  • Record in your own home, yard, garage, or workspace
  • Follow short recording guidelines per session
  • Upload videos through the project app

Requirements

  • Equipment: Own or use a smartphone or alternative camera device capable of 30 FPS or greater and 1080p resolution or greater. iPhone 12 or newer, Google Pixel 6+, or Samsung Galaxy S21+ (must have a wide-angle / 0.5x lens)
  • Capture method: Mount the device at forehead or eye-level for an egocentric perspective, maintaining a downward angle to maximize hand visibility.
  • Software: Utilize the designated "D&A" application for all data capture and upload.
  • Quality control: Ensure all video footage is clear, stable, well-lit, at least 15 seconds long, and accurately depicts useful, intentional tasks without unnecessary pauses or contrived movements.

Why is this freelance opportunity a great fit for you?

• Earn while you do your household chores: up to $6 per hour equivalent depending on the project

• This is project-based freelance work — pick up recording sessions when they fit your schedule

• Influence the future of how AI and robots understand and interact with the real world

Job Description:

Are you a highly motivated individual with an analytical mindset? Are you well-versed in common data transformation techniques? Do you enjoy working with data as well as working with customers? Are you looking for a job where you can use new technologies to tighten and improve processes? Are you looking to make a splash as part of a small but growing team? If you answered “Yes” to all of those questions, then we’re looking for you!

The ideal candidate for this role will be extremely detail-oriented and demonstrate a strong passion for business intelligence and data transformation technologies to support the customers of a rapidly growing SaaS business.

The Customer Data Specialist is a part of the Customer Success team, otherwise known as FMX’s secret weapon. We stand out in the industry due to our world-class customer support, which has earned us a 98% customer satisfaction rating! Customer Data Specialists are meticulous in their work and exhibit high attention to detail. The primary objective of this role is to successfully manage end-to-end customer data migration projects from multiple sources during implementation. Customer Data Specialists are expected to take initiative, meet project deadlines, and provide timely responses to customer inquiries. You'll be working in a fast-paced, high-energy, and collaborative environment, where you'll be expected to show up every day and positively impact the company's strategy and culture. You can expect to dedicate 70% of your time to data migrations, 20% customer meetings, and 10% administering product trainings.

Responsibilities:

As a Customer Data Specialist, you will:

  • Act as a data migration subject matter expert on the Customer Success team
  • Complete end-to-end data migrations for FMX customers. This process includes extracting source data from external softwares and transforming it to fit FMX’s target data schema using tools such as Excel, Power Query, AI and others prior to completing the upload process in the FMX application
  • Be the go-to source for a customer’s data questions and needs during their implementation
  • Understand customer data needs and prioritize them accordingly
  • Attend customer-facing meetings with the Customer Success Implementation and Retention teams to ensure customers’ data requirements are being met
  • Become an expert in FMX’s core product, and lead technical module-based trainings for customers
  • Adhere to project priority procedures and completion deadlines
  • Establish, maintain, and continuously increase client satisfaction through professional and courteous service
  • Work cross-functionally across Customer Success Support, Implementation, and Retention teams to maintain consistent communication
  • Seek continuous improvement in process and utilize emerging technologies, like AI tooling, to serve our customers more effectively

Requirements

Experience & Qualities:

  • A Bachelor’s degree from an accredited university
  • Advanced Microsoft Excel skills
  • Exceptional communication, attention to detail, time management, and organizational traits
  • An openness to learning new skills in data transformation technologies, including a high level of AI fluency
  • Creativity in using intelligent automation tools to complete repetitive tasks
  • Ability to manage a high volume of projects and meet deadlines
  • Comfortable hosting customer-facing meetings
  • Self-motivation and ability to thrive in a fast-paced, competitive environment
  • Embodiment of our core pillars: We value our work ethic, we are disciplined in our processes and responsibilities, we are coachable and seek out constructive criticism, we value results and are performance-driven, and we treat each other and everyone we meet with respect and integrity.

Tech Stack

  • FMX (We love our own product!)
  • Microsoft Excel
  • Slack
  • Zendesk
  • Google Suite (Sheets, Slides, etc.)
  • Claude
  • Notion AI

The hiring process for this role:

  • Apply! Submit your resume and answers to the application questions via the Workable portal.
  • Phone screen with PeopleOps: A 30-minute conversation to review your background and experiences, discuss the culture at FMX, and ensure that you understand the general expectations for the role. Also, a great time for you to ask questions about compensation, benefits, etc.
  • Hiring manager conversation: A 60-minute conversation with the Manager of Support Services and the Director of Customer Success. Be prepared to discuss your background as well as what you’re looking for in your next role and what direction you see your career path taking. This is a great time for you to ask questions about the expectations for this role, team culture, etc. Note: Following the Hiring Manager Conversation, there may be a data assessment project given, which will be reviewed in the first fifteen minutes of the Final Panel Interview.
  • Final Panel interview: A 45-minute, two part conversation. You can expect the first fifteen minutes to be dedicated to reviewing the data assessment project. The second portion of this interview will be a conversation with a few members of the Support Services team. This is a great time for you to ask questions about the team, life at FMX and get to know your potential teammates!

Benefits

raw.description:
👥 Please note that fluency in French is required, as it is our main business language. English is considered our secondary working language.

📅 Start date

  • ASAP - the role is open and the need is immediate

🏡 Contract type

  • Freelance, part-time (around 2.5 days per week) - with a possible move to full-time as the workload grows

  • Seniority: Mid-to-senior level

🌍 Location

  • 100% Remote (Europe)

💼 About the role

DotWorld is a fast-growing Venture Builder and SaaS Studio that designs, launches and scales several SaaS products in parallel. One of our products is a gamified micro-learning and AI literacy platform, and all of its content - courses, modules, acquisition funnels, website, emails - is AI-generated at scale.

Today, this product has no dedicated marketing function. Acquisition runs on organic and network, with no regular content production. Meanwhile, our first paid tests are clear: on this product, search-driven leads cost far too much, while video and image formats on Meta come in significantly cheaper. So the bottleneck is not targeting - it is the volume and quality of creative and content.

That is why we are creating this Content & Creative Marketer role. Your mission: feed the acquisition machine with content and creative, at a steady pace - organic content, video and static ad creative, landing pages, emails. You produce and execute yourself, leaning heavily on generative AI tools to industrialise production.

You will not run the ad accounts: our media buyers handle that. But you think like a performance marketer - angles, hooks, iterations, reading results - because what you produce goes straight into campaigns.

👥 The team

You will work directly with Charles, the product's founder, who will be your day-to-day contact and direct manager. You will be the first person dedicated to marketing on this product, working alongside the product team and our group acquisition experts - including Caroline AUDEBERT, our SEA Expert, who runs search. The team is fully remote, with a culture of agility, co-creation and strong ownership.

📂 Your responsibilities

Content and creative production

  • Video ad creative (short-form, vertical) and static assets for Meta campaigns

  • Organic content: posts, social formats, platform-specific variations

  • Landing pages and email sequences tied to campaigns

  • Industrialising production with generative AI tools (video, image, text): high volume, low production cost, quality held

Angles, messaging and personas

  • Defining positioning and messaging by persona (learners, companies)

  • Building an angle matrix to test: benefits, objections, awareness levels

  • Monitoring the creative formats and patterns that work in edtech and consumer AI

Feeding the acquisition loop

  • Holding a production cadence: a steady flow of creative ready to go live

  • Close collaboration with media buyers: briefs, iterations, variations on winning concepts

  • Reading creative performance signals (hook rate, CTR, cost per result) to steer the next batch

Measurement and iteration

  • Tracking what you produce: what performs, what gets dropped, what gets scaled

  • Contributing to acquisition reporting (PostHog is already in the stack)

  • An explicit learning loop between a creative's performance and the next concept

⭐ About you

Experience

  • Seniority: Mid-to-senior level

  • 3+ years producing content and creative in a marketing context

  • Experience in SaaS or a subscription app - a startup / early-stage environment is a real plus

  • You have already produced creative that ran in paid campaigns and you know what that involves

Technical skills

  • Short-form video production: editing, hooks, vertical formats, fast variations

  • Generative AI tools for content production (video, image, text) - this is the core method here

  • Conversion-oriented copywriting: ads, landing pages, emails

  • Performance / paid literacy: you understand how creative is judged in campaign (angles, testing, cost per result)

  • Hands-on Meta Ads (account structure, creative testing): a welcome plus, not a requirement

  • Tracking and analytics (PostHog or equivalent): a plus

Interpersonal skills

  • Full autonomy: you own this scope alone, with no creative team backing you up

  • Ability to prioritise a broad scope within limited working time

  • Speed of execution in an environment with no established process

  • Results-oriented, comfortable with data

Languages

  • French: fluent

  • English: fluent

  • German or Spanish: a plus (the product is multilingual)

✅ What makes this role attractive

  • Blank page: you build the content and creative machine from scratch, with a dedicated media budget to test

  • A product in a fast-moving market (AI literacy) with a differentiating gamification angle

  • Direct access to the founder, fast decisions, zero layers in between

  • A role where generative AI is a genuine production lever, not a gimmick

  • Part-time, 100% remote: compatible with a portfolio of clients

  • An engagement that can scale up to full-time if the results follow

👣 The challenges

  • Alone on marketing for this product: no creative team, no dedicated media buyer backing you up - you need to be able to do it all

  • Part-time on a broad scope: prioritisation matters, not everything will fit

  • Early-stage product: positioning and personas are still to be refined, and you help define them

  • High creative cadence: producing a lot with AI without letting quality slip is the real exercise

📋 Our hiring process

  1. Discovery interview with our Talent Acquisition Manager, Noémie - 30 min

  2. Creative case study with Charles, the product's founder - 1h

ℹ️ About DotWorld

Dotworld is a Venture Builder and SaaS Studio. Our model is simple but demanding: we design, launch and scale several SaaS products in parallel. Our fully distributed team operates with a strong culture: Test, Learn, Scale. We build practical tools that make everyday life easier for millions of people around the world. Today, our business is structured around several product universes, from HR tools to content management and design creation solutions.

Our approach We build SaaS products that are robust, intuitive and technically solid. Once the fundamentals are mastered, we roll them out internationally through extensive translation and localisation work. Growth then accelerates through a high-performing acquisition strategy, led by our SEO and SEA experts.

This model works - and it works well

More than 50 million visitors per year Zero fundraising: 100% self-funded growth Profitable from year one From 1 to 50+ team members in 4 years

An autonomous, committed and demanding team We build all of this as a team. Our strength lies in autonomous, committed people, where everyone has real impact. 90% of the team works remotely, with a culture built on trust, flexibility and respect for individual rhythms. We cultivate a supportive, stimulating and demanding environment, where individual fulfilment feeds collective success.

A culture of excellence At Dotworld, we aim for high standards: quality, rigour and efficiency in the service of impact. We are results-oriented: performance and pushing our own limits drive us every day. Continuous improvement, innovation and creativity are at the heart of our culture. Every product is refined iteratively until it reaches the best possible version. We adopt the latest technologies thoughtfully, to deliver modern, high-performing solutions built to last.

What's next? We are looking for curious, autonomous, sharp and enthusiastic people - people who like to do, test, build and improve… while aiming high. 👉 Want to join us? We look forward to talking with you.

🌿 Working environment

  • Professional development opportunities: at DotWorld, we believe every team member has the potential to go further. We offer opportunities to learn, grow and shape the future of our company.

  • A culture of innovation: we constantly encourage our teams to think outside the box and bring new ideas forward.

  • Strong company growth, and with it significant opportunities to grow in the years ahead.

  • Everything is still to be created: every idea, every initiative counts in building our culture, our projects and our vision together.

👥 Diversity

DotWorld fully subscribes to the principle of equal opportunity and equal access to employment for all. We believe in an inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive and contribute to our collective success, whatever their identity or background. We thank all candidates for their interest and for the time they invest in their application.

⭐ Our perks

🗺️ Remote work - Europe Work from any country in Europe, freely and simply.

⌛ Flexible hours Organise your schedule the way you want, because your work/life balance is a priority.

🌏 Remote work - worldwide Get a change of scenery and work from a different time zone for a month.

🌻 Our values

PERFORMANCE"Obsessed with Impact" We are a high-performance company. We never mistake motion (being busy) for progress (producing results). We believe that working with excellent colleagues is the best benefit we can offer. Excellence is not an option, it is our baseline standard.

OWNERSHIP"Act like an Owner" In many companies, when there is a problem, people look for who to blame. Here, we look for the solution. Ownership means acting as if it were your own money and your own company. There is no "that's not my job". If you see litter on the floor, you pick it up. If you see a bug, you make sure it gets reported.

INTEGRITY"We act with honesty, consistency, and professional courage." Within a team, integrity means everyone is held accountable for their performance, their attitude and the impact of their behaviour on the collective. We support each other, we play as a team and we look out for one another, while accepting that trust is built through reliability, contribution and upholding standards. Integrity means saying things clearly and respectfully, even when it is uncomfortable. It means aligning your words with your actions, accepting feedback, and understanding that everyone has to earn their place on the field through their commitment and behaviour. We believe that kindness without high standards leads to complacency, and that high standards without kindness lead to tyranny. Integrity is that balance.

GROWTH"Always be Learning" The world changes too fast to rest on what you already know. DotWorld is a school. Our promise is simple: you will work hard, but in 2 years you will have gained 5 years of professional experience. We value the learning curve (the slope) more than past experience (the starting point).

Position Title: Health Communication Specialist – Division of Community-based Prevention and Care

Location: Remote

Position End Date: 6/30/2027

Salary: $60,000 plus benefits

Overview:

The CDC Foundation is seeking a Health Communications Specialist to provide strategic communications support across multiple programs within the Division of Community-Based Prevention and Care, including oral health, asthma, community health workers, cancer, and community-health alignment.

  • promoting community-clinical linkages to prevent and manage asthma, cancer, and oral health
  • engaging and advancing the community health worker workforce, and promoting community health alignment by working closely with community health centers
  • implementing change practices within health systems to address health inequities
  • collecting and disseminating surveillance data on a wide variety of content areas described above

This position will regularly interact with program and evaluation staff to meet the communications needs of the Division. Under the direction of the Division Director and with guidance from the Bureau’s Health communications director, the Health Communications Specialist is responsible for creating and implementing a communications plan that supports and promotes the work in topic areas designated by the Division Director. The Health Communications Specialist identifies key messages, channels for communicating key messages (traditional and emerging), and identifies or develops content appropriate for those channels, ensuring cultural relevance and suitable literacy levels.

The Health Communications Specialist will also provide a structural analysis of systemic and historical racism and the resulting health inequities and apply this lens to their work, tailoring communications plans and activities to this analysis.

Qualifications:

  • Master’s degree in health communications, public health, or a related field.
  • 2-4 years professional, related experience.
  • Knowledge of behavior change messaging, marketing, and other communications principals and experience in applying these principles to previous work.
  • General understanding of and commitment to health equity, including racial equity, and addressing the social determinants of health.
  • Experience developing communications materials and awareness campaign(s), including formatting and creating visually appealing communications materials.
  • Ability to work independently and take direction as part of a team.
  • Excellent organization skills and attention to detail.
  • Excellent interpersonal skills/communication skills and experience working in collaborative team environments.
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office suite including Microsoft Word, Excel, and PowerPoint.

Responsibilities:

  • Plan, develop, implement, and evaluate communications message strategies that meet public health mission and goals.
  • Provide marketing and communications expertise in the development and implementation of printed and online publications, websites, presentations, and collateral materials including via traditional and emerging health communications modalities.
  • Work with program teams to develop effective and cost-efficient opportunities for message planning, research, message development, and message delivery.
  • Establish and maintain effective working relationships with partners, contractors, and stakeholders.
  • Develop content for posting on various digital media outlets, including ensuring consistency across communication channels and working within state requirements and guidelines. This may require work with partners or contractors.
  • Ensure communication activities are based on accepted principles, methods, and best practices.
  • Attend internal and external meetings as requested.
  • Complete assigned deliverables, including required reports, within established time frames.
  • Manage project work, as needed, including quality assurance and deliverable compliance.

Special Notes:

This role is involved in a dynamic public health program. As such, roles and responsibilities are subject to change as situations evolve. Roles and responsibilities listed above may be expanded upon or updated to match priorities and needs, once written approval is received by both the CDC Foundation and MDPH in order to best support the State of Massachusetts in their public health programming.

This position is currently a remote position. CDC Foundation retains the right to make adjustments to this as required.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment and will not be discriminated against on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, mental or physical disabilities, veteran status, and all other characteristics protected by law. We comply with all applicable laws including E.O. 11246 and the Vietnam Era Readjustment Assistance Act of 1974 governing employment practices and do not discriminate on the basis of any unlawful criteria in accordance with 41 C.F.R. §§ 60-300.5(a)(12) and 60-741.5(a)(7). As a federal government contractor, we take affirmative action on behalf of protected veterans.

The CDC Foundation is a smoke-free environment.

Relocation expenses are not included.

About the CDC Foundation The CDC Foundation helps the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC) save and improve lives by unleashing the power of collaboration between CDC, philanthropies, corporations, organizations and individuals to protect the health, safety and security of America and the world. The CDC Foundation is the go-to nonprofit authorized by Congress to mobilize philanthropic partners and private-sector resources to support CDC’s critical health protection mission. Since 1995, the CDC Foundation has raised over $1.2 billion and launched more than 1,200 programs impacting a variety of health threats from chronic disease conditions including cardiovascular disease and cancer, to infectious diseases like rotavirus and HIV, to emergency responses, including COVID-19 and Ebola. The CDC Foundation managed hundreds of programs in the United States and in more than 140 countries last year. Learn more at .

About Niyam IT (Niyam)

Niyam was founded in 2007 by a group of consultants who shared a unique vision: a technology company steeped in orderly process yet driven by passion and innovation. For nearly two decades, we have served the U.S. Federal government delivering mission-critical IT solutions across Emergency Preparedness and Response, Civilian Agency Services, and Law Enforcement and Public Safety.

Niyam is CMMI DEV Level 3 accredited and ISO certified (ISO 9001:2015, ISO/IEC 20000-1, ISO/IEC 27001), and holds an active CMMC Level 2 certification. We are proud to be recognized as a Best Places to Work by The Washington Post (2025) and USA Today (2026).

What We Offer:

  • Flexible Work Hours: Life doesn’t always fit into a 9-to-5 schedule. We offer flexibility to help you manage your work-life balance effectively.
  • Remote Work: Niyam understands the value of flexibility. We offer remote work.
  • Career Growth: Niyam is not just a job; it’s a career journey. We provide a supportive environment for your professional development and offer fully paid opportunities for training and advancement within the company.
  • Great People: Our people are the blueprint of who Niyam is to the industry and community.
  • Great Environment: Niyam fosters a great environment where innovation, collaboration, and personal growth thrive.
  • Diversity & Inclusion: We believe in the strength of diverse perspectives. Your unique ideas are welcomed and celebrated every day at Niyam.

Join us in creating a workplace where innovation, diversity, and well-being thrive. Your journey at Niyam awaits. Apply today!

Niyam is seeking a Principal Engineer, GIS / Geospatial Solutions to serve as the company's senior-most hands-on technical authority for geospatial engineering. This individual will define technical strategy and reference architecture for our GIS solution accelerators (GeoCube, SPHERE, RisQ), serve as lead Solution Architect on GIS-focused proposals and captures, and represent Niyam externally as a recognized geospatial thought leader through technical publications and conference speaking. The role combines deep hands-on delivery across active federal contracts with enterprise-level influence on Niyam's geospatial technical direction and growth strategy, and requires the ability to obtain a Top Secret clearance to support Niyam's continued expansion into DoD and Intelligence Community work.

Roles and Responsibilities

  • Technical Leadership & Strategy
    • Serve as the company-wide expert and recognized thought leader in GIS/geospatial engineering, setting technical direction for GeoCube, SPHERE, RisQ, and related capabilities.
    • Define technical strategy, reference architectures, and engineering standards for geospatial data ingestion, the Medallion (Bronze/Silver/Gold) data architecture, and the Model Lifecycle Management Framework.
    • Solve the organization's most complex or ambiguous geospatial and spatial-analytics challenges, from data fusion and geoprocessing to real-time situational awareness dashboards.
    • Collaborate closely with Niyam's Technical Directors (GIS, Solutions Engineering, Data Analytics) to align geospatial strategy with enterprise technical direction.
    • Drive innovation, such as AI/ML-enabled geospatial analytics and predictive risk modeling, that materially improves platform capability, performance, or revenue.
    Solution Architecture & Delivery
    • Serve as the primary Solution Architect on GIS-related engagements, providing hands-on architecture and delivery leadership across multiple active contracts/projects concurrently.
    • Design and oversee geodatabase architecture, geoprocessing models, and cloud-native geospatial pipelines that meet performance, security, and scalability requirements.
    • Resolve high-impact technical risks and escalations across GIS programs, ensuring solutions align with client mission needs and Niyam engineering standards.
    • Directly influence revenue and CPAR/customer-satisfaction performance by shaping technical strategy and solution quality across multiple projects.
    Business Development & Proposal Leadership
    • Act as lead Solution Architect and technical author on GIS-focused proposals and capture efforts, defining win themes, technical differentiators, and solution strategy.
    • Advise capture leadership and executives on technical feasibility, innovation opportunities, and competitive positioning for geospatial pursuits.
    • Support orals preparation, client technical due diligence, and solution demonstrations as the geospatial subject matter expert.
    • Partner with the GIS Technical Director and capture teams to protect and grow revenue through differentiated, credible geospatial solution offerings.
    Thought Leadership & External Representation
    • Author and publish technical blog posts, white papers, and case studies that position Niyam IT as an innovator in geospatial intelligence and disaster/risk analytics.
    • Speak at industry conferences, client forums, and technical webinars as a recognized geospatial subject matter expert, building Niyam's brand and pipeline visibility.
    • Represent Niyam in professional GIS/geospatial communities (e.g., Esri User Conferences, GEOINT, FedGeoDay) to strengthen market positioning and teaming relationships.
    Mentorship & Organizational Growth
    • Mentor engineers at all levels (Associate Engineer through Staff Engineer/Lead Architect) on geospatial engineering practices and career growth.
    • Make substantial contributions to the GIS/Geospatial Center of Competency (CoC), including standards, training materials, and reusable technical assets.
    • Support hiring and technical interviews for geospatial roles across the organization.

Required Qualifications

  • Must be a U.S. citizen and able to obtain and maintain a Top Secret (TS) security clearance.
  • Bachelor's degree in GIS, Geography, Computer Science, Geospatial Engineering, or a related field (equivalent experience considered in lieu of degree).
  • 12+ years of progressive experience in GIS/geospatial engineering, including architecture-level design of geospatial platforms and analytics solutions.
  • Deep hands-on expertise with the Esri ArcGIS platform (ArcGIS Enterprise, ArcGIS Online, ArcGIS Pro), geodatabase design, and geoprocessing model development.
  • Demonstrated experience architecting cloud-native, scalable geospatial data platforms (e.g., AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud) including data pipelines and API-enabled analytics.
  • Proficiency in Python and/or other languages used for geospatial data engineering, automation, and analytics.
  • Proven track record leading technical proposal content, solution architecture, and capture support for federal government contracts.
  • Demonstrated experience mentoring engineers and driving technical standards across teams or programs.
  • One or more industry-recognized certifications of considerable difficulty in a relevant technical discipline (e.g., Esri Technical Certification, AWS/Azure Solutions Architect, GISP).
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including experience authoring technical publications and presenting to technical and executive audiences.

Preferred Skills

  • Active Top Secret clearance or prior DoD/Intelligence Community clearance eligibility.
  • Experience with hazard risk modeling, emergency management, or disaster response platforms (e.g., FEMA, DHS, or similar mission areas).
  • Familiarity with AI/ML-enabled geospatial analytics, predictive modeling, or the Medallion (Bronze/Silver/Gold) data architecture pattern.
  • Prior publication of technical white papers, blog content, or peer-reviewed papers, and experience speaking at industry conferences (e.g., Esri UC, GEOINT Symposium, FedGeoDay).
  • Experience supporting GSA MAS, OASIS+, or other federal contract vehicle proposal efforts.

Why Join Niyam

  • Recognized as a Washington Post and USA Today Top Workplace (2025, 2026).
  • SBA Certified HUBZone small business with a growing federal past performance portfolio (FEMA, CBP, NOAA, DOJ, TSA, and more).
  • Opportunity to shape the technical direction of proprietary solution accelerators (GeoCube, SPHERE, RisQ) used across the federal government.
  • Clear, transparent technical career path with growth potential to Distinguished Engineer.

Join Niyam and help us win the work that matters.

Who is Boulevard?

Boulevard provides the first and only client experience platform for appointment-based, self-care businesses. We empower our customers to give their clients more of the magical moments that matter most.

Before launching in 2016, our founders spent months interviewing salon managers and working behind front desks to understand their pain points so we could design a modern, user-friendly platform that meets the unique needs of their business. Our roots may be in hair salons, but we are built for the broader self-care industry, including many types of salons, spas, medspa, barbershops, and more. Our technology not only helps our customers survive but thrive. Take a look at how we (and YOU) can make that happen.

We have an insatiable curiosity and embrace experimentation. We believe that simple solutions require the most sophistication, and we design each and every detail to maximize potential, power, and impact. Do our values match? Read through our story and what we value the most.

Our team values and celebrates our diverse backgrounds. Being open about who we are and what we do allows us to do the best work of our lives. We believe in equal opportunity for all, and you should too.

Come do the best work of your life at Boulevard.

As Creative Director, you will define and lead Boulevard’s creative vision, bringing our brand to life in ways that are bold, differentiated, and deeply resonant with the unique, expressive world of self-care businesses.

Boulevard serves some of the most creative, design-forward entrepreneurs in the world, spa owners, salon operators, and medspa professionals who care deeply about aesthetics, experience, and craft. Your role is to ensure our brand not only meets that bar, but sets it.

You will own how Boulevard shows up visually and experientially across every touchpoint, building a cohesive, modern, and scalable creative system that fuels awareness, affinity, and demand.

As a leader, you’ll guide and grow a multidisciplinary creative team while operating as a player-coach on the highest-impact work. You’ll partner closely with Brand, Content, Product Marketing, Demand Gen, and Product Design to translate strategy into breakthrough creative that drives business outcomes.

You’ll raise the bar for craft, storytelling, and creative effectiveness—ensuring everything we put into the world feels intentional, inspiring, and unmistakably Boulevard.

What you’ll do here:

  • Set and evolve Boulevard’s creative vision—ensuring a distinctive, cohesive, and elevated brand presence across all channels and touchpoints
  • Translate brand strategy and positioning into compelling, high-impact creative across campaigns, digital, social, web, events, and experiential
  • Lead the development of large-scale brand campaigns and always-on creative systems that drive awareness, engagement, and pipeline
  • Build and scale a high-performing in-house creative team across design, copy, video, and emerging formats
  • Operate as a player-coach—providing hands-on creative direction on key initiatives while mentoring and elevating the team
  • Establish and uphold a high bar for creative quality, consistency, and craft across all outputs
  • Own and evolve Boulevard’s visual identity system, ensuring it is both differentiated and scalable across the business
  • Partner closely with Brand, Content, Product Marketing, and Demand Gen to bring unified storytelling to life across the full customer journey
  • Collaborate with Product Design to ensure a cohesive brand experience across marketing and product surfaces
  • Lead creative reviews, provide clear and actionable feedback, and build strong alignment with cross-functional stakeholders
  • Manage and collaborate with external agencies, freelancers, and production partners to extend team capabilities
  • Integrate and explore AI-powered tools and workflows into the creative process to increase speed, scale output, and enable new forms of experimentation—while maintaining a high bar for craft and brand integrity
  • Continuously explore new formats, channels, and creative approaches to keep Boulevard’s brand fresh, relevant, and ahead of the curve
  • Ensure creative work drives measurable business impact across awareness, engagement, pipeline, and customer experience

What you'll need to thrive:

  • 10+ years of experience in creative leadership roles, ideally within B2B SaaS or high-growth technology companies
    • Candidates who are comfortable operating at the intersection of B2B SaaS and consumer lifestyle brands will have a distinct advantage — Boulevard lives in a unique space where enterprise software meets the highly visual, experience-driven world of self-care.
  • 5+ years leading and developing multidisciplinary creative teams
  • Strong strategic instincts—you can connect brand and creative decisions to business outcomes
  • Exceptional taste and creative judgment, with a deep understanding of visual storytelling, design systems, and brand building
  • Experience building and scaling creative systems, not just one-off campaigns
  • Curiosity and hands-on experience with AI-powered creative tools and workflows, with a point of view on how to apply them to improve speed, scalability, and creative effectiveness
  • Proven ability to lead concept development from insight to execution across multiple formats and channels
  • Strong communication and storytelling skills—you can clearly articulate the “why” behind the work to stakeholders at all levels
  • Strong cross-functional leadership skills and experience partnering with Brand, Content, Product Marketing, and Demand teams
  • Ability to balance bold, conceptual thinking with operational rigor and executional excellence
  • Experience working with and managing external agencies and production partners
  • Experience in video, motion, and emerging creative formats
  • Strong experience with tools such as Figma, Adobe Creative Suite, Asana, Unbounce, and modern creative workflows

How we'll take care of you:

At Boulevard, we work hard to structure compensation in a way that balances internal equity with local market competitiveness, and we’re happy to share a good-faith estimate of the base salary range for this role. For U.S. based candidates, the anticipated base salary range is $149,500 - $175,000 per year. In addition to this base compensation, this role may be eligible to participate in a variable compensation program. Final compensation will vary based on a variety of factors, which include but are not limited to applicable experience, location, and final leveling.

In addition to the wonderful people you’ll get to work with and challenging projects that’ll push you - Boulevard is here to make sure you’re always at the top of your game emotionally, mentally, and physically.

  • ✨ We’ve got you covered with a 401(k) match plus dental, medical, vision, and life insurance.

  • 🏝 Take a break whenever you need with our flexible vacation day policy.

  • 🖥 Fully remote so you can choose where you want to work. You’ll receive a work from home stipend every month.

  • 💚 Family planning resources and specialized support programs.

  • 🔮 Equity: get ahead on the ground floor and grow with Boulevard.

  • 💅 Boulevard Bucks Learning and Development program allows employees to explore businesses in the market we serve.

📲 We recommend following our official LinkedIn page to stay up to date on all things Boulevard life!

Boulevard Labs, Inc. is an Equal Opportunity Employer committed to hiring a diverse workforce and sustaining an inclusive culture. All employment decisions at Boulevard Labs, Inc. are based on business needs, job requirements, and individual qualifications, without regard to race, color, religion, marital status, age, national origin, ancestry, physical or mental disability, medical condition, pregnancy, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, veteran status, or any other status protected under federal, state, or local law.

raw.description:
Senior Software Engineer, MediaWiki Content Platform Team

Summary

The Wikimedia Foundation is looking for a software engineer to join our team, reporting to engineering management. As a software engineer, you will be responsible for engineering software that supports our product user experiences. In this role, you will work in a fully-remote environment (with occasional travel for team, department, or organization events), where we value teamwork and a consensus-oriented approach. You get to write open source code for collaborative experiences supporting well over half a billion pages accessed per day, and you get to do it at a place that believes we're all more successful when everyone has a good work-life balance.

On the Content Platform team, we work to support and evolve all things wikitext, the markup language behind Wikipedia. We aim to make wikitext easier to write, faster to parse, and less error-prone for humans. We also strive to support editing and content analysis tools with structured representations. We also maintain the web services associated with content rendering and transformation.

In this role, you will work in a mostly-remote environment. To ensure there are enough opportunities to communicate, the preferred timezone for this candidate will be GMT-4 to GMT+2.

You are responsible for:

  • Designing and delivering improvements to Wikipedia's wikitext processing infrastructure, balancing user experience, performance, backwards compatibility, and maintainability
  • Iterating on new features through collaboration with fellow engineers, product managers, designers, client teams, and community members
  • Writing PHP and JavaScript which supports hundreds of world languages
  • Creating and maintaining internet APIs with server scripting languages
  • Instrumenting components to monitor feature and quality characteristics
  • Leveraging caching and persistence technologies

Skills and experience:

  • 5+ years of related professional experience in software engineering
  • Experience with one or more of: parser generators, interpreters, language runtimes, compilers, or bringing a language feature through a product cycle
  • Demonstrated ability to own complex technical projects from problem definition through implementation and delivery, including making and communicating architectural decisions and navigating ambiguity
  • Experience designing and maintaining reliable, performant software components used by other teams, products, or large numbers of users
  • Strong engineering practices: you enjoy writing unit and integration tests, proactively addressing security and code review feedback, and balancing architectural tradeoffs
  • Ability to work effectively across team and organizational boundaries, identify and resolve technical dependencies, and bring projects to completion with limited direction
  • Experience mentoring other engineers and raising the technical quality of a team, through code reviews, design discussions, documentation, or direct mentorship

Qualities that are important to us:

  • A desire to make meaningful contributions to knowledge equity, free culture, and open access
  • An emphasis on communicating clearly in both synchronous and asynchronous channels
  • Self motivated with an ability to navigate through ambiguity and bring a project to completion with limited direction

Additionally, we'd love it if you have this:

  • Familiarity with the HTML5 spec and DOM manipulation
  • Expertise in Node.js and related technologies
  • Familiarity with Wikipedia/wikitext/markdown editing or content management systems (e.g., MediaWiki, Drupal, WordPress). We grow and care for MediaWiki and Wikimedia specific services. MediaWiki is an open source, PHP, MySQL, and JavaScript web application that powers Wikipedia and other Wikimedia Foundation websites. It has been incrementally developed for many years to become a richly featured wiki engine and the basis for hundreds of extensions and skins, and has a vibrant volunteer community.
  • A history of open source contribution
  • Bachelor's, master's, or doctorate degree in computer science, software engineering, or other STEM field (or equivalent certification)

About the Wikimedia Foundation

The Wikimedia Foundation is the nonprofit organization that operates Wikipedia and the other Wikimedia free knowledge projects. Our vision is a world in which every single human can freely share in the sum of all knowledge. We believe that everyone has the potential to contribute something to our shared knowledge, and that everyone should be able to access that knowledge freely. We host Wikipedia and the Wikimedia projects, build software experiences for reading, contributing, and sharing Wikimedia content, support the volunteer communities and partners who make Wikimedia possible, and advocate for policies that enable Wikimedia and free knowledge to thrive.

The Wikimedia Foundation is a charitable, not-for-profit organization that relies on donations. We receive donations from millions of individuals around the world, with an average donation of about $15. We also receive donations through institutional grants and gifts. The Wikimedia Foundation is a United States 501(c)(3) tax-exempt organization with offices in San Francisco, California, USA.

As an equal opportunity employer, the Wikimedia Foundation values having a diverse workforce and continuously strives to maintain an inclusive and equitable workplace. We encourage people with a diverse range of backgrounds to apply. We do not discriminate against any person based upon their race, traits historically associated with race, religion, color, national origin, sex, pregnancy or related medical conditions, parental status, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, genetic information, or any other legally protected characteristics.

The Wikimedia Foundation is a remote-first organization with staff members including contractors based 40+ countries*. Salaries at the Wikimedia Foundation are set in a way that is competitive, equitable, and consistent with our values and culture. The anticipated annual pay range of this position for applicants based within the United States is US$116,633 to US$181,243 with multiple individualized factors, including cost of living in the location, being the determinants of the offered pay. For applicants located outside of the US, the pay range will be adjusted to the country of hire. We neither ask for nor take into consideration the salary history of applicants. The compensation for a successful applicant will be based on their skills, experience and location.

*Please note that we are currently able to hire in the following:
US States: Arizona, California, Colorado, Connecticut, District of Columbia*, Florida, Georgia, Idaho, Illinois, Indiana, Iowa, Maryland, Massachusetts, Michigan, Minnesota, Missouri, New Jersey, New Mexico, New York, North Carolina, Ohio, Oklahoma, Oregon, Pennsylvania, Puerto Rico*, Rhode Island, Tennessee, Texas, Utah, Vermont, Virginia, Washington, West Virginia, Wisconsin and Wyoming (*US Territory or Federal District)

Countries: Brazil, Canada, Colombia, Germany, Ghana, India, Indonesia, Italy, Kenya*, Mexico, Morocco, Netherlands, Poland, Singapore*, South Africa, Spain, Switzerland and the United Kingdom. Our non-US employees are hired through a local third party Employer of Record (EOR) and must have current work authorization in their location. (*citizens/permanent residents only)

We periodically review this list to streamline to ensure alignment with our hiring requirements.

All applicants can reach out to their recruiter to understand more about the specific pay range for their location during the interview process.

If you are a qualified applicant requiring assistance or an accommodation to complete any step of the application process due to a disability, you may contact us at or +1 (415) 839-6885.

raw.excerpt: We're transforming the grocery industryAt Instacart, we invite the world to share love through food because we believe everyone should have access to the food they love and more time to enjoy it together.
raw.description:
We're transforming the grocery industry

At Instacart, we invite the world to share love through food because we believe everyone should have access to the food they love and more time to enjoy it together. Where others see a simple need for grocery delivery, we see exciting complexity and endless opportunity to serve the varied needs of our community. We work to deliver an essential service that customers rely on to get their groceries and household goods, while also offering safe and flexible earnings opportunities to Instacart Personal Shoppers.

Instacart has become a lifeline for millions of people, and we’re building the team to help push our shopping cart forward. If you’re ready to do the best work of your life, come join our table.

Instacart is a Flex First team

There’s no one-size fits all approach to how we do our best work. Our employees have the flexibility to choose where they do their best work—whether it’s from home, an office, or your favorite coffee shop—while staying connected and building community through regular in-person events. Learn more about our flexible approach to where we work.

Overview

Caper is at the forefront of Physical AI, building smart shopping carts that sense and respond to the real world in real time. By bringing intelligence onto the cart, Caper digitizes the entire in-store shopping journey, turning every trip into an interactive, personalized experience from the first item added to checkout. Our plug-and-play technology requires no store renovation or operational overhaul — retailers simply add Caper Carts and instantly upgrade their stores into connected, intelligent shopping environments. Caper is one of the fastest-growing retail automation technology products in the market and is already widely adopted across the industry.

We are looking for a Senior Product Manager to own recommendations and personalization on the Caper Cart. In this role, you will define how the cart decides what to show each shopper, when to show it, and how it adapts to who they are. Every recommendation, moment of inspiration, and ranking decision on the cart screen runs through the systems you will build and refine.

This is a unique opportunity to sit at the intersection of recommendation systems, machine learning, and a physical shopping experience that unfolds in real time as a customer moves through a store. You will blend ML and data science work with hands-on UX design thinking, partnering closely with Instacart's discovery and personalization platforms while shaping a first-of-its-kind experience for the Caper customer. You will report to the Group Product Manager for Caper Customer Value and work alongside a tight-knit team of three product managers, with broad cross-functional reach across Engineering, Data Science, Design, Ads, and Operations.

About the Job

  • Set and own the vision for recommendations and personalization on Caper. Caper turns the store itself into a personalization surface, where every item added and every step through the store is a chance to show something useful in the moment. You will drive Engagement as a primary pillar metric — growing customer interactions, building monetizable surfaces, and diversifying the content mix to serve savings, discovery, and health-focused shoppers.
  • Own the system that decides what to show and when. Mature recommendation and item ranking using machine learning, including LLM-based techniques, and use real-time signals — cart location and motion, lists, search, and Instacart personalization data — to deliver content at the moments it is most relevant rather than constant or intrusive.
  • Drive AI-first innovation to expand what Caper shows shoppers. Ship net-new content types with nuanced product information and pairings tailored to each individual, and lead the architecture for capturing real-time, in-session signals that make personalization feel genuinely intelligent.
  • Champion a high-quality, intuitive shopping experience by partnering closely with Design to translate complex personalization logic into interactions that feel simple and natural on the cart screen. Spend time in labs and partner stores to observe real shopper behavior, test features, and iterate quickly based on what you learn.
  • Run a fast, experiment-driven roadmap and serve as the product lead for recommendations and personalization across the organization — aligning senior stakeholders on strategy, tradeoffs, and progress, and partnering cross-functionally with Engineering, Data Science, Design, Ads, and Operations from discovery through launch with clear PRDs and measurable success criteria.

About You

Minimum Qualifications

  • 3+ years of product management experience or equivalent practical experience
  • Experience partnering with ML or data science teams to ship models into a production consumer product
  • Experience defining and driving engagement or relevance metrics, and using experimentation to move them
  • Demonstrated ability to leverage data and quantitative analysis to make sound decisions in ambiguous environments
  • Track record of close partnership with UX design teams and applying strong design thinking practices throughout the product development process
  • Strong communication and influencing skills, with experience presenting to large groups and aligning multiple senior stakeholders on strategy and tradeoffs

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience building recommendation, personalization, ranking, or search products
  • Experience with consumer-facing hardware, IoT, or physical retail products
  • Familiarity with retail, grocery, ads, or marketplace recommendation systems

Instacart provides highly market-competitive compensation and benefits in each location where our employees work. This role is remote and the base pay range for a successful candidate is dependent on their permanent work location. Please review our Flex First remote work policy here. Currently, we are only hiring in the following provinces: Ontario, Alberta, British Columbia, and Nova Scotia.

Offers may vary based on many factors, such as candidate experience and skills required for the role. Additionally, this role is eligible for a new hire equity grant as well as annual refresh grants. Please read more about our benefits offerings here.

For Canadian based candidates, the base pay ranges for a successful candidate are listed below.

CAN

raw.description:
Legal Administrative Assistant

Australian Criminal Law Firm | Remote – Philippines

Position Overview

The Legal Administrative Assistant will provide remote administrative and practice support to the directors and lawyers of an Australian criminal law firm. The role is responsible for diary coordination, matter administration, court document preparation and lodgement, stakeholder follow-ups, videoconference arrangements, and maintaining accurate electronic files.

This is a legal administration position and does not involve providing legal advice or making legal decisions. All court forms, correspondence, adjournment requests, and other legal documents must be prepared using approved templates and completed under the direction and review of the firm's lawyers.

Key Responsibilities

Diary and Court Schedule Management

  • Manage lawyers' diaries and maintain accurate schedules for court appearances, client meetings, videolinks, and other legal appointments.
  • Enter new matters and court dates into the firm's diary.
  • Record matters at the correct time based on court schedules and videolink arrangements.
  • Ensure all videolink details, access information, and supporting notes are correctly included in the diary.
  • Organise videoconferences for directors, lawyers, clients, and other relevant parties.
  • Monitor upcoming court dates and administrative deadlines and flag potential conflicts or missing information.

Matter and File Administration

  • Create new client and matter files in Actionstep practice management software.
  • Maintain accurate, complete, and well-organised electronic matter files.
  • Update matter information, court dates, contact details, documents, and correspondence in Actionstep.
  • Compile Word documents listing all charges relating to an accused person.
  • Prepare backsheets for barristers and organise the secure transmission of briefs and supporting materials.
  • Ensure documents are correctly named, saved, filed, and accessible to the relevant lawyers.

Court Documentation and Lodgement

  • Draft court forms using approved templates and instructions, including:
    • Bail applications and associated documents
    • Gaol orders
    • Form 25 documents
    • Adjournment requests
    • Other court or matter-related forms as directed
  • Submit documents through the relevant court systems, including the Courts Case Management System and County Court platforms.
  • Request adjournments through CMS under the express direction of the responsible lawyer.
  • Check documents for completeness, formatting, matter details, and attachments before submission.
  • Maintain records of submitted documents, confirmation receipts, and court correspondence.
  • Immediately escalate rejected lodgements, missing information, approaching deadlines, or system issues to the responsible lawyer.

Correspondence and Stakeholder Coordination

  • Request briefs and relevant case materials from informants.
  • Draft letters to clients regarding court appearances, matter updates, and finalisation of matters using approved templates.
  • Correspond with clients, informants, barristers, psychologists, court personnel, and other stakeholders at the direction of the directors or lawyers.
  • Follow up with stakeholders when a response has not been received within the firm's required timeframe.
  • Maintain professional, accurate, and confidential written communications.
  • Record material correspondence and follow-up actions in Actionstep.

Appointment and External Provider Coordination

  • Arrange psychologist appointments at the request of lawyers.
  • Coordinate appointment details among the lawyer, client, psychologist, and other relevant parties.
  • Confirm availability, booking details, videoconference information, and supporting documentation.
  • Follow up on outstanding confirmations, reports, or appointment requirements and escalate delays when necessary.

Key Deliverables

  • Court appearances, videolinks, and legal appointments are accurately recorded and maintained in the diary.
  • New matters are promptly and correctly created in Actionstep.
  • Court forms and correspondence are prepared accurately and within the required deadlines.
  • Documents are successfully lodged through the correct court platforms.
  • Stakeholder requests and follow-ups are completed within agreed timeframes.
  • Matter files are complete, current, well-organised, and compliant with the firm's procedures.
  • Confidential client and legal information is handled securely at all times.

Qualifications and Experience

  • At least three years of experience in legal administration, legal secretarial support, paralegal administration, or a comparable professional services role.
  • Experience supporting an Australian law firm is strongly preferred.
  • Exposure to criminal law, litigation, court administration, or matter management is advantageous.
  • Experience preparing legal forms, correspondence, briefs, and court-related documents using established templates.
  • Experience with court filing or electronic document lodgement is highly desirable.
  • Practical experience using Actionstep or a comparable legal practice management system is preferred.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Word, Outlook, Teams, and electronic document management.
  • Strong written English communication skills.

Core Competencies

  • Exceptional attention to detail and document accuracy.
  • Strong diary, deadline, and task management skills.
  • Ability to follow legal instructions and approved procedures precisely.
  • Sound judgement regarding when to proceed, clarify instructions, or escalate an issue.
  • Ability to manage multiple matters and competing priorities.
  • Professional and confident written communication.
  • Strong follow-through when coordinating with courts, clients, and external stakeholders.
  • High level of discretion when handling confidential and sensitive information.
  • Ability to work independently in a remote environment while remaining responsive to the Australian team.
  • Comfortable performing detailed, process-driven, and repetitive administrative work.

Systems and Tools

The successful candidate may work with:

  • Actionstep
  • Australian court case management and electronic lodgement systems
  • County Court online platforms
  • Microsoft Word
  • Microsoft Outlook
  • Microsoft Teams
  • Videoconferencing platforms
  • Electronic document and file management systems

Working Arrangements

  • Remote position based in the Philippines.
  • Required to work hours aligned with the Australian firm's operating schedule.
  • Must maintain reliable internet connectivity and a secure, confidential home-working environment.
  • Must be available during agreed working hours for instructions, urgent court-related administration, and time-sensitive follow-ups.

Scope and Authority

The Legal Administrative Assistant is responsible for administrative support only. The position does not provide legal advice, interpret legal issues independently, make representations to a court, or make decisions on behalf of a lawyer or client.

All substantive correspondence, court documents, adjournment requests, and legal forms must be completed using approved templates and submitted only following the direction or authorisation of the responsible lawyer.

raw.description:
Overview

HealthEdge® offers AI-powered operational infrastructure for health insurance companies, guaranteeing an enduring financial edge in an increasingly competitive market. We're experiencing strong market momentum, with a growing number of health plans choosing HealthEdge to modernize their operations and compete more effectively. As we expand, we're investing in the people who power that growth, making this a pivotal moment to join us and shape the future of healthcare technology. Learn more at HealthEdge.com.

Position Overview:  

We are seeking a Senior Corporate Counsel with deep experience in Business Process as a Service (BPaaS) and outsourced business operations to serve as a strategic legal partner to our BPaaS lines of business. A successful candidate has structured and negotiated complex BPaaS, business process outsourcing (BPO), or managed services arrangements, and understands the unique risk allocation, service-level, and regulatory considerations those engagements require. This person will have substantial responsibilities with daily impact in adding to the forward momentum of HealthEdge’s growth, and will serve as a senior legal advisor on our highest-value, highest-complexity BPaaS transactions. In this role, you will have responsibility for providing legal advice and counsel in support of a dynamic, fast-paced BPaaS and SaaS business. 

About Center of Excellence:  Centers of Excellence (COE) are teams whose primary goal is to provide expertise in a specific field. COEs will usually provide support through training, research, and skilled leaders. In the case of HealthEdge, our Centers of Excellence incorporate the Human Resources, IT, Legal and Financial fields, all of which provide support to our Product divisions and allows the enterprise to move forward and achieve its goals. 

 

Your Impact: 

  • Provide practical, business-oriented legal advice, counsel and recommendations to sales professionals and other stakeholders on numerous legal and business issues 
  • Draft, review, negotiate and close commercial contracts, including BPaaS master services agreements (MSAs), statements of work (SOWs), SaaS subscription contracts, license and services agreements, service orders, and related documents with customers, partners, resellers, data licensors and vendors 
  • Serve as lead counsel on BPaaS and business process outsourcing (BPO) engagements, including delegated administration and managed services arrangements — advising on service level agreements (SLAs), risk and liability allocation, data ownership and portability, and termination/transition provisions 
  • Coordinate with other groups (Finance, Marketing, Professional Services, Security, IT and others) in commercial contracting matters to support company policies and procedures 
  • Monitor and provide guidance on data privacy, delegated-function, and other applicable laws and regulations relevant to BPaaS and outsourced business operations (including delegation and accreditation requirements such as URAC and NCQA), as part of our global compliance program 
  • Provide legal support related to acquisitions and strategic alliances, including due diligence reviews and negotiations of purchase and sale agreements 
  • Create and maintain standard templates, including BPaaS MSA and SOW templates, business processes and internal policies to help scale the business 
  • Interface with and manage support from outside counsel 

 

What You Bring: 

  • 7-10 years of commercial law experience, including work in a large law firm or in-house at a technology or BPaaS/outsourced-services company; candidates with comparable backgrounds will be considered.
  • Demonstrated experience structuring, negotiating, and closing BPaaS, business process outsourcing (BPO), or managed services agreements, including SLAs, delegated functions, risk and liability allocation, and data rights 
  • Familiarity with regulatory and accreditation requirements applicable to delegated or outsourced business functions in healthcare or another highly regulated industry (e.g., URAC, NCQA, state delegation/TPA requirements) 
  • Ability to work independently to draft and close complex BPaaS and commercial agreements with minimal support from senior staff, and to advise less-experienced legal team members on BPaaS deal structuring 
  • Strong organizational and interpersonal skills, including ability to work effectively within a distributed team and a fast-paced business environment 
  • Self-motivation and the ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment  
  • The ability to tackle a variety of legal issues with a proactive approach to getting things done.  

Geographic Responsibility: Remote, US

Type of Employment: Full-time, permanent

FLSA Classification (USA Only): Exempt

Work Environment: The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job: 

  • The employee is occasionally required to move around the office. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception, and ability to adjust focus.
  • Work across multiple time zones in a hybrid or remote work environment.
  • Long periods of time sitting and/or standing in front of a computer using video technology.
  • May require travel dependent on company needs.

The above statements are intended to describe the general nature and level of the job being performed by the individual(s) assigned to this position. They are not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, and skills required. HealthEdge reserves the right to modify, add, or remove duties and to assign other duties as necessary. In addition, reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of this position in compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act of 1990. Candidates may be required to go through a pre-employment criminal background check.

HealthEdge is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to workforce diversity and actively encourage all qualified persons to seek employment with us, including, but not limited to, racial and ethnic minorities, women, veterans and persons with disabilities.

**The annual US base salary range for this position is $186,000 to $202,000. This salary range may cover multiple career levels at HealthEdge. Final compensation will be determined during the interview process and is based on a combination of factors including, but not limited to, your skills, experience, qualifications and education.
