raw.excerpt: Are you looking for a unique opportunity to be a part of something great?
raw.description:
Are you looking for a unique opportunity to be a part of something great? Want to join a 17,000-member team that works on the technology that powers the world around us? Looking for an atmosphere of trust, empowerment, respect, diversity, and communication? How about an opportunity to own a piece of a multi-billion dollar (with a B!) global organization? We offer all that and more at Microchip Technology Inc.

People come to work at Microchip because we help design the technology that runs the world. They stay because our culture supports their growth and stability. They are challenged and driven by an incredible array of products and solutions with unlimited career potential. Microchip’s nationally-recognized Leadership Passage Programs support career growth where we proudly enroll over a thousand people annually. We take pride in our commitment to employee development, values-based decision making, and strong sense of community, driven by our Vision, Mission, and 11 Guiding Values; we affectionately refer to it as the Aggregate System and it’s won us countless awards for diversity and workplace excellence.

Our company is built by dedicated team players who love to challenge the status quo; we did not achieve record revenue and over 30 years of quarterly profitability without a great team dedicated to empowering innovation. People like you.

Visit our careers page to see what exciting opportunities and company perks await!

Job Description:

We currently have an opening for a Senior Field Applications Engineer (FAE). It is a high-impact technical role for an experienced hardware, firmware, or embedded systems engineer seeking broader influence than a traditional development position. As a trusted technical advisor, the Senior FAE combines deep engineering expertise with customer engagement to help customers make architecture decisions, solve complex design challenges, and bring successful products to market. This role works closely with customers, sales, product management, and internal engineering teams to drive design wins, influence product direction, and create measurable business impact.

Why This Role Is Compelling:
• Broader technical influence across complete systems, architectures, technology selections, and customer design decisions.
• Direct visibility to business outcomes through design wins, revenue impact, and successful customer product launches.
• Exposure to a wide range of customers, applications, and industries instead of working on a single internal product for years.
• Continuous learning across emerging technologies such as embedded systems, industrial networking, high-speed Ethernet, PCIe, CXL, SoCs, FPGA, security, AI edge, and connected designs.
• Autonomy, trust, and ownership of strategic customer relationships, technical strategy, and territory success.
• A career path that can grow toward Principal FAE, solutions architecture, technical marketing, or technical sales leadership.

Key Responsibilities:
• Act as a trusted technical advisor to strategic customers, influencing system architecture, technology selection, and product integration decisions.
• Partner with sales teams to identify customer needs, shape technical strategy, and drive design-in and design-win opportunities.
• Support customers throughout the product lifecycle, from early architecture discussions and proof of concept through production launch and post-sales support.
• Conduct technical presentations, product demonstrations, and training sessions for customers and partners.
• Analyze customer requirements and recommend optimal product usage, system architecture, software, firmware, interface, logic, IP integration, and implementation strategies.
• Support customer discussions involving high-speed interface selection, SoC integration, IP blocks, FPGA or programmable logic development, and system-level trade-offs.
• Provide customer and market feedback to engineering, product management, and R&D teams to help influence product roadmaps and future solution development.
• Troubleshoot and resolve complex technical issues, escalating to engineering teams as needed.
• Build trusted relationships with technical stakeholders, engineering leaders, and decision-makers at customer sites.
• Stay current with emerging technologies, competitive products, industry standards, and market trends relevant to customer designs.
• Mentor and provide technical guidance to junior FAEs and other team members.

Requirements/Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related technical field.
    • 7+ years of relevant design or applications experience in embedded systems, hardware, software, firmware, networking, Ethernet, FPGA, security, SoCs, or related semiconductor technologies.
    • Solid understanding of high-speed digital technologies and interfaces such as Ethernet, PCIe, CXL, high-speed SerDes, SoC architectures, or related board- and system-level design considerations.
    • Ability to understand customer requirements involving processor, memory, connectivity, acceleration, and peripheral integration within complex embedded or SoC-based systems.
    • Strong track record of taking multiple hardware, firmware, software, or embedded systems designs from concept through production.
    • Experience working directly with customers, suppliers, sales teams, or cross-functional stakeholders to explain technology, solve technical problems, or influence design decisions.
    • Comfortable presenting technical concepts, leading architecture discussions, and translating customer requirements into practical engineering solutions.
    • Excellent problem-solving, analytical, and troubleshooting skills.
    • Strong communication and presentation abilities, with experience engaging both technical and non-technical audiences.
    • Proven ability to manage multiple projects and priorities in a fast-paced environment.
    • Willingness to travel to customer sites as required.
    • Bilingual proficiency in English and French.

Ideal Candidate Profile:
• An experienced engineer who has delivered high-speed, embedded, networking, or SoC-based designs to production and wants broader ownership, customer exposure, and visible business impact.
• A strong communicator who enjoys explaining technology, solving varied technical problems, and influencing design decisions across multiple customers and industries.
• A technically curious engineer with interest in embedded AI, edge intelligence, acceleration, or applying advanced semiconductor technologies to real customer problems.
• A self-directed professional who values autonomy, trust, continuous learning, and a path toward senior technical or customer-facing leadership roles.

Preferred Skills:
• Experience with product design cycles, customer architecture reviews, proof-of-concept activity, and customer design-in processes.
• Familiarity with industry standards and protocols relevant to Microchip products, including Ethernet, PCIe, CXL, high-speed digital interfaces, embedded security, and SoC integration.
• Experience supporting logic development, FPGA-based development, IP integration, RTL-level concepts, or semiconductor design-in activity is a strong asset.
• Interest in embedded AI, edge computing, acceleration, machine learning at the edge, or AI-enabled embedded applications is considered a bonus.
• Prior experience mentoring or leading technical teams

0% - 25%

We offer a total compensation package that ranks among the best in the industry. It consists of competitive base pay, restricted stock units, and quarterly bonus payments. In addition to these components, our package includes health benefits that begin day one, retirement savings plans, and an industry leading IESPP program with a 6-month look back feature. Find more information about all our benefits at the link below:

Benefits of working at Microchip

raw.title: Director of Capture Management
raw.excerpt: Position SummaryOdyssey is seeking a Capture Management Director to lead a high-performing team of Capture Managers responsible for identifying, shaping, and winning large federal business opportunities.
raw.description:
Position Summary

Odyssey is seeking a Capture Management Director to lead a high-performing team of Capture Managers responsible for identifying, shaping, and winning large federal business opportunities. Reporting to the Executive Director of Business Development and Capture, this leader will oversee the company’s capture portfolio and establish the priorities, processes, and operating discipline required to support sustained growth.

This is a leadership role focused on building and managing a world-class capture organization. The Director will lead Capture Managers pursuing significant opportunities across the U.S. Air Force, Army, Navy, Space and Missile Defense (SMD), and Life Sciences markets, with particular emphasis on large Full and Open competitions, major recompetes, and strategic growth opportunities.

The Director will work closely with the Executive Director of Business Development and Capture and senior company leadership to determine where Odyssey Systems should invest its time, people, and resources. This includes evaluating the opportunity pipeline, establishing capture priorities, assessing competitive positioning, and making informed recommendations on which pursuits should receive the organization’s highest level of investment.

The successful candidate will bring a strong understanding of how large federal procurements are won and the leadership ability to translate that knowledge into a consistent approach across the Capture Management team. The Director will establish common standards and best practices while giving Capture Managers the autonomy to develop strategies appropriate to their customers and opportunities.

This position requires a leader who can operate at two levels: managing the overall capture portfolio and developing the people responsible for individual pursuits, while personally engaging in the company's most important opportunities when executive leadership, customer relationships, or strategic intervention can influence the outcome.

Responsibilities

Duties include, but not limited to:

What You Will Do

Lead the Capture Organization

  • Lead, coach, and develop a team of Capture Managers responsible for major federal pursuits.
  • Establish clear expectations, performance standards, and priorities for the Capture Management team.
  • Build a culture that emphasizes accountability, collaboration, disciplined execution, and winning.
  • Develop Capture Managers through regular coaching, mentoring, pursuit reviews, and hands-on leadership.
  • Identify opportunities to strengthen the team's capabilities, processes, tools, and talent.
  • Establish a consistent operating rhythm for capture reviews, pipeline assessments, strategy sessions, and leadership updates.

Manage and Prioritize the Capture Portfolio

  • Work with the Executive Director of Business Development and Capture to establish and maintain the company's strategic capture priorities.
  • Evaluate opportunities based on customer alignment, strategic value, contract size, competitive environment, probability of success, resource requirements, and potential return on investment.
  • Recommend where Odyssey Systems should invest, pursue, shape, accelerate, or walk away from opportunities.
  • Ensure Capture Managers remain focused on the opportunities that matter most to the company's growth objectives.
  • Maintain visibility into the health and maturity of the capture portfolio and identify issues requiring executive attention.
  • Balance near-term recompete activity with longer-term growth opportunities and market expansion.

Lead Large Federal Pursuits

  • Provide leadership and oversight for significant Full and Open opportunities, major recompetes, and other high-value federal competitions.
  • Ensure Capture Managers engage customers early and develop a strong understanding of mission requirements, acquisition strategies, funding, evaluation priorities, and competitive dynamics.
  • Challenge capture teams to develop solutions that are differentiated, executable, and aligned with what matters most to the customer.
  • Review and challenge capture strategies, competitive assessments, teaming approaches, win strategies, pricing strategies, and proposal plans.
  • Personally engage in the company's most strategic pursuits where senior leadership involvement can improve customer access, teaming relationships, competitive positioning, or probability of win.
  • Ensure critical decisions are made early enough to influence the acquisition rather than simply respond to the RFP.

Establish Capture Best Practices

  • Develop and implement a consistent capture framework for Odyssey Systems based on proven federal capture practices.
  • Establish common standards for opportunity qualification, capture planning, customer engagement, competitive analysis, solution development, teaming, pricing, and proposal transition.
  • Implement meaningful capture metrics and decision points that provide leadership with a clear view of opportunity health and risk.
  • Establish disciplined reviews that identify weaknesses early and drive corrective action before proposal submission.
  • Continuously improve the company's capture approach based on wins, losses, customer feedback, and lessons learned.

Partner Across the Business

  • Work closely with the Executive Director of Business Development and Capture to translate corporate growth objectives into actionable capture priorities.
  • Partner with Business Development, Operations, Engineering, Program Management, Pricing, Contracts, Recruiting, Finance, and Proposal teams to develop executable strategies.
  • Ensure capture strategies reflect Odyssey Systems' actual capabilities, resources, customer relationships, and ability to deliver.
  • Guide Capture Managers in developing effective teaming strategies and relationships with industry partners.
  • Engage senior executives at appropriate stages of major pursuits to ensure organizational alignment and timely decision-making.
  • Help position Odyssey Systems for opportunities before formal acquisition activity begins.

Drive Continuous Improvement

  • Conduct structured reviews of major wins, losses, and completed pursuits to identify lessons that can improve future performance.
  • Track capture performance and use data to identify trends, bottlenecks, and opportunities for improvement.
  • Refine tools, processes, templates, and training programs used by the Capture Management organization.
  • Build a scalable capture function capable of supporting Odyssey Systems' continued growth without sacrificing discipline or quality.

Markets and Growth Focus

The Capture Management Director will oversee pursuits across a diverse set of federal markets, including:

  • U.S. Air Force
  • U.S. Army
  • U.S. Navy
  • Space and Missile Defense
  • Life Sciences

The immediate emphasis will be on building and winning a pipeline of large, strategically important Full and Open opportunities and major recompetes. The Director will help determine where Odyssey Systems can compete most effectively and how the company should position itself to expand its presence with existing customers and enter new markets.

What Success Looks Like

In this role, success is more than winning individual contracts. The Capture Management Director will be expected to build a stronger, more capable capture organization and create a repeatable approach to pursuing large federal opportunities.

Success will include:

  • A focused and strategically prioritized capture portfolio.
  • Stronger Capture Managers and a deeper bench of capture leadership talent.
  • Consistent application of capture best practices across major pursuits.
  • Earlier and more meaningful customer engagement.
  • Improved competitive positioning and probability of win.
  • A healthy pipeline of large Full and Open opportunities and recompetes.
  • Better alignment between capture strategy and operational execution.
  • Increased capture efficiency and disciplined use of company resources.
  • Growth in contract awards and profitable revenue across Odyssey Systems' priority markets.

Qualifications

Qualifications

  • Ability to obtain and maintain a Secret security clearance.
  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Engineering, Management, or a related discipline.
  • 12+ years of experience in federal business development, capture management, or a combination of both.
  • Demonstrated success leading or overseeing large federal captures, preferably including $50M+ opportunities.
  • Experience leading and developing Capture Managers or other senior business development professionals.
  • Demonstrated experience with Full and Open federal competitions and major recompetes.
  • Experience with one or more of Odyssey Systems' target markets, including Air Force, Army, Navy, SMD, or Life Sciences.
  • Strong understanding of the federal acquisition process and the dynamics of large government procurements.
  • Proven ability to evaluate opportunities and make sound pursuit and resource-allocation decisions.
  • Strong understanding of capture methodology and disciplined pursuit management.
  • Executive-level communication skills with the ability to brief senior leadership, customers, and industry partners.
  • Strong customer relationship, negotiation, strategic planning, and team leadership skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities while maintaining focus on the organization's most important opportunities.
  • Willingness to travel as required.

Preferred Experience

  • Experience with large DoD procurements involving the Air Force, Army, Navy, or SMD.
  • Experience pursuing federal Life Sciences or health-related opportunities.
  • Demonstrated success with large Full and Open competitions.
  • Experience with major recompetes and incumbent displacement strategies.
  • Experience with IDIQ, GWAC, BPA, and task-order environments.
  • Experience with FFP, CPFF, T&M, and other federal contract structures.
  • Experience establishing or improving a formal capture management organization.
  • Experience implementing capture metrics, governance, and portfolio-management processes.

Company Overview

Odyssey is a world-class technical, engineering, and integration company serving the warfighting ecosystem with airborne integration, ISR, C2, and warfighter readiness capabilities. Odyssey meets the military’s operational needs by integrating layered defense systems from equipment, technology, and services to data, information, and business operations. We streamline defense acquisition and sustainment, engineering the technical battlefield with domain-specific proficiency to ensure lethality. Odyssey is dedicated to excellent contract execution, peak organizational performance, and fostering a workplace built on employee care.

Odyssey is proud to live out our core values of commitment, ambition, and respect in our work and communities through OdysseyCares, a philanthropic group focused on giving back through direct donations, an employer match program, and volunteering events.

Equal Opportunity Employer/Protected Veterans/Individuals with Disabilities

Please Note:

Final compensation for this position will be determined by various factors such as the Federal Government contract labor categories and contract wage rates, relevant work experience, specific skills and competencies, geographic location, education, and certifications.

This position is filled through continuous recruitment and will remain open until a sufficient pool of applications has been received.Hired applicants may be eligible for benefits, including but not limited to, medical, dental, vision, life insurance, Tricare supplement, short-term disability, long-term disability, 401(k) match, flexible spending accounts, health savings accounts, employee assistance program, learning and development benefit, paid time off, and holidays.Odyssey Benefits

raw.description:
Welcome! We’re excited you’re considering an opportunity with us! To apply to this position and be considered, click the Apply button located above this message and complete the application in full. Below, you’ll find other important information about this position.

The Senior Reimbursement Analyst – Net Revenue PB is responsible for performing complex net revenue analysis and reimbursement activities for assigned hospitals and payers. The position supports month-end close, annual budget preparation, contractual and third-party reserve analysis, journal-entry preparation, and reconciliation of net revenue data. This role serves as a subject matter expert and senior technical resource regarding net revenue methodologies, reimbursement regulations, systems, and processes. The position collaborates with reimbursement, accounting, revenue cycle, and operational stakeholders but does not have direct supervisory responsibility.

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS:

EDUCATION, CERTIFICATION, AND/OR LICENSURE:

1. Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Accounting or Finance.

EXPERIENCE:

1. Four (4) years of work experience in finance or accounting.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:

EDUCATION, CERTIFICATION, AND/OR LICENSURE:

1. CPA Certification.

2. Master’s degree in accounting, finance, or business administration.

EXPERIENCE:

1. Two (2) years experience performing healthcare net revenue calculations, contractual reserve analysis, reimbursement budgeting, or month-end close activities.

CORE DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES: The statements described here are intended to describe the general nature of work being performed by people assigned to this position. They are not intended to be constructed as an all-inclusive list of all responsibilities and duties. Other duties may be assigned.

1. Provides advanced analytical and technical support for departmental net revenue reimbursement activities, including productivity, quality, process consistency, and education.

2. Serves as a senior technical resource regarding net revenue reimbursement for Reimbursement Analysts, specialty groups, committees, and other stakeholders.

3. Collaborates with reimbursement, accounting, revenue cycle, and operational stakeholders to analyze and resolve issues affecting net revenue reimbursement.

4. Serves as a subject matter expert for the Revenue Cycle Analytics application across assigned System hospitals and provides technical education, guidance, and troubleshooting support.

5. Develops and maintains an ongoing relationship with site accountants to assist with payments received or withheld relating to net revenue reimbursement.

6. Prepares annual net revenue reimbursement budget models for assigned hospitals using applicable final regulations, revenue data, statistical reports, and established methodologies. Reviews results for accuracy and explains significant assumptions or variances.

7. Applies knowledge of reimbursement components and programs, including IME, GME, DSH, RHC, bad debt, and other medical education or supplemental payment programs, when completing net revenue analyses.

8. Analyzes monthly contractual reserve estimates, identifies and explains material changes affecting accounts receivable, and prepares accurate and timely journal entries.

9. Provides peer training, technical guidance, and knowledge transfer to new and existing analysts regarding department procedures, systems, and reimbursement methodologies.

10. Supports team effectiveness by responding to technical questions, sharing subject matter expertise, contributing improvement ideas, and assisting with the resolution of complex reimbursement issues.

11. Leads or contributes subject matter expertise to process-improvement initiatives, system implementations, committee work, and cross-functional projects related to net revenue reimbursement.

12. Reconciles daily Epic accounts receivable, transaction, and charge files loaded into the Revenue Cycle Analytics application and investigates or resolves data variances between systems.

13. Reviews and updates application settings related to contractual, administrative adjustment, bad debt, and charity reserve calculations in accordance with established Enterprise Net Revenue processes and month-end deadlines.

14. Performs complex variance, trend, and root-cause analyses and presents findings and recommendations to reimbursement and finance leadership.

15. Develops, maintains, and improves analytical models, reconciliations, procedures, and internal controls to promote accuracy, consistency, and audit readiness.

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS: The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

1. Ability to sit and work at a computer for extended periods of time.

2. Ability to communicate effectively through verbal, written, and electronic methods.

3. Ability to perform repetitive hand and wrist movements associated with keyboarding, data entry, and use of standard office equipment.

WORKING ENVIRONMENT: The work environment characteristics described here are representative of those an employee encounters while performing the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

1. Work is performed primarily in a standard office or remote office environment with extensive use of computers, financial systems, video conferencing, and other electronic communication tools.

2. The employee may experience increased workload during month-end close, annual budgeting, audits, system implementations, and other designated reporting periods.

3. Occasional travel to organizational facilities, meetings, or training sessions may be required.

SKILLS & ABILITIES:

1. Advanced analytical, critical-thinking, problem-solving, and reconciliation skills.

2. Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including complex formulas, pivot tables, data validation, and analysis of large datasets.

3. Knowledge of healthcare reimbursement, net revenue methodologies, contractual allowances, third-party reserves, and accounts-receivable valuation.

This Full Stack Software Engineer will help build and evolve the web applications that power the driver experience at Roadie, while also contributing to RoadieXD™, our cross-dock solution, geospatial capabilities, and other foundational platform services. You’ll partner across Engineering, Product, and Operations to create intuitive, reliable experiences, solve complex logistics challenges, and build scalable systems that support millions of deliveries. If you enjoy owning features end to end, tackling challenging full-stack problems, and seeing your work make a meaningful impact, you’ll thrive in this role.

  • Design, build, and test full-stack features that improve the experience of drivers on the road
  • Develop the APIs and services that support RoadieXD, geospatial capabilities, and other areas of the Roadie platform
  • Build internal and customer-facing tools, primarily in React, that help our operations scale efficiently
  • Partner with Engineering, Product, and Operations to solve complex logistics challenges and deliver high-impact features
  • Contribute to architecture and technical design decisions that improve platform scalability, reliability, and performance
  • Write clean, maintainable code supported by automated testing, thoughtful code reviews, and modern engineering practices
  • Improve existing systems by identifying opportunities to enhance performance, developer experience, and long-term maintainability

Technologies

  • Frontend: TypeScript, JavaScript, React
  • Backend: Go and Ruby on Rails, with experience in other backend technologies welcomed
  • Data: PostgreSQL, Redis, Kafka
  • Infrastructure and DevOps: AWS, GitHub, Docker, Kubernetes, CircleCI

What You Bring

  • 3+ years of professional software engineering experience building and shipping production applications
  • Experience developing scalable systems and APIs in production environments
  • Proficiency in at least one backend language, such as Go, Ruby, Java, C#, or Python
  • Experience working with a modern frontend framework, ideally React
  • A track record of building reliable, maintainable, and well-tested software
  • Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to navigate complex technical challenges
  • Sound technical judgment, with the ability to balance immediate needs and long-term maintainability
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills, with experience working across Engineering, Product, and other teams

Why Roadie?

MEET CASA

Casa is the secure home for your bitcoin. We’re the leading provider of Bitcoin self-custody solutions, the ultimate blend of security, privacy, and control. Our team combines deep security expertise, human-focused design, and exceptional customer service to empower our clients and build lifelong relationships.

THE ROLE

Casa is looking for a DevSecOps Engineer to help secure our customers, their data, and our company. As a member of our Security team, you will report to our Chief Security Officer and play a crucial role in overseeing our security architecture and culture. It will also be a unique opportunity to help develop an evolving security program consisting of efficient processes, training materials, and methodologies for all employees.

The successful candidate has experience developing scalable security controls and approaches in accordance with industry standards.

Compensation: $125,000-155,000 USD

WHAT YOU'LL DO:

  • Handle internal security requests and make sure employees have the tools and access they need without over-provisioning
  • Ensure that employees have access to the tools and systems they need while maintaining least privilege access principles
  • Onboard and offboard employees across internal systems
  • Oversee our MDM system and stay on top of alerts
  • Review and assess new technologies (tools, code frameworks, third-party providers, internal apps) through a security lens
  • Help shape and refine security best practices across the org
  • Triage and work through vulnerabilities surfaced by pen testing, static analysis, responsible disclosures, and automated alerts
  • Keep security documentation and training materials fresh and useful
  • Automate security processes and alerts wherever you can find the leverage
  • Participate in a shared on-call rotation for critical production security issues
  • Stay abreast of the latest security events and trends
  • Participate in regular security training and certification acquisition
  • Ensure our software development lifecycle remains secure as we continue to evolve its processes.
  • Write infrastructure-as-code to automate deployment and management using Terraform, Ansible, or similar tools
  • Stay current on emerging threats, security trends, and what's happening across our stack and industry
  • Investigate and resolve infrastructure incidents to keep things running smoothly

WHO YOU ARE:

  • You have security certifications or equivalent real-world experience
  • You think like an attacker, and a hacker mindset is genuinely how you approach problems
  • Deep background across multiple facets of security
  • 5+ years implementing security in Linux-based infrastructures, AWS, and code
  • Comfortable with open-source tooling, cloud environments, and multiple operating systems
  • Experience building security solutions that actually scale
  • Hands-on with one or more of: penetration testing, threat modeling, code analysis, system hardening, distributed patching, vulnerability scanning
  • Familiar with hardening AI tooling to prevent security incidents
  • Strong communicator who can present findings to both technical and non-technical audiences
  • Bonus points for experience or genuine interest in cryptocurrency / cryptography

WHY CASA?

At Casa, our mission is to empower individuals to secure their digital sovereignty, and we empower our employees to do their best work.

  • Ownership. Private key management is the beginning of a future you can truly own, and at Casa, everyone has a role. We offer equity opportunities so our employees can benefit from what we are building together
  • Community. Inclusivity is important to us.We value each other and our contributions. Our team, known as the Casa Space Fleet, brings out the best in everyone while having plenty of fun along the way
  • Rest and Relaxation. We believe in the power of personal time, so we offer as much flexible time as you need. We encourage you to take at least 3 weeks off a year
  • Health Benefits. We provide medical coverage with FSA options, dental, vision, and access to mental health providers
  • Setup for Remote Success. Our team is both decentralized and effective. We reimburse up to $400 for anything you need to set up your home office
  • Investment Avenues. We partner with resources so you can invest a portion of your paycheck in Bitcoin, and we also have the more traditional 401(k) option
  • Maternity/Paternity Leave. We provide 12 weeks for maternity / 4 weeks for paternity

*As Casa is a fully remote company hiring candidates around the world, our perks and benefit packages may adjust based on your location

Casa is an Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO) employer and welcomes all qualified applicants. Applicants will receive fair and impartial consideration without regard to race, sex, color, religion, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, genetic data, or other legally protected status
